items.title: Dream moving all home games to Hawks' State Farm Arena
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Atlanta Dream will begin playing all of their home games at State Farm Arena starting next season.
items.body:
The Atlanta Dream will begin playing all of their home games at State Farm Arena starting next season.
The WNBA team announced a multi-year agreement on Tuesday with the home of the NBA's Atlanta Hawks.
Since 2021, the Dream have been based at 3,500-capacity Gateway Center Arena in suburban College Park, Ga. They have sold out every game there over the past three seasons.
By comparison, State Farm Arena in downtown Atlanta can hold more than 17,000 for basketball games. The Dream have had eight sellouts at the larger arena.
"This is an exciting next chapter for the Atlanta Dream, and a direct reflection of the exciting style of play that is Dream basketball, the passion of our fans and the incredible growth of this franchise," Dream president and COO Morgan Shaw Parker said in a statement. "Our players and our fans have transformed Gateway Center Arena into the most exciting experience in the WNBA. State Farm Arena gives us the opportunity to welcome thousands of additional fans while creating an even bigger stage for women's basketball in Atlanta. We look forward to bringing the energy, traditions and spirit of Gateway with us to the heart of our city."
Over the past five years, the Dream have seen more than a 400% growth in season ticket members, per the team.
Atlanta is currently competing in the WNBA playoff semifinals, holding a 1-0 lead over the New York Liberty in a best-of-five series. The Dream won Game 1 on Sunday at State Farm Arena before a crowd of 9,745.
"We are thrilled that the Atlanta Dream has chosen to make State Farm Arena its new home. The team's brand and fan base have grown tremendously throughout the city as the Dream has become one of the WNBA's elite franchises both on and off the court," said Andrew Saltzman, president of business enterprise and chief commercial officer of the Hawks and State Farm Arena. "The WNBA is experiencing a meteoric rise with rapid growth in attendance and viewership, and this is a great opportunity to elevate the visibility of women's basketball and bring that excitement to our world-class venue."
The Dream will play 25 regular-season games at State Farm Arena in 2027 under the league's expanded 50-game schedule.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Refinería venezolana de Cardón se detuvo tras un incendio, según dos fuentes
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La refinería Cardón de Venezuela, la segunda más grande del país con una capacidad de 310.000 barriles por día, fue paralizada debido a un incendio en una de sus unidades de procesamiento, dijeron el martes ocho fuentes con conocimiento del asunto.
items.body:
La refinería Cardón de Venezuela, la segunda más grande del país con una capacidad de 310.000 barriles por día, fue paralizada debido a un incendio en una de sus unidades de procesamiento, dijeron el martes ocho fuentes con conocimiento del asunto.
Incendios, fallas operativas y cortes de energía son comunes en las instalaciones operadas por la petrolera estatal PDVSA, lo que puede afectar el suministro de combustibles esenciales para el mercado interno, como gasolina y diésel.
El incendio comenzó en una línea de gas que conecta el hidrotratador de diésel de la refinería, lo que obligó a paralizar toda la instalación, incluidas las calderas, dijeron dos de las fuentes.
La petrolera estatal PDVSA no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios. El incendio fue extinguido menos de una hora después, tras algunas explosiones y la evacuación del personal, según fuentes y vecinos. No se han reportado trabajadores heridos.
Cardón es parte del Centro de Refinación Paraguaná de 955.000 bpd de PDVSA, el complejo más grande del país.
Los vídeos publicados en las redes sociales mostraban enormes columnas de llamas y humo saliendo de la refinería. Posteriormente, fotografías compartidas por vecinos mostraban a los bomberos en las instalaciones y el fuego extinguido. Reuters no pudo verificar de inmediato el contenido de los vídeos, pero otras fuentes informaron haber visto llamas y humo en la refinería.
La producción en una de las unidades de destilación de crudo de Cardón y su craqueador catalítico fluidizado se detuvo el mes pasado debido a la insuficiencia de materia prima.

items.title: NYC sues Manhattan law firm alleging bogus injury suits
items.author: David Thomas
items.creator: David Thomas
items.summary: The city of New York has sued a small Manhattan law firm for allegedly bringing bogus slip-and-fall lawsuits against it in violation of federal anti-racketeering law.
items.body:
The city of New York has sued a small Manhattan law firm for allegedly bringing bogus slip-and-fall lawsuits against it in violation of federal anti-racketeering law.
The city, in a complaint filed Sunday in Manhattan federal court, cited 15 allegedly fraudulent lawsuits brought by Asher & Associates and its attorneys, Ryan and Roberta Asher. The Asher firm claimed its clients were injured riding motorcycles, scooters and bicycles on poorly-maintained city roads when they were actually injured in other ways, like a fight or a hit-and-run incident, the city said.
The Asher firm dropped its cases without explanation after the city confronted it with "contradictory statements" in the lawsuits, New York's Law Department said in a press release.
“Personal injury laws exist to protect actual victims of trauma, not to line the pockets of people looking to make a quick buck off City taxpayers,” New York City Corporation Counsel Steven Banks said in a statement.
Ryan and Roberta Asher did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The case is the latest around the country to target personal injury lawyers under the federal Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations Act, a 56-year-old law passed by Congress to help rein in organized crime bosses who were often insulated by foot soldiers, for a pattern of unlawful behavior. Damages are tripled under RICO if the plaintiff wins.
New York is also seeking damages under the city and state False Claims Act.
“Fraudulent personal injury lawsuits profit on the misfortune of others and taxpayers bear the burden,” New York City Department of Transportation Commissioner Mike Flynn said in a statement.
The city in its lawsuit said the 15 cases it cited are "the tip of the proverbial iceberg," and that it seeks to discover other lawsuits by the Asher firm that have allegedly generated "millions of dollars in legal fees, settlements and judgments based on false narratives."
Companies including Uber Technologies and Federal Express Corporation [USN:L6N41R1BP TEXT:"have filed a string of lawsuits"] invoking civil RICO provisions against plaintiffs' lawyers in US federal courts. Nearly 300 such cases have been filed since 2024, according to a report released Tuesday by the American Tort Reform Association, a pro-business legal advocacy group.
The case is The City of New York v. Ryan H Asher, et al., US District Court for the Southern District of New York, 1:26-cv-08753
For the city: Eric Proshansky and Cesar Ruiz of the New York City Law Department

items.title: Posts inventam percentuais de votos de Lula e Flávio por região
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Posts nas redes sociais inventam percentuais de votos registrados para os candidatos a presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) e Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) no último domingo e alegam que Flávio foi eleito em primeiro turno com 54,98%.
items.body:
Posts nas redes sociais inventam percentuais de votos registrados para os candidatos a presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) e Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) no último domingo e alegam que Flávio foi eleito em primeiro turno com 54,98%.
Nenhuma das porcentagens mostradas no mapa corresponde ao apurado pelo Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE). Lula e Flávio irão disputar o segundo turno após terem somado, respectivamente, 45,16% e 47,03% dos votos válidos.
“Como o TSE pode ter encontrado outro resultado?”, questionam os posts, compartilhados no Facebook .
O conteúdo checado mostra os seguintes supostos resultados:
Sul -- Flávio 55,8%, Lula 44,2%
Sudeste -- Flávio 55,2%, Lula 44,8%
Centro-Oeste -- Flávio 59,5%, Lula 40,5%
Nordeste -- Flávio 45,5%, Lula 54,5%
Norte -- Flávio 58,9%, Lula 41,1%
O post apresenta como resultado nacional uma média simples dos percentuais por região, concluindo que Flávio teve 54,98% dos votos.
Já os resultados apurados pelo TSE no domingo foram:
Sul -- Flávio 60,08%, Lula 31,28%
Sudeste -- Flávio 51,36%, Lula 39,68%
Centro-Oeste -- Flávio 56,51%, Lula 32,62%
Nordeste -- Flávio 30,85%, Lula 63,77%
Norte -- Flávio 49,15%, Lula 44,65%
Em todo o país, Flávio somou 47,03% dos votos válidos, e Lula, 45,16%.
Além de apresentar dados errados, o conteúdo checado mostra um cálculo incorreto ao fazer uma média simples das porcentagens de Flávio, dando o mesmo peso a regiões com eleitorados de tamanhos diferentes em vez de considerar os votos válidos apurados em cada uma.
O mapa ainda ignora os votos recebidos pelos outros candidatos no primeiro turno, como se houvesse votos apenas para Flávio e Lula nas cinco regiões do país. Nacionalmente, Augusto Cury (Avante) teve 2,89% dos votos válidos, Renan Santos (Missão) alcançou 2,24% e Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) chegou a 2,18%. Os demais concorrentes não somaram 1%.
VEREDICTO Falso. O mapa mostra dados falsos por região no primeiro turno para alegar que Flávio Bolsonaro venceu com 54,98% dos votos do país, mas o candidato obteve 47,03% e disputará o segundo turno.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.title: Libya's eastern lawmakers elect Abdulnabi as speaker after 12 years of Saleh
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Libya's eastern-based House of Representatives elected Al-Salhin Abdulnabi as speaker on Tuesday, replacing Aguila Saleh after nearly 12 years in the post amid growing discontent among lawmakers over his leadership.
items.body:
Libya's eastern-based House of Representatives elected Al-Salhin Abdulnabi as speaker on Tuesday, replacing Aguila Saleh after nearly 12 years in the post amid growing discontent among lawmakers over his leadership.
The vote came a day after 98 members of the House approved a new term system limiting the speaker and deputy speakers to a single 12-month term, ending an arrangement that had remained in place since the chamber's first leadership was elected in 2014.
"There was significant discontent among MPs with the previous leadership over numerous errors. We tried to engage with the leadership to address these issues, but to no avail. Among these errors were decisions made without consulting MPs," lawmaker Jebreel Oheida told Reuters.
The House also elected Tarek al-Ashtar and Mesbah Douma as first and second deputy speakers, respectively.
Abdulnabi, who comes from the same tribe as Saleh, represents the eastern city of Tobruk and has chaired parliament's Libyan-Turkish friendship committee. He holds a master's degree in civil engineering.
Libya, a major oil and gas producer, has been split since 2014 between rival administrations in the east and west, with the internationally recognised Government of National Unity based in the western capital Tripoli.
Saleh, an ally of eastern military commander Khalifa Haftar, has long played a central role in diplomacy aimed at resolving Libya's conflict.
Libya has two legislative chambers. The House of Representatives was elected in 2014, while the High State Council was established under a 2015 political agreement and drawn from a parliament elected in 2012.
The House is based in the east, while the High State Council is in Tripoli alongside the Government of National Unity.

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 6 : The US Justice Department directed its employees on Tuesday to use the words "super intelligence" instead of "artificial intelligence" when referring to the technology in most circumstances, including in court, according to a memo seen by Reuters.
• The directive from acting Deputy Attorney General Trent McCotter follows US President Donald Trump's executive order last week mandating the switch within federal agencies, which Trump said would more accurately reflect the potential of the rapidly advancing technology.
• DOJ employees are to use the words "super intelligence" and "SI" in place of AI "to the maximum extent permitted by law" in public communications, policy documents and other official records, according to the memo. The directive "shall extend to court filings when appropriate," the memo says.
• Public perception of artificial intelligence has soured in the wake of hacking incidents that have raised questions about safety.
• Trump has resisted new regulations for the technology but has said the Justice Department would rein it in if necessary.

items.title: 原油先物ほぼ横ばい、中東供給増とフーシ派攻撃巡る懸念見極め
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Scott DiSavino

[ニューヨーク　６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Scott DiSavino

[ニューヨーク　６日　ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は序盤の下げを取り戻し、ほぼ横ばいで終了した。中東からの原油輸出の増加や主要７カ国（Ｇ７）による緊急備蓄からのディーゼル燃料放出計画と、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派の攻撃に伴う供給懸念とを見極める展開となった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．２６ドル（０．３％）高の１バレル＝１００．５８ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．０１ドル高の８９．４４ドル。 

大手石油商社ビトルの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は６日、価格上昇圧力を和らげるために必要な量とされる日量約１２００万バレルの原油と同２００万バレルの石油製品が、過去７─１０日間に中東から出荷されたと明らかにした。

サウジアラビアのアブドルアジズエネルギー相も６日、紅海沿岸の石油輸出拠点ヤンブーに通じる東西パイプラインの送油量が、同日朝の時点で５８０万バレルに達したと明らかにした。

こうした中、サウジアラビア航空当局は、フーシ派との対立が激化する中、ジャザンとナジュランにあるサウジの２空港が５日に攻撃の標的となり、３人が負傷し、限定的な被害が出たと明らかにした。中東でのさらなる供給途絶の可能性が意識され、原油価格の下落幅は限定的なものにとどまった。

大手石油商社ビトルの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は６日、価格上昇圧力を和らげるために必要な量とされる日量約１２００万バレルの原油と同２００万バレルの石油製品が、過去７─１０日間に中東から出荷されたと明らかにした。

サウジアラビアのアブドルアジズエネルギー相も６日、紅海沿岸の石油輸出拠点ヤンブーに通じる東西パイプラインの送油量が、同日朝の時点で５８０万バレルに達したと明らかにした。

こうした中、サウジアラビア航空当局は、フーシ派との対立が激化する中、ジャザンとナジュランにあるサウジの２空港が５日に攻撃の標的となり、３人が負傷し、限定的な被害が出たと明らかにした。中東でのさらなる供給途絶の可能性が意識され、原油価格の下落幅は限定的なものにとどまった。

items.title: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson watching film with Randy Moss, might rest with bye looming
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Having a Lamborghini in the garage might make sense only to an owner tasked with keeping such a prized investment safe.
items.body:
Having a Lamborghini in the garage might make sense only to an owner tasked with keeping such a prized investment safe.
In similar context, the Vikings are thinking carefully about whether to put All-Pro wide receiver Justin Jefferson on the field for Week 5, with a bye week -- and nearly two weeks of rehab and rest for his injured ankle -- on deck.
"He's doing great. He kind of got a lot of the initial soreness and things out last week," Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell told the Pat McAfee Show on Tuesday. "We'll see what he's kind of able to handle from a practice standpoint leading into Sunday, but (we) don't know exactly where he's going to be at. We have the bye next week."
The Vikings (4-0) face the New Orleans Saints (1-3) on Sunday. With no game during the Week 6 slate, resting Jefferson on Sunday against the Saints could mean his next game isn't until Oct. 25, 28 days from the date he was injured.
Jefferson was ruled out last week against the Miami Dolphins. He rested his ankle after being injured on a 10-yard reception in the first quarter of Minnesota's 23-16 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in Week 3.
While Jefferson did not practice last week, he has been studying with a well-known pass catcher.
"Randy Moss has been spending some time around the facility and it's been awesome," O'Connell said. "But when Randy and Justin are watching tape together, they come up with some pretty damn good ideas, I've got to say."
Jefferson played in all 17 regular-season games for Minnesota in both 2024 and 2025. The seven-year veteran missed seven games in 2023 with a torn right hamstring.
Jefferson, 27, has collected 13 receptions for 179 yards and two touchdowns in three games this season.
Named Offensive Player of the Year in 2022, Jefferson has 592 catches for 8,659 yards and 44 touchdowns in 97 career games (94 starts) since being selected by the Vikings with the 22nd overall pick of the 2020 NFL Draft.
--Field Level Media

items.title: US Justice Dept tells staff to call AI 'super intelligence' under Trump order
items.author: Andrew Goudsward
items.creator: Andrew Goudsward
items.summary: The US Justice Department directed its employees on Tuesday to use the words "super intelligence" instead of "artificial intelligence" when referring to the technology in most circumstances, including in court, according to a memo seen by Reuters.
items.body:
The US Justice Department directed its employees on Tuesday to use the words "super intelligence" instead of "artificial intelligence" when referring to the technology in most circumstances, including in court, according to a memo seen by Reuters.
The directive from acting Deputy Attorney General Trent McCotter follows US President Donald Trump's executive [USN:L1N45K0VR TEXT:"order last week"] mandating the switch within federal agencies, which Trump said would more accurately reflect the potential of the rapidly advancing technology.
DOJ employees are to use the words "super intelligence" and "SI" in place of AI "to the maximum extent permitted by law" in public communications, policy documents and other official records, according to the memo. The directive "shall extend to court filings when appropriate," the memo says.
Public perception of artificial intelligence has soured in the wake of hacking incidents that have raised questions about safety.
Trump has resisted new regulations for the technology but has said the Justice Department would rein it in if necessary.

原油相場の落ち着きを背景に、仏１０年債利回りは６日の取引で低下。同債利回りはここ数週間で急上昇し、指標となる独債との利回り格差は月初に２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の最大水準に拡大していた。

［ニューヨーク　６日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場ではユーロが上昇し、１日としては７週間ぶりの大幅な上昇を記録する見通し。フランス国債利回りの低下を受け、ユーロ圏債市場の緊張に対する懸念が和らいだ。

ユーロ／ドルは０．３５％高の１．１２６ドル。１日としては８月１９日以来の大幅高となる見通し。前日の取引では、約１年５カ月ぶりの安値を付ける場面もあった。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．３２％安の１０１．８３。１日の下げとしては９月３日以来最大となる見込み。

原油相場の落ち着きを背景に、仏１０年債利回りは６日の取引で低下。同債利回りはここ数週間で急上昇し、指標となる独債との利回り格差は月初に２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の最大水準に拡大していた。

ポンド／ドルは１週間ぶりの高値となる１．３２８３ドルを付けた後、終盤の取引では０．４２％高の１．３２７５ドル。ポンドも１日としては８月１９日以来の大幅高となる勢い。    　一方、ドル／円は０．１１％高の１５８．０８円。    　日銀の植田和男総裁は６日、基調的な物価上昇率が２％に近づいている中、金融環境が緩和的なことを踏まえれば「経済・物価・金融情勢に応じて、引き続き政策金利を引き上げ、金融緩和度合いを調整していくことになる」と述べた。その上で、政策調整のタイミングやペースは、経済・物価の中心的な見通しが実現する確度やリスクを点検しながら検討していくとした。    　米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は月末の会合で金利を据え置くと見込まれている。ＣＭＥのフェドウォッチによると、同会合で０．２５％ポイント利上げが実施される確率は約１９％と、１週間前の約５１％から低下した。しかし、市場が織り込む１２月の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ確率は８６％となっている。    　ゴールドマン・サックスのアナリストはレポートで、９月のドルの上昇について、米株式市場でのハイテクおよび人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄の比重の高まりと、最近の米経済成長の好調さが一因だと指摘。ただ、ＦＲＢが金融引き締めに忍耐強いアプローチを強調していることなどを理由に、短期的なドルの強さについては慎重な見方を示した。    　こうした中、カンザスシティー地区連銀のシュミッド総裁は６日、長期金利の上昇が一部の経済活動の重しになっているとしても、ＦＲＢがインフレ抑制のために追加利上げを実施する必要があるとの考えを示した。

items.title: Russia says tanker crew rescued in Black Sea after attack set ship ablaze
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Emergency crews on Tuesday rescued the 23-member crew of a Liberian-flagged tanker, the Aframax Rio, which was set ablaze off Russia's Black Sea coast after coming under attack from an unmanned vessel, the Russian Transport Ministry said.
items.body:
Emergency crews on Tuesday rescued the 23-member crew of a Liberian-flagged tanker, the Aframax Rio, which was set ablaze off Russia's Black Sea coast after coming under attack from an unmanned vessel, the Russian Transport Ministry said.
The ministry, in a report posted on Telegram, said the crew was made up entirely of Indian nationals. It said there were no injuries.
The ministry said firefighters had sufficient means to tackle the blaze once it became less intense.
Russian regional authorities in the settlement of Sirius had earlier reported the fire aboard the tanker. Beaches in the settlement in Russia's south Krasnodar region were closed to the public, the authorities said.

items.title: Anec prevé descenso de exportaciones de soja y maíz de Brasil en octubre
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Las exportaciones de soja de Brasil deberían alcanzar los 6,18 millones de toneladas en octubre, frente a los 6,40 millones de toneladas del mismo periodo del año pasado, pronosticó el martes la Asociación Nacional de Exportadores de Cereales (Anec).
items.body:
Las exportaciones de soja de Brasil deberían alcanzar los 6,18 millones de toneladas en octubre, frente a los 6,40 millones de toneladas del mismo periodo del año pasado, pronosticó el martes la Asociación Nacional de Exportadores de Cereales (Anec).
Del mismo modo, los envíos de maíz de Brasil deberían descender a 5,34 millones este mes, frente a los 5,69 millones del mismo periodo del año pasado, según la primera previsión de la asociación para octubre.
Por otra parte, las exportaciones de sorgo de Brasil, impulsadas por los envíos a China en 2026 tras un acuerdo entre ambos países, se estimaron en 1,439 millones de toneladas en octubre.
En los dos meses anteriores, las exportaciones de sorgo brasileño ya habían sido sólidas, sumando en lo que va de año casi 2,5 millones de toneladas, frente a un volumen nulo registrado en 2025, según datos de la Anec.
En tanto, la exportación de harina de soja de Brasil debería alcanzar los 2,09 millones de toneladas en octubre, frente a los 1,73 millones del mismo periodo del año pasado, señaló la asociación.

items.title: Petróleo fecha estável com alta de exportações e riscos no Oriente Médio
items.author: Scott Disavino
items.creator: Scott Disavino
items.summary: Os preços do petróleo permaneceram praticamente inalterados nesta terça-feira, enquanto o mercado avaliava o aumento nas exportações de petróleo do Oriente Médio e a liberação planejada pelo Grupo dos Sete (G7) de reservas de emergência de diesel e petróleo, em contraposição às preocupações com o abastecimento relacionadas aos ataques dos houthis do Iêmen, apoiados pelo Irã.
items.body:
Os preços do petróleo permaneceram praticamente inalterados nesta terça-feira, enquanto o mercado avaliava o aumento nas exportações de petróleo do Oriente Médio e a liberação planejada pelo Grupo dos Sete (G7) de reservas de emergência de diesel e petróleo, em contraposição às preocupações com o abastecimento relacionadas aos ataques dos houthis do Iêmen, apoiados pelo Irã.
Os futuros do Brent subiram 26 centavos, ou 0,3%, fechando a US$100,58 o barril, enquanto o petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos Estados Unidos subiu um centavo, fechando a US$89,44.
Cerca de 12 milhões de barris por dia de petróleo e 2 milhões de bpd de produtos refinados — volumes necessários para amenizar a pressão sobre os preços — saíram do Oriente Médio em petroleiros nos últimos sete a dez dias, afirmou nesta terça-feira o presidente-executivo da gigante de comercialização de commodities Vitol.
O ministro da Energia da Arábia Saudita, príncipe Abdulaziz bin Salman, afirmou nesta terça-feira que o petróleo bombeado pelo Oleoduto Leste-Oeste, que se estende até Yanbu, o centro de exportação do reino no Mar Vermelho, havia atingido 5,8 milhões de barris até a manhã desta terça-feira.
A queda nos preços do petróleo, no entanto, tem sido limitada pela possibilidade de novas interrupções no abastecimento do Oriente Médio.
Os aeroportos sauditas de Jazan e Najran foram alvo de dois ataques na noite de segunda-feira, ferindo três pessoas e causando danos limitados, informou a autoridade de aviação saudita, à medida que as hostilidades entre o reino e os houthis do Iêmen, apoiados pelo Irã, se intensificavam.
Os ataques ocorreram enquanto as forças governamentais iemenitas, apoiadas pela Arábia Saudita, lançavam uma grande ofensiva para retomar território dos houthis, após semanas de avanços rebeldes, com Riade intensificando os ataques aéreos em apoio à campanha.
Por outro lado, o presidente da Ucrânia, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, afirmou nesta terça-feira que as informações mais recentes sugeriam que a Rússia estava preparando um “ataque em grande escala”.
A Rússia era o terceiro maior produtor mundial de petróleo, atrás dos EUA e da Arábia Saudita, em 2025, de acordo com dados de energia dos EUA. As sanções destinadas a manter a energia russa fora dos mercados globais têm ajudado a sustentar os preços do petróleo desde que a Rússia invadiu a Ucrânia em 2022. Um acordo para pôr fim à guerra entre a Rússia e a Ucrânia poderia permitir que a Rússia exportasse mais energia.
Enquanto isso, nos EUA, o Centro Nacional de Furacões informou que há 100% de chance de um ciclone se formar nos próximos sete dias no Golfo do México. Uma tempestade na região poderia elevar os preços do petróleo ao interromper a produção de petróleo e gás natural e causar danos a outras infraestruturas energéticas.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A exportação de soja do Brasil deve alcançar 6,18 milhões de toneladas em outubro, ante 6,40 milhões t no mesmo período do ano passado, previu nesta terça-feira a Associação Nacional dos Exportadores de Cereais (Anec).
items.body:
A exportação de soja do Brasil deve alcançar 6,18 milhões de toneladas em outubro, ante 6,40 milhões t no mesmo período do ano passado, previu nesta terça-feira a Associação Nacional dos Exportadores de Cereais (Anec).
Da mesma forma, os embarques de milho do Brasil devem recuar para 5,34 milhões neste mês, versus 5,69 milhões no mesmo período do ano passado, de acordo com a primeira projeção da associação para o outubro.
Por outro lado, as exportações de sorgo do Brasil, que são impulsionadas por embarques para a [USN:L1N44H0MF TEXT:"China"] em 2026 após um acordo entre os países, foram estimadas em 1,439 milhão de toneladas em outubro.
Nos dois meses anteriores, as exportações de sorgo brasileiro já tinham sido fortes, somando no ano quase 2,5 milhões de toneladas, contra nenhum volume visto em 2025, segundo dados da Anec.
A exportação de farelo de soja do Brasil, por sua vez, deve alcançar 2,09 milhões de toneladas em outubro, ante 1,73 milhão no mesmo período do ano passado, apontou a associação.

items.title: Kalshi launches perpetual futures tied to US 500 stock index
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Kalshi has introduced a new perpetual futures contract that is linked to its US 500 index. This contract will allow traders to hold positions indefinitely, without the need to roll over. It aims to provide stock market exposure, a key step in Kalshi's expansion as a financial exchange. The CEO mentioned leveraging long or short positions on the stock index.
items.body: Prediction-market startup Kalshi launched a perpetual futures contract linked to a US stock index on Tuesday, expanding into a nascent derivatives market as it seeks to compete with traditional exchange operators, according to a Reuters report.The contract tracks Kalshi’s US 500 index, which comprises 500 of the largest US companies, the company said.Perpetual futures, commonly called “perps,” do not have an expiration date, allowing traders to hold positions indefinitely without having to roll over contracts.Kalshi said periodic funding payments between traders holding long and short positions will help keep the contract’s price aligned with the underlying index.The company, best known for allowing users to trade on the outcomes of events such as elections and sporting contests, said the product will enable investors to take leveraged long or short positions on the stock index, Reuters reported.Kalshi filed plans for the product with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission in August.“Stock market exposure is the next step towards Kalshi becoming a full-service financial exchange, and perps are the best way for our traders to get this exposure,” CEO Tarek Mansour said in a statement.Kalshi is also preparing to seek US regulatory approval for a perpetual futures contract linked to West Texas Intermediate crude oil, Reuters reported last month. The move forms part of the company’s effort to expand beyond cryptocurrency and metals.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

items.title: Report: Formula 1 returning to Africa in 2030
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Formula 1 is set to return to Africa with a race in Rwanda in 2030, RacingNews365 reported on Tuesday.
items.body:
Formula 1 is set to return to Africa with a race in Rwanda in 2030, RacingNews365 reported on Tuesday.
An agreement has been reached and an official announcement could come later this year, per the report.
Despite attempts from local organizers, F1 hasn't raced on the continent since the 1993 South African Grand Prix.
Rwandan president Paul Kagame announced his country's intention to bid for an F1 race back in 2024.
The F1 community was initially skeptical since Rwanda doesn't currently have a racing circuit capable of hosting a major motorsports event. However, there are plans to build a permanent facility just outside the capital city of Kigali, per the report.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Votação do PL ao Senado superou a de Flávio porque eleitor pôde votar em dois nomes do partido
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Uma publicação que circula nas redes sociais engana ao sugerir que há algo suspeito no fato de a soma de votos nos candidatos do PL ao Senado ser maior do que o número de votos recebidos por Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato a presidente pelo mesmo partido.
items.body:
Uma publicação que circula nas redes sociais engana ao sugerir que há algo suspeito no fato de a soma de votos nos candidatos do PL ao Senado ser maior do que o número de votos recebidos por Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato a presidente pelo mesmo partido.
Estes são os principais pontos:
“A conta não fecha: somente os senadores do PL tiveram 58.123.987 votos. Flávio Bolsonaro teve 56.076.888 votos. Quem vota nos senadores do PL e não vota no Flávio do PL?”, dizem os posts.
Com 100% das urnas apuradas, Flávio teve 56.104.503, segundo dados da Justiça Eleitoral . Já os 33 candidatos ao Senado pelo PL somaram 58.307.861 votos, considerando eleitos e não eleitos.
Neste ano, cada eleitor escolheu dois senadores --ou seja, cada pessoa deu apenas um voto para presidente, mas pôde votar duas vezes para o Senado.
Em sete Estados ( Goiás , Mato Grosso do Sul , Rio de Janeiro , Rondônia , Roraima , Santa Catarina e Sergipe ) e no Distrito Federal , o PL lançou mais de uma candidatura ao Senado.
Por isso, nestes locais, o mesmo eleitor pôde dar dois votos ao PL na disputa pelo Senado, mas apenas um para Flávio, o que explica a diferença no total de votos.
Veredicto: Enganoso. A soma dos votos de senadores do PL foi superior ao total de votos de Flávio porque os eleitores puderam votar em dois candidatos ao Senado, e o partido lançou mais de um nome ao cargo em oito unidades da federação.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.title: Report: Ravens TE Durham Smythe (Achilles) out for season
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Baltimore Ravens tight end Durham Smythe will miss the remainder of the season after sustaining a torn Achilles, NFL Network reported on Tuesday.
items.body:
Baltimore Ravens tight end Durham Smythe will miss the remainder of the season after sustaining a torn Achilles, NFL Network reported on Tuesday.
An MRI confirmed the severity of the injury, which occurred during Sunday's 24-18 victory against the visiting Tennessee Titans.
Smythe, 31, is primarily deployed as a blocker and has one catch for 4 yards while playing in four games (all starts) this season with Baltimore.
He has 137 receptions for 1,257 yards and three touchdowns in 133 career games (80 starts) with the Miami Dolphins (2018-24), Chicago Bears (2025) and Ravens. He was selected by the Dolphins in the fourth round of the 2018 NFL Draft out of Notre Dame.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Trump says he is thinking about suspending federal gas tax
items.author: Nandita Bose, Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Nandita Bose, Kanishka Singh
items.summary: President Donald Trump said on Tuesday he was thinking about suspending the federal gas tax as high gas and diesel prices pose a risk to his Republican Party heading into the November midterm US elections.
items.body:
President Donald Trump said on Tuesday he was thinking about suspending the federal gas tax as high gas and diesel prices pose a risk to his Republican Party heading into the November midterm US elections .
DETAILS AND QUOTES: "We're thinking about that," Trump said when asked if the federal gas tax should be suspended, without providing more details.
Trump has also [USN:S0N41B038 TEXT:"previously expressed support"] for suspending the US gas tax in recent months.
Trump's comments came a day after he [USN:L1N45R0NK TEXT:"signed an executive order"] to expand access to tax-exempt diesel that he unveiled from a rally stage in Nebraska.
High gas and diesel prices are a risk to Trump ahead of the midterm elections in which control of Congress is at stake.
Republicans currently hold a narrow majority in the Senate and House of Representatives.
Waiving the 18.4-cent federal gasoline tax requires Congress to pass legislation.
Fuel prices have risen in response to the US-Israeli war on Iran and the Russian invasion of Ukraine , with the conflicts having led to attacks on refineries in the Middle East and Russia.
Trump's approval rating has held at [USN:L6N45R122 TEXT:"a record low"] 32% in recent days, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll completed on Monday, with Americans most concerned about the high cost of living, spurred by soaring gasoline and diesel prices.

items.title: Ronaldo accuses coach Jesus of broken promises but leaves Portugal return open
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has accused Portugal coach Jorge Jesus of twice breaking his word, saying a failed agreement to publicly explain his omission against Norway drove him out of the camp but insisting he remained available after any punishment.
items.body:
Cristiano Ronaldo has accused Portugal coach Jorge Jesus of twice breaking his word, saying a failed agreement to publicly explain his omission against Norway [USN:L6N45M14A TEXT:"drove him out"] of the camp but insisting he remained available after any punishment.
In a lengthy statement, the 41-year-old gave his account of the dispute that prompted his departure from Copenhagen before Portugal's Nations League match versus Denmark last week.
Ronaldo said Jesus had agreed a plan under which the forward would miss the Norway and Denmark matches to manage his fitness. However, on the day of the Norway game, the coach told him he would play for 30 minutes.
"Everyone knows the rest. I warmed up from halftime onwards, watched the minutes tick by and wasn't called on," Ronaldo said.
"The manager had broken his word to me."
Portugal's captain and all-time leading scorer said a subsequent meeting with Jesus, attended by his club side Al Nassr's sporting director Simao Coutinho, produced an agreement for the coach to clarify events at his next press conference.
According to Ronaldo, an eight-point document was prepared saying he had never demanded playing time, had respected Jesus' decisions and that the coach asking him to warm up without bringing him on had been a mistake.
Ronaldo said the agreed notes did not require Jesus to apologise to him but said the coach's public remarks bore no resemblance to their private discussion.
"It was the second time he had broken his word to me," Ronaldo said. "I decided to leave the training camp without waiting for any further broken promises."
The statement provided Ronaldo's account but on Sunday, after Portugal's win over Norway, Jesus denied he had made any agreement with the player but [USN:L1N45R00Y TEXT:"left the door open"] for his return.
The Portuguese Football Federation (FPF) did not immediately respond to a request for comment about Ronaldo's statement.
Ronaldo apologised for failing to greet supporters after the Norway match and for leaving his team mates, accepting that his captaincy made his conduct more serious.
"The consequences of my actions must be assessed and punished by the Portuguese Football Federation," he said.
Despite the rupture, Ronaldo said he was not limiting his international ambitions to a farewell appearance.
"If I'm physically fit, playing for my club – scoring goals, I hope – after serving whatever suspension is imposed on me, I'll be available, as I've always been until now, to compete and win for our national team," he added.

"The consequences of my actions must be assessed and punished by the Portuguese Football Federation," he said.
Despite the rupture, Ronaldo said he was not limiting his international ambitions to a farewell appearance.
"If I'm physically fit, playing for my club – scoring goals, I hope – after serving whatever suspension is imposed on me, I'll be available, as I've always been until now, to compete and win for our national team," he added.

items.title: IGet registra queda nas vendas no varejo em setembro
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: As vendas no comércio brasileiro encolheram 3,7% em setembro ante o mesmo mês do ano passado, de acordo com o indicador IGet, desenvolvido pelo Santander Brasil em parceria com a Getnet, empresa de pagamentos do grupo espanhol.
items.body:
As vendas no comércio brasileiro encolheram 3,7% em setembro ante o mesmo mês do ano passado, de acordo com o indicador IGet, desenvolvido pelo Santander Brasil em parceria com a Getnet, empresa de pagamentos do grupo espanhol.
Em relação ao mês de agosto, o IGet Varejo Ampliado recuou 1,6%. Quando excluídos os segmentos de materiais de construção e de automóveis, partes e peças (IGet Restrito), houve queda de 11,3% ano a ano e de 1,6% na base mensal.
A pesquisa também mostrou retração dos serviços prestados às famílias, após dois meses consecutivos de recuperação. Na comparação com o mesmo mês do ano anterior, houve recuo de 3,6% e, em relação a agosto, foi registrada queda de 2,9%.
"O resultado de setembro reforça nossa leitura de moderação da atividade no segundo semestre, com sinais mais claros de perda de dinamismo tanto nos serviços quanto no consumo de bens", disse o economista Rodolfo Pavan, que assina o relatório.

items.title: Anthropic pone sus modelos de IA más potentes a disposición de más equipos de seguridad
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Anthropic está ampliando un programa que permite a profesionales de la ciberseguridad debidamente acreditados probar sus modelos de IA más potentes con menos medidas de seguridad, después de que su iniciativa "Project Glasswing" ayudara a descubrir más de 100.000 vulnerabilidades de software este año.
items.body:
Anthropic está ampliando un programa que permite a profesionales de la ciberseguridad debidamente acreditados probar sus modelos de IA más potentes con menos medidas de seguridad, después de que su iniciativa "Project Glasswing" ayudara a descubrir más de 100.000 vulnerabilidades de software este año.
Sus socios en el marco de Glasswing, una iniciativa destinada a proteger el software más crítico del mundo, detectaron al menos 129.000 vulnerabilidades verificadas entre abril y julio. El propio escáner de código abierto de Anthropic detectó otras 5.500 entre abril y octubre.
Hasta la fecha, más de 33.000 han sido clasificadas como críticas o de gravedad alta.
Anthropic ha señalado que es probable que estas cifras estén por debajo de la realidad y espera que el impacto real sea al menos cinco veces mayor, ya que los datos proceden de una encuesta realizada a un número limitado de socios.
El renovado Programa de Verificación Cibernética (CVP, por sus siglas en inglés), anunciado el martes, combina dos programas que Anthropic ha llevado a cabo durante los últimos seis meses.
El primero, Glasswing, ofrecía a las organizaciones encargadas de proteger software crítico acceso a Claude Mythos, la familia de modelos de Anthropic con mayor capacidad cibernética. El segundo, el CVP original, proporcionaba a equipos de seguridad acreditados un acceso con restricciones a los modelos Claude Opus y Sonnet.
La presentación en abril por parte de la empresa de la versión preliminar de Claude Mythos suscitó el temor de que la inteligencia artificial pudiera piratear el software antes de que este hubiera sido protegido.
El nuevo programa cuenta con tres niveles, cada uno con sus propios requisitos de verificación y controles de seguridad. Los tres incluyen acceso a Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Mythos 5.1 y futuros modelos.
El nivel "Defensa" abarca tareas como la respuesta a incidentes y el análisis de malware. Pueden solicitarlo equipos de seguridad, operadores de infraestructura crítica, responsables del mantenimiento de software de código abierto e investigadores con un historial de vulnerabilidades notificadas.
El nivel "Red Team" añade pruebas de penetración autorizadas y simulacros de ataque, pero solo pueden solicitarlo las organizaciones.
El nivel "Specialized" es el que presenta menos restricciones y está reservado a un pequeño grupo de organizaciones autorizadas para probar sistemas críticos para la seguridad, como redes eléctricas, sistemas de vuelo e infraestructuras de transferencias interbancarias.
Anthropic evalúa a cada miembro junto con el Gobierno de Estados Unidos, y los miembros actuales de Glasswing pasarán a formar parte de este nivel.

items.title: 加州共和党員からも批判、トランプ氏がイランによるロスなど「破壊」の可能性示唆
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Steve Gorman　Bo Erickson

[ロサンゼルス ５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Steve Gorman　Bo Erickson

[ロサンゼルス ５日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が、ロサンゼルスやサンディエゴなどの米主要都市がイランによって「破壊」され得ると発言したことを受け、カリフォルニア州の民主党指導者らに加え、一部共和党員からも批判の声が上がっている。

トランプ大統領は５日、ネブラスカ州で開いた集会で、イランとの戦争に伴うエネルギー価格などの高騰について「小さな代償」だとして自身の政策を擁護。ロサンゼルスやサンディエゴを引き合いに出し、「彼らは都市を壊滅させることもできる」とし、経済的犠牲を「世界と米国の安全を守るための代償としては小さいものだ」と述べた。

また、イランとの戦争は「実質的にはほぼ終わっている」とした上で、「間もなく終わるだろうし、いずれにせよ終わるだろう」とした。

民主党の牙城であるカリフォルニア州の都市に言及した発言を受け、同州のニューサム知事（民主）はＸへの投稿で、「カリフォルニアを占領するために州兵と海兵隊を派遣した後、今度は外国の敵がロサンゼルスとサンディエゴを『破壊すべきだ』と言っている」と批判。「トランプ大統領は常軌を逸しており、危険だ」と非難した。

ロサンゼルスのバス市長（民主）も声明で、トランプ大統領の発言は「われわれの安全を脅かしかねない」と述べた。

１１月の中間選挙の下院選に出馬している共和党のデズモンド候補はＸへの投稿で、「トランプ大統領の発言に断固として反対する。米国はイランに立ち向かい、国益を守らなければならない。しかし、最高司令官の第一の責務は米国民と祖国を守ることだ」と述べた。

共和党と連携する無所属のカイリー下院議員も声明で、トランプ氏の発言は建設的ではないとの見方を示した。

ホワイトハウスのチャン広報部長はこうした批判を一蹴。ソーシャルメディアへの投稿で、「トランプ大統領の発言を巡るメディアの過剰反応は現実に基づいていない。大統領は、核武装したイランを阻止していなければ、米都市が脅威にさらされていたと明確にしたのだ」と述べた。

items.title: Cornell hires ex-Justice Dept official Yates to review rape claims response
items.author: Karen Sloan
items.creator: Karen Sloan
items.summary: Cornell University has hired a top former US Justice Department lawyer for an internal investigation of how it handled a student's allegations that she was gang-raped, a case that has brought mounting scrutiny and triggered student protests at the Ivy League school.
items.body:
Cornell University has hired a top former US Justice Department lawyer for an internal investigation of how it handled a student's allegations that she was gang-raped, a case that has brought mounting scrutiny and triggered student protests at the Ivy League school.
Sally Yates, who served as deputy US attorney general from 2015 to 2017, will conduct an independent review of how Cornell prevents and responds to sexual assault claims, university officials said on Tuesday.
The investigation by Yates, now a partner at law firm King & Spalding, will include a “detailed review” of Cornell’s response to the student's claims that she was sexually assaulted by multiple men during a fraternity party in October 2024.
The student, referred to as Jane Doe in a lawsuit she filed against Cornell and seven fraternity members, has said the Ithaca, New York university failed to adequately investigate and punish the fraternity members involved.
Other Cornell students staged a mass rally on Monday voicing solidarity with Jane Doe and [USN:L1N45R111 TEXT:"demanding"] that the school take firmer action against sexual violence on campus.
A newly formed Special Committee of the Cornell University Board of Trustees said Yates will have “full independence” to conduct her review.
A lawyer for Jane Doe, Thomas Giuffra, did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Tuesday about the investigation.
Yates was previously hired by the US Soccer Federation to [USN:L1N3141TA TEXT:"investigate"] allegations of sexual abuse and misconduct within the National Women's Soccer League.
'DEFINING MOMENT' Cornell University President Michael Kotlikoff on October 3 [USN:L1N45P06O TEXT:"called"] the alleged sexual assault case a “defining moment” and said the university "must do better."
In her lawsuit, filed last month, Jane Doe said she was plied with drugs and alcohol and then sexually assaulted by several members of the campus chapter of the Chi Phi fraternity in October 2024 after she had become incapacitated.
She had reported the alleged assault to police several weeks after the fact, leading to an internal university investigation and a law enforcement probe, but the local prosecutor declined to bring criminal charges.
Cornell, which has defended its response to the original report, shut down the Chi Phi chapter and imposed a range of discipline on the fraternity members involved, including expulsions and other sanctions.

items.title: Chilena Codelco crea gerencia para manejar integración de mina Andina con Los Bronces de Anglo American
items.author: Fabián Andrés Cambero
items.creator: Fabián Andrés Cambero
items.summary: La estatal chilena Codelco decidió ajustar su estructura y crear una nueva gerencia que se encargará del proceso de integración de su mina de cobre Andina con la vecina Los Bronces, de la global Anglo American, de acuerdo a un documento visto el martes por Reuters.
items.body:
La estatal chilena Codelco decidió ajustar su estructura y crear una nueva gerencia que se encargará del proceso de integración de su mina de cobre Andina con la vecina Los Bronces, de la global Anglo American, de acuerdo a un documento visto el martes por Reuters.
A fines de junio, las mineras informaron que [USN:L6N42W0U1 TEXT:"sellaron el acuerdo definitivo"] para operar de forma conjunta los yacimientos enclavados en la Cordillera de Los Andes, al nororiente de la capital Santiago, con planes para sumar en promedio unas 120.000 toneladas métricas de cobre al año entre 2030 y 2051.
Desde inicios de septiembre, la estatal eliminó la vicepresidencia de Integración para el proyecto.
La nueva Gerencia de Integración Operaciones Andina debe "liderar la gestión operativa del Plan Minero Conjunto en el distrito Andina-Los Bronces, asegurando la coordinación efectiva entre todas las áreas de Codelco involucradas en el proyecto", contempla la resolución firmada por el presidente ejecutivo, Jorge Gómez.
En la nueva gerencia designó a Claudia Monreal López desde el 27 de octubre.
De acuerdo a documentos obtenidos por Reuters, las empresas planean presentar en diciembre [USN:L6N40Y0YB TEXT:"dos solicitudes separadas de permiso ambiental"] para avanzar con la iniciativa que afirman generaría al menos 5.000 millones de dólares en valor adicional antes de impuestos para ambas compañías, como resultado de las sinergias.

items.title: Exportação café do Brasil em setembro tem maior volume em 20 meses, aponta Secex
items.author: Roberto Samora
items.creator: Roberto Samora
items.summary: A exportação de café verde do Brasil em setembro somou 235,8 mil toneladas, ou 3,93 milhões de sacas de 60 kg, marcando o maior volume de embarques do país em 20 meses, de acordo com dados da Secretaria de Comércio Exterior (Secex), publicados nesta terça-feira.
items.body:
A exportação de café verde do Brasil em setembro somou 235,8 mil toneladas, ou 3,93 milhões de sacas de 60 kg, marcando o maior volume de embarques do país em 20 meses, de acordo com dados da Secretaria de Comércio Exterior (Secex), publicados nesta terça-feira.
As vendas externas do Brasil no mês passado saltaram 20,4% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025, com o Brasil escoando volumes de uma safra estimada em um [USN:L1N45G0FN TEXT:"recorde"].
Em setembro, com a colheita já finalizada após chuvas atípicas de inverno atrasarem os trabalhos, os exportadores já puderam contar com grãos da nova safra.
As exportações de café renderam ao país US$1,29 bilhão em setembro, aumento de 8,7% no comparativo anual, com os maiores volumes mais do que compensando uma queda de 9,8% no preço médio, segundo dados da Secex.
Em termos de divisas, o café só fica atrás da soja nas exportações agropecuárias de produtos in natura.
A soja, apesar de setembro já não ser um mês de pico de exportação, gerou divisas de US$3,47 bilhões, aumento de 11,9% na comparação anual. Já os embarques da oleaginosa ficaram praticamente estáveis no mês passado, a 7,36 milhões de toneladas.
O milho, por outro lado, registrou recuo de embarques de mais de 30% em setembro, para 5,2 milhões de toneladas, com o mercado interno demandando cada vez mais devido à expansão da indústria de etanol e também pela maior competitividade das exportações argentinas.
Já a exportações de carne bovina in natura do Brasil, maior exportador mundial, despencaram 38% na comparação com o mesmo período do ano passado, para 195,2 mil toneladas, principalmente por conta do fim da cota da China com tarifa menor.
Além disso, desde o início de setembro as vendas para a União Europeia ficaram suspensas após o Brasil ficar fora de uma lista de países habilitados a exportar, devido a exigências da UE sobre antimicrobianos.

items.title: Brasil bate recorde histórico de exportação de petróleo em setembro com produção em alta
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: As exportações de petróleo do Brasil atingiram recorde histórico em setembro, somando 11,7 milhões de toneladas, impulsionadas pelo aumento da produção nacional e por uma demanda internacional aquecida, mostraram dados da Secretaria de Comércio Exterior (Secex) divulgados nesta terça-feira.
items.body:
As exportações de petróleo do Brasil atingiram recorde histórico em setembro, somando 11,7 milhões de toneladas, impulsionadas pelo aumento da produção nacional e por uma demanda internacional aquecida, mostraram dados da Secretaria de Comércio Exterior (Secex) divulgados nesta terça-feira.
O recorde confirma a tendência já apontada por [USN:L6N45K15K TEXT:"dados preliminares"], conforme reportagem da Reuters.
O volume embarcado superou o recorde anterior de 11 milhões de toneladas, registrado em março de 2023, marcando o maior patamar mensal já observado na série da Secex.
Na comparação com setembro de 2025, as exportações avançaram 42,2% em volume, enquanto a receita com as vendas externas de petróleo saltou 77,3%, para cerca de US$6,5 bilhões.
O desempenho foi sustentado por uma combinação de produção recorde no Brasil e preços mais elevados no mercado internacional.
Segundo a Secex, o preço médio de exportação do petróleo brasileiro alcançou US$556 por tonelada em setembro, alta de 24,7% sobre um ano antes.
Os embarques também foram beneficiados por um mercado internacional mais apertado. As tensões envolvendo o Irã e os riscos ao fluxo de petróleo e combustíveis pelo Estreito de Ormuz impulsionaram os preços globais da commodity e favoreceram fornecedores alternativos, incluindo o Brasil.
A produção brasileira de petróleo tem sido sustentada pelo avanço dos campos do pré-sal, especialmente Búzios e Mero, na Bacia de Santos. Em agosto, a produção nacional já [USN:L6N45N0VE TEXT:"alcançou recorde"] pelo terceiro mês consecutivo, segundo a Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP).

items.title: México dará prioridad a endeudamiento en moneda local: secretario Hacienda
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: México dará prioridad al endeudamiento en moneda local a tasas fijas y plazos de vencimiento largos para reducir la exposición a las fluctuaciones de las tasas de interés y los tipos de cambio, dijo el martes el secretario de Hacienda del país, Edgar Amador.
items.body:
México dará prioridad al endeudamiento en moneda local a tasas fijas y plazos de vencimiento largos para reducir la exposición a las fluctuaciones de las tasas de interés y los tipos de cambio, dijo el martes el secretario de Hacienda del país, Edgar Amador.
En su intervención sobre el presupuesto del 2027 ante los legisladores, Amador afirmó que "el 79% de la deuda estará denominada en moneda local y, en su mayoría, a tipos de interés fijos y con vencimientos a largo plazo".

O risco real de sofrer uma derrota na eleição deste ano, depois de terminar o primeiro turno atrás de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), levou o PT a rever suas estratégias de comunicação na campanha do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, e a aposta no segundo turno é mostrar que programas e benefícios hoje dados como garantidos podem desaparecer com a eleição do candidato de oposição.
A "estratégia do medo", como vem sendo chamada internamente por aliados de Lula, parte de uma fala feita pelo próprio presidente, na noite de segunda-feira, em uma reunião com aliados em um hotel em Brasília. No primeiro encontro da legenda depois de um primeiro turno frustrante, Lula deixou claro que a intenção é enfatizar os riscos para a vida das pessoas que representaria a eleição de seu oponente, contaram fontes presentes à conversa, que pediram anonimato.
A mudança de tática já começou a ser colocada em prática. Nesta terça, uma peça do PT começou a circular nas redes sociais afirmando que "algumas perdas não têm volta", enquanto bilhetinhos com nomes de programas sociais do governo Lula, como Pé de Meia e Mais Médicos -- além do reajuste real das aposentadorias -- voam de uma mão aberta.
O PT busca conquistar eleitores que votaram em outros candidatos no primeiro turno, mas também quer convencer aqueles que não votaram a ir às urnas. A abstenção este ano bateu mais um recorde, chegando a 33 milhões de pessoas. A avaliação é que muitas dessas pessoas não foram votar por desânimo e por não ter preferência por nenhum candidato, mas podem se animar agora para assegurar a manutenção de programas sociais.
No primeiro turno, no domingo, Lula teve 45,16% dos votos válidos, somando 53,9 milhões de votos, enquanto Flávio Bolsonaro obteve 47,03%, com 56,1 milhões de votos.
Procurada, a assessoria da campanha de Flávio não respondeu de imediato a pedido de comentário sobre as acusações do adversário.
Em recente entrevista, o senador disse que, se eleito, vai manter o Bolsa Família e também já disse que vai garantir o reajuste de 15% anunciado por Lula para o programa a poucos dias do primeiro turno eleitoral.
MEA-CULPA NA COMUNICAÇÃO Para além da mensagem, o mea-culpa petista também passa pela forma de comunicar. Fontes contaram à Reuters que o próprio presidente está desgostoso com a eficácia da comunicação e se queixou que a campanha falhou ao tentar se comunicar com jovens e mulheres, e que muita coisa precisa ser mudada.
Nas discussões internas do PT, aparece um culpado: o ministro da Secretaria de Comunicação da Presidência, Sidônio Palmeira, de acordo com as fontes. O publicitário, que fez a campanha de Lula em 2022, não está efetivamente à frente este ano, mas é seu sócio, Raul Rebelo, que comanda a comunicação da campanha, e Sidônio participa efetivamente das decisões.
A parcela de culpa de Sidônio, dizem fontes, passa pelos discursos de Lula centrados em questões como soberania e minerais críticos, que são considerados temas inacessíveis para boa parte da população. Aliados apontam, por exemplo, que um programa de TV inteiro foi feito sobre terras raras.
Não se fala ainda efetivamente em substituir Rebelo, mas o publicitário Otávio Antunes, que fez a campanha de Fernando Haddad em São Paulo, deve se juntar à comunicação nacional, segundo as fontes. Considerado mais agressivo no seu estilo, Antunes ajudou Haddad a ter a maior votação do PT para o governo do Estado em São Paulo na história, mesmo com o ex-ministro tendo perdido no primeiro turno, o que já era esperado.
PAPEL DE LULA A mudança, no entanto, também passa pelo próprio Lula. Aliados afirmam que é preciso mudar a fala do presidente e também sua forma de se comunicar. Há uma crescente cobrança para um uso melhor e mais intenso das redes sociais, algo que Lula resiste.
Na reunião de segunda, circulou entre os presentes um vídeo feito para o Instagram por Ana Elisa Silva, eleita deputada federal pelo PT em Minas Gerais com mais de meio milhão de votos. No vídeo, Ana Elisa, de 21 anos, aponta que todos os 10 deputados federais mais votados do país, ela inclusive, baseiam suas estratégias de comunicação nas redes sociais.
"É o momento de deixarmos realmente a ignorância de lado, calçarmos a sandália da humildade e entendermos que com a rede social a gente precisa sim aprender. Não é que não é importante ir para as ruas, é entender que não existe mais separação de redes e ruas. Quem está nas ruas está nas redes", disse a deputada eleita em um vídeo que já teve quase 6 milhões de curtidas e 150 mil compartilhamentos.
Paulo Okamotto, um dos coordenadores da campanha de Lula, afirmou que a campanha vai intensificar o trabalho com influenciadores de esquerda, e a ideia, disse, é montar uma rede com vários nomes que estão se oferecendo para ajudar o partido.
A estratégia de redes, no entanto, esbarra no próprio presidente. Aos 80 anos, Lula nem mesmo carrega consigo um celular, e vive criticando o fato de as pessoas estarem sempre olhando para telas.
Em uma de suas falas na reunião de segunda-feira, Lula disse que vai fazer mais "selfies" -- como chama os vídeos para as redes -- mas ressaltou que também quer falar mais para rádios neste segundo turno.

Oct 6 : Anthropic is expanding a program that allows vetted cybersecurity professionals to test its most powerful AI models with fewer safeguards, after its Project Glasswing initiative helped uncover more than 100,000 software vulnerabilities this year.
Its partners under Glasswing, an initiative aimed at securing the world's most critical software, found at least 129,000 verified vulnerabilities between April and July. Anthropic's own open-source scanning found 5,500 more between April and October.
More than 33,000 have so far been rated critical or high severity.
Anthropic said the figures are likely an undercount and expects the true impact to be at least five times higher, as the data comes from a survey of a limited number of partners.

The revamped Cyber Verification Program, or CVP, announced on Tuesday combines two programs Anthropic has run for the past six months.
The first, Glasswing, gave organizations securing critical software access to Claude Mythos, Anthropic's most cyber-capable family of models. The second, the original CVP, gave vetted security teams reduced safeguards on Claude Opus and Sonnet models.
The company's April unveiling of Claude Mythos Preview raised fears that AI could hack software before it had been secured. 
The new program has three tiers, each with its own verification requirements and security controls. All three include access to Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Mythos 5.1 and future models.
The Defense tier covers work such as incident response and malware analysis. Security teams, critical infrastructure operators, open-source maintainers and researchers with a record of reported vulnerabilities can apply.
The Red Team tier adds authorized penetration testing and red-teaming, but only organizations can apply.
The Specialized tier has the fewest restrictions and is reserved for a small group of organizations authorized to test safety-critical systems such as power grids, flight systems and interbank transfer infrastructure. 
Anthropic vets each member together with the US government, and existing Glasswing members will move into this tier.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Cury não declarou apoio no 2º turno; fala sobre vitória de Lula é anterior ao 1º turno
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: O candidato a presidente Augusto Cury (Avante) não declarou até o momento apoio a Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) ou Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), que avançaram para o segundo turno da disputa presidencial. Uma fala de Cury sobre uma vitória do petista é anterior à votação do último domingo.
items.body:
O candidato a presidente Augusto Cury (Avante) não declarou até o momento apoio a Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) ou Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), que avançaram para o segundo turno da disputa presidencial. Uma fala de Cury sobre uma vitória do petista é anterior à votação do último domingo.
"'Ele vai trucidar': Augusto Cury prevê vitória de Lula e descarta apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno", afirmam posts no Instagram e no Threads. "Seja bem-vindo, companheiro! Que a luta contra o lixo fascista nos una! 'Bora' para a luta!", diz a legenda de um deles.
No entanto, a declaração de Cury sobre “trucidar” é de uma sabatina da revista Veja no final de setembro.
"O modelo de Lula da Silva está falido. O modelo de Flávio Bolsonaro também. Se o pai perdeu, o filho também vai perder. E tudo que o Lula quer é pegar Flávio Bolsonaro no segundo turno. Ele vai trucidar, ele vai destruir Flávio", disse.
Na noite de domingo, antes da confirmação do segundo turno entre Flávio e Lula, Cury afirmou à imprensa que não apoiaria nenhum candidato na etapa seguinte.
“Eu me silencio completamente em relação àqueles que estarão no segundo turno, se é que vai haver segundo turno, e dizendo o seguinte, que ninguém está autorizado em meu nome... a pedir ou dizer que vai apoiar qualquer um dos candidatos. E eu gostaria de me silenciar em relação a isso”, disse.
Procurada, a assessoria de Cury não respondeu a um pedido de comentário até a publicação deste texto.
Flávio teve 56,1 milhões de votos (47,03% dos votos válidos), e Lula recebeu 53,8 milhões (45,16%), segundo a Justiça Eleitoral . Cury ficou em terceiro lugar, com 3,4 milhões de votos (2,89%). O segundo turno ocorre no próximo dia 25.
VEREDICTO Enganoso. Augusto Cury não declarou apoio a nenhum dos dois candidatos do segundo turno, e sua fala sobre uma eventual vitória de Lula foi feita antes do primeiro turno.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.title: 'I'm getting fed up': voters line up before dawn as early voting begins in Ohio
items.author: Richard Cowan
items.creator: Richard Cowan
items.summary: Registered Republicans, Democrats and independents expressed that they are exhausted by political ads they see as deceptive and mean, they hate the US war with Iran and they really hate the inflation that has become chronic.
items.body:
Voters started lining up while it was still dark on Tuesday morning at the Medina County Board of Elections on first day of early voting in Ohio, a state that looms large in the nationwide campaigns between Republicans and Democrats battling for control of the US Congress.
If this biennial midterm election is similar to years past, voter turnout will be lower than in the presidential elections every four years.
But at least in Medina County in northeast Ohio, residents queuing at 7:15 a.m. (1115 GMT) were taking seriously their right to vote at a time when one US Senate race and two for the US House of Representatives in the state are seen as "toss-ups," according to the Cook Political Report.
Registered Republicans, Democrats and independents interviewed by Reuters all shared similar frustrations: they are exhausted by political ads they see as deceptive and mean, they hate the US war with Iran and they really hate the inflation that has become chronic.
Nobody said they expected things to improved any time soon.
Third in the line that awaited the 8 a.m. opening of the polling center was Eddie St. John, 83, who retired years ago from a career working "offshore" in Louisiana, and who lives in Wadsworth, Ohio, population around 24,700.
Asked what he most wanted to see fixed as a result of the election, which ends on November 3, St. John said, "Mostly its our economy. It sucks."
"You can't afford nothing anymore. Everything's so high. Gas is getting worse all the time," he said, adding, "This guy in office now he promises this. He promises that... (but) nothing's coming down."
"This guy," St. John said, is President Donald Trump, who isn't on the ballot. He stressed, however, that he lays blame less on political parties than "the person that's in office."
INFLATION, WAR ON BALLOT The political party out of power usually benefits in midterm elections. With Republicans holding the White House and both chambers of [USN:L6N45D0NV TEXT:"Congress at a time when Trump's approval rating"] is at a record-low 32%, Democrats are feeling increasingly competitive.
Political analysts will be watching closely what unfolds in Ohio, as Trump has been a dominant force, especially among blue-collar workers who used to align with the Democratic Party.
But with inflation running at around 3.4%, there is deep discontent over rising food, energy and housing costs.
The US war with Iran, launched by Trump on February 28 for reasons that critics say he has not clearly presented to the nation, also has voters worried that it will become yet another "forever war."
Troy Flohr, 59, a retired policeman with the Medina County Sheriff, complained about the campaign ads from all sides that he said were riddled with "half-truths."
Standing just feet away from a voting booth, Flohr said he was still undecided on whether to vote to reelect Republican Representative Max Miller for a third term, despite the fact that he generally votes for the Republican ticket. "I tend to like the rest of them" running as Republicans on this year's ballot, Flohr said.
He said his nephew is serving in the US Army and stationed in the Middle East.
Without mentioning Trump by name, Flohr said, "I'm tired of him saying the war's going to end in two weeks, the war's going to end next month...I'm getting fed up with that."
Yet Flohr said he would "probably" vote for Trump again given the chance. "I don't like where the Democrat Party has gone. I'm going to leave the rest of that comment alone," he said when asked to elaborate.
INDEPENDENTS Trump won Ohio and the state's 17 electoral votes handily in 2016, 2020 and 2024, despite losing the 2020 presidential race to Democrat Joe Biden.
This election could depend on whether disaffected Democrats return to their party and whether many independents turn their backs on Trump's Republicans.
Medina County, seen as a swing district, has 132,345 registered voters of which 29,466 are Republicans and 15,872 Democrats. Election officials say there are 86,762 independents, who could determine whether Republicans continue their success there.
Early voting, which so far was off to a vibrant start, plus mail-in ballots are seen as an early indicator of what turnout could be on the November 3 election day, according to officials.
SENATE SEAT IN PLAY Former Senator Sherrod Brown, a Democrat from Ohio, is trying to return to the Senate, where he served for 18 years before being defeated two years ago by Republican Senator Bernie Moreno.
This time around, Brown, a populist Democrat who long railed against US trade deals with foreign competitors, is attempting to unseat Republican Jon Husted in a special election with the winner holding the seat through 2028.
Political analysts see the race between Husted and Brown as a toss-up.
With Republicans currently holding a 53-47 majority in the Senate, Democrats are hoping for a net gain of at least four seats, including in Ohio, in order to control the chamber.
CLOSE HOUSE RACES Meanwhile, two neck-and-neck US House races could help determine next year's majority in that chamber, which Republicans currently hold with a 218-214 margin. One independent is aligned with Republicans and there are two vacancies that will be filled in the midterm elections.
In the 7th congressional district, which includes Medina, just south of Cleveland, incumbent Miller is seen facing a tough challenge from Democrat Brian Poindexter.
While Miller has raised far more funds than his Democratic opponent and has Trump's endorsement in a Republican-leaning district, his campaign has been hit by allegations of domestic violence, which he denies.
Poindexter is a labor union ironworker and member of a suburban city council.
Meanwhile, in Ohio's 9th congressional district that covers most of northwest Ohio and hugs the shores of Lake Erie, Democratic Representative Marcy Kaptur, a moderate who was first elected in 1982, is battling in another toss-up race against Republican challenger Derek Merrin, who nearly defeated her in 2024.
Annie Wild, 64, a retired public school teacher, said she will vote for all Democrats on the ballot. She also said since the early days of Trump's second term she has begun to see some of the president's supporters saying they are abandoning him. But that is not coming from the voters she called "MAGA."
"I've lost friends that I've had for 50 years," she said of some Trump supporters, because of the gulf between them.

items.title: Canadian power mega-deal is a twin momentum trade
items.author: Pranav Kiran
items.creator: Pranav Kiran
items.summary: Emera’s $10 bln deal for Alberta’s Canadian Utilities lets buyer and target focus on two spending waves. The power provider bulks up for data-center growth. The Southern family's selling conglomerate gets to bet on Ottawa’s Arctic sovereignty push, which looks the safer course.
items.body:
Canada’s utilities are bulking up for the AI era. Halifax-headquartered Emera (EMA.TO) is merging with Alberta’s Canadian Utilities (CU.TO) in a $10 billion all-stock deal. Both buyer and seller are betting on two different spending waves. The power provider gears up for data-center growth up North. The Southern family, which controls the target through conglomerate ATCO, is focused on Ottawa’s defense buildout. Ensuring arctic sovereignty might prove the better end of the deal.
Canadian Utilities will become a part of Emera, with the buyer’s shareholders owning 60% of the combined company. The Southern family's other businesses, which span awkwardly from oilfield trailers to military contract work, will be spun into publicly-traded New ATCO.
For Emera, the deal is a way to diversify. Despite being headquartered in Canada, hurricane-prone Florida makes up 73% of the utility’s rate base. After the combination, that number goes down to less than half. Data-center building for AI has so far been concentrated in the US and China. But massive facilities have become politically unpopular in the US, including in the Sunshine State, where a rash of local governments have passed building moratoriums that have spooked companies. It makes sense to move North, given Alberta’s ambition to spark C$100 billion in data-center investment by 2030.
For ATCO, it’s a sensible trade. The all-stock deal, though it comes with no premium, lets shareholders own a piece of an enlarged entity more capable of the heavy investment required to participate in the data-center gold rush. That holds promise for an uplift in valuation, which has stayed stubbornly flat at a bit over 10 times expected EBITDA over the next 12 months, according to LSEG. That's in line with Canadian peers, but trails some companies more exposed to the US AI buildout. Shareholders are also set to see a 20% boost in dividend payouts as part of the combined company.
Meanwhile, ATCO's sharpened focus leans in on Ottawa’s defense push. Prime Minister Mark Carney’s government wants to [USN:L1N4000V1 TEXT:"spend"] roughly $26 billion to build military airfields and support hubs while boosting Canada's Arctic defenses and reducing its reliance on the United States. Escalating trade tensions with the Trump administration have added urgency to the spending.
The global data-center buildout, which consultancy Bain reckons could involve as much as $6.5 trillion of spending by 2030, is clearly the larger opportunity, but it comes with many risks. For instance, AI clients could cut back if the promise of self-learning tech disappoints, hurting returns on heavy capital investments. By contrast, NATO allies including Canada, pressured by Russia’s war in Ukraine, have now committed to investing 5% of GDP in defense. Governments could prove more reliable customers than hyperscalers.
Follow Pranav Kiran on Bluesky and X .
Emera on October 6 said it would acquire Canadian Utilities in an all-stock deal worth C$14.3 billion ($10.02 billion).
Under the deal, Class A shareholders of Canadian Utilities, excluding controlling shareholder ATCO, will receive 0.755 Emera shares for each share they hold, while Class B shareholders will receive 0.819 Emera shares apiece.
ATCO, which holds nearly 37% of the outstanding non-voting shares and all outstanding voting shares of Canadian Utilities, will spin off into a publicly traded industrial services company called New ATCO, Emera said.
Emera shareholders are expected to own about 60% of the merged entity, which will have an enterprise value of about C$72 billion. Canadian Utilities shareholders will own about 40%, Emera said.
The deal values Canadian Utilities' Class A shares at about C$51.57 each, a premium of roughly 0.7% to the stock's last closing price on October 5, according to LSEG data.
Lazard and Scotiabank served as financial advisers to Emera, while Gordon Dyal advised ATCO and Canadian Utilities. BMO Capital Markets served as an adviser to a special committee of Canadian Utilities' board, while CIBC World Markets advised ATCO's special committee.

items.title: Kane matches Shilton's England appearance mark on milestone Wembley night
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Captain Harry Kane matched Peter Shilton's England men's record of 125 appearances when he led the side against the Czech Republic in the Nations League at Wembley on Tuesday.
items.body:
Captain Harry Kane matched Peter Shilton's England men's record of 125 appearances when he led the side against the Czech Republic in the Nations League at Wembley on Tuesday.
The latest milestone came at the stadium where Kane's England journey began more than 11 years ago.
The Bayern Munich striker, already his country's all-time leading scorer with 89 goals, made an instant impact on his 2015 debut when he came off the bench against Lithuania in a European Championship qualifier and scored 79 seconds later.
"I think it's always special, even just walking out now and seeing the stadium, just the excitement of what's to come," Kane told ITV on Tuesday. "I try and never take it for granted. It's obviously a special night tonight, but as always, we've got to focus on the job."
Kane has become one of the defining figures of the national team, breaking Wayne Rooney's scoring record and surpassing him as England's most-capped outfield player at the World Cup earlier this year.
The 33-year-old also broke Gary Lineker's England men's World Cup scoring record this past summer, drawing level on 10 with a double against Croatia, then moving clear with a goal against Panama. By the end of the tournament, Kane had extended the record to 14 World Cup goals.
Shilton, whose cap record has stood since 1990, posted a congratulatory message on X.
"You will go on and beat (the record) in November, I'm sure of that, and maybe go on and set a record that will never be beaten," he said in a video. "Because you're still going strong, Harry, still playing well and scoring goals, and I know how much dedication and hard work you've actually put into achieving this."

items.title: Chuvas podem reduzir ritmo do plantio de soja no Paraná, alerta Deral
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O plantio de soja da safra 2026/27 no Paraná pode reduzir o ritmo diante de novas chuvas previstas para o Estado, afirmou o Departamento de Economia Rural (Deral), nesta terça-feira.
items.body:
O plantio de soja da safra 2026/27 no Paraná pode reduzir o ritmo diante de novas chuvas previstas para o Estado, afirmou o Departamento de Economia Rural (Deral), nesta terça-feira.
Até segunda-feira, a semeadura no Paraná, um dos principais produtores do Brasil, havia atingido 36% da área projetada, mantendo o patamar [USN:L1N45L0OG TEXT:"mais elevado em oito safras"] para esta época.
Mas as chuvas que impulsionaram o plantio precoce agora podem dificultar a entrada das plantadeiras nos campos.
Novas precipitações deverão "limitar temporariamente o avanço da semeadura", disse o Deral. A indica volumes acima da média histórica no início da próxima semana, segundo dados meteorológicos da LSEG.
Nas áreas já semeadas, a umidade favorece o "bom desenvolvimento inicial e vegetativo, embora o excesso de umidade e a baixa luminosidade tenham dificultado o manejo inicial, especialmente as pulverizações para controle de pragas e doenças", segundo o relatório.
O Deral estima preliminarmente uma safra recorde de soja para o Estado, um dos principais produtores do Brasil, em 22,6 milhões de toneladas.
Já a colheita de trigo evoluiu para 70% da área prevista, ante 62% na semana anterior, apesar das chuvas que afetam a qualidade do cereal.
"As chuvas persistentes têm paralisado ou retardado os trabalhos e comprometido a qualidade dos grãos, especialmente nas áreas que permaneceram mais tempo expostas à elevada umidade", disse o Deral.
O órgão acrescentou que foram relatadas produtividades abaixo do esperado e predominância de classificação de menor qualidade em parte das áreas remanescentes.

items.title: Schmid de la Fed dice que es probable que la tasa de interés oficial tenga que seguir subiendo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos aún necesita subir más su tasa de interés para reducir la inflación, pero el aumento de los rendimientos a largo plazo esté lastrando la actividad en algunos sectores de la economía, dijo el martes el presidente de la Fed de Kansas City, Jeff Schmid.
items.body:
La Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos aún necesita subir más su tasa de interés para reducir la inflación, pero el aumento de los rendimientos a largo plazo esté lastrando la actividad en algunos sectores de la economía, dijo el martes el presidente de la Fed de Kansas City, Jeff Schmid.
El aumento de los rendimientos de los bonos puede estar elevando los costos del crédito y "provocando cierta debilidad en determinados sectores, pero creo que, en nuestro caso, nos centramos exclusivamente en la tasa a corto plazo y, personalmente, considero que aún nos queda trabajo", dijo Schmid en un evento económico en Oklahoma.
Este año el funcionario no tiene derecho a voto en materia de política de tasas de interés.
