Ukraine has used long-range drones to attack Russian oil refineries and depots this year in what Kyiv has described as an effort to impose greater costs on its enemy, with no end in sight more than four years since Russia's full-scale invasion.
The strikes prompted Russia to impose a ban on diesel and gasoline exports, while restricting fuel purchases in some regions hit hard by the fuel crunch.
"In effect, imports from South Korea helped Russia offset the impact of losing its own refining capacity," Vlasiuk said, citing "available data" and "reports" as sources in his post.
Earlier on Tuesday, the Guardian reported that it had analysed port records and ship-tracking data, determining that the volumes were loaded at South Korean ports onto seven tankers, some of which are under UK and EU sanctions.
Vlasiuk provided the same figures as those in the Guardian.
"This stands in stark contrast to the sanctions policy South Korea adopted following the start of the full-scale invasion," Vlasiuk said.
In response to the Guardian article, South Korea's Foreign Ministry said "the Korean government supports and actively participates in global efforts to end the war in Ukraine and achieve peaceful recovery".
It said that its government was strictly enforcing export controls against Russia by expanding the scope beyond strategic items to include "non-strategic items ... that carry a high risk of diversion for military use."
Relations between South Korea and Ukraine have been under strain for weeks.
South Korean President Lee Jae Myung threatened unspecified measures against Ukraine on Friday unless Kyiv acknowledged a confidentiality agreement that Seoul says covered the transfer of two captured North Korean soldiers.
Seoul has said it wants an apology. Ukraine denies there was a confidentiality agreement, but its foreign minister has said that Kyiv wants to mend ties with South Korea.

Source: Reuters

items.title: リトアニア、核兵器禁止条項撤廃へ　議会で第1回採決通過
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ビリニュス　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ビリニュス　６日　ロイター］ - リトアニア議会は６日、核兵器を禁じる憲法の条項撤廃提案について、１回目の投票で可決した。議員１４１のうち１０６人が賛成票を投じ、可決に必要な３分の２以上の賛成を確保した。条項撤廃には２回目の投票でも３分の２以上の賛成が必要となり、来年１月１２日に採決が予定されている。

禁止条項はリトアニアが旧ソ連から独立して以降、３０年以上維持されてきた。ロシアによるウクライナへの全面侵攻などを経て、バルト３国などの安全保障上の前提が変化していることが示された形となった。

リトアニアのナウセーダ大統領は、国内に核兵器を配備する計画は当面ないものの、条項撤廃により安全保障環境が変化した場合には対応できるようになると説明。各党が禁止条項の撤廃案で合意したと述べていた。ナウセーダ氏は７月、リトアニアが引き続き核拡散防止条約（ＮＰＴ）の締約国にとどまることも表明している。

items.title: 仏、最新弾道ミサイル初試験発射　ロシアとの緊張で核抑止力向上
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
John Irish

［パリ　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
John Irish

［パリ　６日　ロイター］ - フランス国防省は６日、最新の潜水艦発射弾道ミサイル「Ｍ５１．３」の初めての発射試験を行ったと発表した。２０２５年１０月に配備され、射程は９０００キロ以上と推定されている。ロシアとの緊張が高まる中、核戦力を近代化することで抑止力を向上する戦略の一環となる。

マクロン大統領は「われわれがより強くなったというメッセージが明確に伝えられた」と、発射を見守る自身の動画と共にＸに投稿した。弾道ミサイルは、整備を終了した原子力潜水艦の能力を確認する作戦の一部としてブルターニュ沖から発射された。国防省は国際法を順守して実施したと説明している。

ロシアのプーチン大統領は先週、西側諸国に対し、ウクライナを巡る対立を深めないよう警告。ポーランドとリトアニアに挟まれたロシアの飛び地カリーニングラードを防衛するため、必要であれば核兵器を用いる意向を明らかにした。北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）は「いかなる活動も、ロシアの領土への脅威とはならない」と主張。プーチン氏も、欧州諸国を攻撃する計画はないとの意向を示している。

マクロン氏は今年３月、核搭載可能な兵器の欧州同盟国への配備や、共同演習を実施する構想を打ち出した。フランスは、世界第４位の核弾頭２９０発を維持するため、年約５６億ユーロ（約６０億４０００万ドル）を支出。ロシアと米国はそれぞれ５０００発超、英国は２２５発を保有している。

items.title: Kotak, IndusInd, Axis Bank shares jump on strong Q2 business updates
items.author: Subrata Panda
items.summary: Lenders report strong credit and deposit growth aided by FCNR(B) inflows, though analysts flag concerns over CASA momentum ...
items.body: Shares of Kotak Mahindra Bank, IndusInd Bank and Axis Bank rose sharply on Tuesday after the lenders reported robust growth in advances and deposits in their quarterly business updates. This growth was aided by healthy mobilisation of FCNR(B) deposits. Kotak Mahindra Bank’s shares jumped 3.59 per cent to close at ₹431.25 on the BSE, while IndusInd Bank gained 2.79 per cent to end at ₹906.95. Axis Bank’s shares rose 2.01 per cent to ₹1,248.50. However, RBL Bank’s shares closed 0.72 per cent lower at ₹414 on the BSE compared with the previous day’s close. On Monday, Kotak Mahindra Bank reported robust net advances (period-end) growth of 25 per cent year-on-year (Y-o-Y) and 13 per cent quarter-on-quarter (Q-o-Q). Excluding advances linked to FCNR(B) deposits, loan growth remained firm at around 21 per cent Y-o-Y and 10 per cent Q-o-Q. Deposits grew 23 per cent Y-o-Y and 14 per cent Q-o-Q, aided by FCNR(B) inflows. Excluding these, deposit growth was more measured at 13 per cent Y-o-Y and 4 per cent Q-o-Q. Current account savings account (CASA) balances grew 11 per cent Y-o-Y and 8 per cent Q-o-Q. The bank mobilised $5.78 billion through FCNR(B) deposits during the quarter. Axis Bank, India’s third-largest private sector lender, said its deposits grew 5.8 per cent sequentially and 20.7 per cent Y-o-Y to ₹14.52 trillion as of September 30, while gross advances rose 8.8 per cent Q-o-Q and 22.7 per cent YoY to ₹13.85 trillion. The lender mobilised $10.62 billion (₹1.02 trillion) in FCNR(B) deposits under the Reserve Bank of India’s swap facility introduced earlier this year.   “While the outcome is good on the loan growth front, the question is sustainability plus core deposit growth around 12-13 per cent for Kotak (Mahindra Bank) and Axis (Bank) isn’t that great. That goes to show that eventually loan growth will have to come down from current levels. CASA growth is also 10 to 11 per cent similar to HDFC Bank showing the pressure that exists in CASA across the system. CASA ratios continue to decline even on core deposit growth basis”, said Suresh Ganapathy, MD&Head - Financial Services Research, Macquarie Capital.  Meanwhile, IndusInd Bank’s net advances grew 11.2 per cent Y-o-Y to ₹3.62 trillion as of September 30, 2026, outpacing the 10.1 per cent growth in deposits to ₹4.29 trillion. IndusInd Bank’s CASA ratio declined to 28 per cent from 30.7 per cent a year earlier and 29.4 per cent in June. The lender mobilised $3.51 billion in FCNR(B) deposits under the RBI’s deposit swap facility, with outstanding loans of about ₹16,564 crore extended from its GIFT City branch against these deposits as of September-end. And, RBL Bank’s total deposits rose 34 per cent Y-o-Y to around ₹1.56 trillion in the quarter ended September 30 (Q2FY27), while gross advances grew 40 per cent to around ₹1.43 trillion. (Disclosure: Entities controlled by the Kotak family have a significant holding in Business Standard Pvt Ltd)

FAST

Oct 6 : Three-times Olympic champion Mikaela Shiffrin intends to race less slalom next season, and concentrate more on giant slalom and super-G, with the American describing the new campaign as "an exploration".
Shiffrin won her second Olympic slalom gold medal at Milano Cortina this year and has dominated the discipline at World Cup level, winning the slalom crystal globe on nine occasions.
The 31-year-old holds the record for most World Cup race wins, with 73 of her 110 victories coming in slalom.
Shiffrin says that curiosity has been the driving force behind her motivation down through the years.

"Right now, I feel that curiosity with giant slalom and super-G. This season is an exploration." Shiffrin said on social media on Tuesday.
"I'm planning to race less slalom this season. Not necessarily no slalom."
Shiffrin, who won nine of the 10 slalom races last season, will skip the first two slalom events in the new season.
"Right now, the plan is Killington as my first slalom and potentially a few others throughout the season," Shiffrin said.
"I'll have the chance to recover, train differently, take care of my body differently, and build more intentional GS and super-G blocks."
INTENT TO CHANGE
In February, Shiffrin signalled her intent to make a change when she spoke to Reuters following her Olympic success.
"I feel that there's some kind of transition in my career coming closer," Shiffrin said.
"But I don't know what that looks like and I don't know how to say it."
After winning a record-equalling sixth World Cup overall crystal globe last season, the transition is also about putting off the day when she hangs up her skis.
"Ironically, the more predictable choice might be to race only slalom. From a purely results-oriented perspective, maybe that's the obvious move," Shiffrin said.
"But staying only where I've been most successful, rather than taking a risk and following my curiosity into something less known, feels like a faster path toward retirement."
Shiffrin has won the giant slalom globe twice, and her only super-G success came in 2019, in her best ever season when she also won the slalom, giant slalom overall titles.
The season begins with a giant slalom on October 24 in Solden, Austria.

Source: Reuters

FAST

THE HAGUE, Oct 6 : Thousands of administrative systems at wind and solar power parks in Europe are exposed to the internet, potentially giving attackers access to interfaces that can stop turbines and raising the risk of sabotage, Dutch researchers warned on Tuesday.
The exposed systems included administrative and login interfaces as well as operational interfaces showing data and controls.
However, one of the researchers, Soufian El Yadmani, from internet-scanning company Modat, told Reuters that researchers believed full control would have been possible in the case of around 181 sites.
One turbine's web page showed live data, "Start, Stop and Reset" buttons and the turbine's location, the research said. Some systems controlled several turbines or a whole farm.

"What we can map in hours, an attacker can map in hours too," the report said. The researchers urged operators to take admin interfaces off the internet immediately.
SPANISH SOLAR, GERMAN WIND MOST EXPOSED
The findings come amid concerns about Europe's critical infrastructure, which has faced suspected sabotage and cyberattacks frequently attributed by Western governments to Russia since its invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Russia denies any involvement. 
Last month, Dutch intelligence agencies, police and prosecutors warned that artificial intelligence was accelerating the threat.
El Yadmani and Bouke van Laethem of the Dutch National Cyber Security Centre presented their findings on Tuesday at the ONE Conference in The Hague.
Turbines or arrays closely linked to public infrastructure were a special concern, El Yadmani said. "If you can turn off the energy within the city or the airport, imagine that at a larger scale."
Using machine learning to sort and cluster data, the pair said they identified 8,547 internet-facing systems they could link to at specific solar parks (7,942) and wind farms (605) in 35 European countries, which should not have been exposed to the internet.
Most of the systems found were admin pages with login screens. 
Spain had the most exposed solar systems, with 2,766, followed by Greece with 1,860, they said. 
Germany has Europe's most installed solar capacity, and 672 exposed solar systems. However it had the most exposed wind systems with 212, with Italy close behind at 192. The researchers said the rankings partly reflected where they had been able to link systems to specific sites. 
The European Union Agency for Cybersecurity could not immediately comment. Authorities in Germany, Italy and Spain did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
The report listed among its sources the Polish cybersecurity team CERT Polska's analysis of a December 2025 attack on 30 wind and solar sites in Poland, an example of the potential threat.

Source: Reuters

Spain had the most exposed solar systems, with 2,766, followed by Greece with 1,860, they said. 
Germany has Europe's most installed solar capacity, and 672 exposed solar systems. However it had the most exposed wind systems with 212, with Italy close behind at 192. The researchers said the rankings partly reflected where they had been able to link systems to specific sites. 
The European Union Agency for Cybersecurity could not immediately comment. Authorities in Germany, Italy and Spain did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
The report listed among its sources the Polish cybersecurity team CERT Polska's analysis of a December 2025 attack on 30 wind and solar sites in Poland, an example of the potential threat.

items.title: Thousands of European wind and solar power systems exposed online, Dutch researchers say
items.author: Stephanie van den Berg, Toby Sterling
items.creator: Stephanie van den Berg, Toby Sterling
items.summary: Thousands of administrative systems at wind and solar power parks in Europe are exposed to the internet, potentially giving attackers access to interfaces that can stop turbines and raising the risk of sabotage, Dutch researchers warned on Tuesday.
items.body:
Thousands of administrative systems at wind and solar power parks in Europe are exposed to the internet, potentially giving attackers access to interfaces that can stop turbines and raising the risk of sabotage, Dutch researchers warned on Tuesday.
The exposed systems included administrative and login interfaces as well as operational interfaces showing data and controls.
However, one of the researchers, Soufian El Yadmani, from internet-scanning company Modat, told Reuters that researchers believed full control would have been possible in the case of around 181 sites.
One turbine's web page showed live data, "Start, Stop and Reset" buttons and the turbine's location, the research said. Some systems controlled several turbines or a whole farm.
"What we can map in hours, an attacker can map in hours too," the report said. The researchers urged operators to take admin interfaces off the internet immediately.
SPANISH SOLAR, GERMAN WIND MOST EXPOSED The findings come amid [USN:L8N45F1L2 TEXT:"concerns about Europe's critical infrastructure,"] which has faced suspected sabotage and cyberattacks frequently attributed by Western governments to Russia since its invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Russia denies any involvement.
Last month, Dutch intelligence agencies, police and prosecutors warned that artificial intelligence was accelerating the threat.
El Yadmani and Bouke van Laethem of the Dutch National Cyber Security Centre presented their findings on Tuesday at the ONE Conference in The Hague.
Turbines or arrays closely linked to public infrastructure were a special concern, El Yadmani said. "If you can turn off the energy within the city or the airport, imagine that at a larger scale."
Using machine learning to sort and cluster data, the pair said they identified 8,547 internet-facing systems they could link to at specific solar parks (7,942) and wind farms (605) in 35 European countries, which should not have been exposed to the internet.
Most of the systems found were admin pages with login screens.
Spain had the most exposed solar systems, with 2,766, followed by Greece with 1,860, they said.
Germany has Europe's most installed solar capacity, and 672 exposed solar systems. However it had the most exposed wind systems with 212, with Italy close behind at 192. The researchers said the rankings partly reflected where they had been able to link systems to specific sites.
The European Union Agency for Cybersecurity could not immediately comment. Authorities in Germany, Italy and Spain did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
The report listed among its sources the Polish cybersecurity team CERT Polska's analysis of a [USN:L6N3YV10T TEXT:"December 2025 attack"] on 30 wind and solar sites in Poland, an example of the potential threat.

items.title: 米中、原子力施設の相互訪問を協議　信頼醸成へ前進の可能性＝報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[６日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権が中国と原子力施設の相互訪問の開始について協議しており、今後数カ月の対面会合で引き続きその実現を働きかけていく方針であることが分かった。協議は非公式かつ予備的な段階にある。ＣＮＮが６日、関係筋の話として報じた。

報道によると、相互訪問の構想は今年、米政府当局者との会合で中国側が最初に持ち出した。より大きな合意への道筋をつけ得る信頼醸成措置に、中国が前向きになる可能性を示唆する動きだとされる。関係筋によると、協議では米エネルギー省傘下の国立研究所と、中国側の同等施設への訪問が議論された。米国は核実験場への訪問についても議論する用意があるという。

原子力施設の相互訪問を認めるという構想は、戦略的安定性に関する問題で中国を関与させようとする米国の取り組みを前進させ、三国間協定の足掛かりとなる可能性があるが、中国は自国の核増強を制限しかねない協議には応じないとの姿勢を崩していないもよう。

items.title: Mayoría de monedas sube; activos brasileños se estabilizan tras dispararse en la víspera
items.author: Manuel Farías
items.creator: Manuel Farías
items.summary: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subió el martes por una baja global del dólar en medio del descenso de los rendimientos de los bonos y de los precios del crudo, que reducían los temores sobre la inflación, mientras que los activos brasileños se estabilizaron tras la fuerte alza de la víspera después de la primera vuelta presidencial.
items.body:
La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subió el martes por una baja global del dólar en medio del descenso de los rendimientos de los bonos y de los precios del crudo, que reducían los temores sobre la inflación, mientras que los activos brasileños se estabilizaron tras la fuerte alza de la víspera después de la primera vuelta presidencial.
* El índice dólar , que mide el desempeño del billete verde frente a una canasta de monedas pares, bajó un 0,32%, a 101,83 unidades, en su mayor caída diaria desde el 3 de septiembre. debido principalmente al avance del euro después de caer en la víspera a su mínimo de 17 meses. La moneda única avanzó ante el descenso de los retornos de los bonos franceses, que aliviaban los temores sobre la deuda de la zona euro.
* La rentabilidad de la deuda de Estados Unidos también retrocedió, luego de tocar en la víspera máximos de varias décadas. Por su parte, los precios del crudo Brent bajaron levemente.
* El real brasileño ganó un 0,55% a 4,9745 por dólar, su mayor cotización en casi cinco meses; al tiempo que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) descendió un 0,53% a 205.805 puntos, al cierre preliminar, tras avanzar más temprano hasta un 1%, en medio de ajustes y con atención en las elecciones presidenciales.
* En la víspera, el real escaló más de un 4% en su mayor avance diario desde el 8 de junio de 2018, mientras que el Bovespa se disparó hasta máximos históricos después del resultado de la primera vuelta electoral del domingo, cuando el senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro llegó por sobre el presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, en un desempeño que superó las proyecciones de las encuestas.
* Flávio y Lula dirimirán la contienda presidencial en un balotaje el 25 de octubre.
* El peso mexicano subía por la tarde un 0,58%, a 17,9682 unidades por dólar, marcando su tercer avance seguido; en tanto que el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, ganó un 0,45%, a 65.269,62 puntos, también en su tercera sesión consecutiva de alzas.
* El peso chileno , subió un 0,19%, a 972,00/972,30 unidades por dólar, tras ceder parte importante de sus ganancias de primera hora. Asimismo, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , clausuró la jornada con un alza 0,36%, en 11.163,42 puntos.
* El peso colombiano , sin embargo, operó en contra de sus pares de la región y cerró con caída de un 1,30% a 3.241,50 unidades por dólar, luego de dos jornadas de ganancias; mientras que en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) se valorizó un 0,24% a 2.588,91 puntos.
* El peso mayorista argentino apenas avanzó un 0,03% a 1.520 por dólar, con la intervención cotidiana del banco central (BCRA) mediante la absorción de divisas para respaldar sus reservas internacionales. Este martes hubo compra oficial por 41 millones de dólares. El índice accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires ganó un 0,95%, ampliando el avance del 3,68% del lunes.
* La moneda peruana, el sol , se apreció un leve 0,03% a 3,4340/3,4350 unidades por dólar. En tanto que la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) subía un leve 0,19% a 1.586,25 puntos.

items.title: Texas AG Paxton probes Fruit of the Loom, Hanes over potential toxic chemicals in children's underwear
items.author: Jonathan Stempel
items.creator: Jonathan Stempel
items.summary: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton launched an investigation on Tuesday into whether Fruit of the Loom and Hanes use toxic chemicals in producing children's underwear.
items.body:
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton launched an investigation on Tuesday into whether Fruit of the Loom and Hanes use toxic chemicals in producing children's underwear.
Paxton said he sent civil investigative demands to Fruit of the Loom, which is owned by Berkshire Hathaway (BRKa.N) , and Hanes, which is owned by Gildan Activewear (GIL.TO) , citing the chemicals' potential effects on children's health. He did not accuse either company of wrongdoing.
Fruit of the Loom and Berkshire did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
Gildan said it will cooperate with the investigation, and maintains strict manufacturing and sourcing standards to comply with industry guidelines related to harmful chemicals. "We remain committed to providing safe, high-quality products for consumers," it added.
Paxton said clothing manufacturers have turned increasingly to synthetic materials such as polyester, rayon and spandex to meet consumer demand for lower-priced products.
He said research shows that synthetic fabrics can shed microplastics, while chemicals including bisphenols, fluorine, parabens, phthalates and so-called "forever chemicals" used in textile manufacturing have been associated with cancer, hormone disruption, infertility and other health concerns.
"We must protect our children who cannot yet protect themselves," Paxton said in a statement. "This includes making sure that the necessities parents rely on are free from toxic chemicals and do not harm the health of kids."
The attorney general announced a [USN:L6N40W10V TEXT:"similar probe"] in April into whether Lululemon Athletica (LULU.O) activewear contained forever chemicals, which do not break down easily in nature. Forever chemicals are also known as PFAS, short for per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances.
Paxton, a Republican, is running for a US Senate seat against Democrat James Talarico and trailing in most polls. The race is among the country's most closely watched in the November 3 midterm elections.

items.title: パラマウント、1100億ドルのワーナー買収完了　新会社「スカイダンス」誕生
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Anzar Mehraj　Harshita Mary Varghese

[６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Anzar Mehraj　Harshita Mary Varghese

[６日　ロイター] - 米メディア大手パラマウント・スカイダンスは６日、ワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリー（ＷＢＤ）を買収する１１００億ドル規模の大型取引が完了したと発表した。これにより、新会社「スカイダンス」が誕生し、デービッド・エリソン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が世界最大級のエンターテインメント企業を率いることになる。

統合後の新会社「スカイダンス」の株式は６日、ナスダックからニューヨーク証券取引所に移管され、「SKYD」のティッカーシンボルで取引が開始された。

人気映画シリーズ「ミッション：インポッシブル」や「ハリー・ポッター」などを手がけるスタジオに、ＣＢＳニュース、ＣＮＮニュース、「パラマウント＋（プラス）」、「ＨＢＯマックス」などの主要なテレビや動画配信サービスが統合され、映画、テレビ、ニュースを網羅する広範なエンターテインメント企業が誕生する。

トランプ米大統領は、記者団から買収完了について質問され、「素晴らしい企業になるだろう」とし、「素晴らしい合併だ」と応じた。

トランプ大統領は１期目から報道機関を批判し、最近ではＷＢＤ傘下のニュース専門局ＣＮＮを含む３社の記者らをホワイトハウスから締め出すという異例の措置を講じた。

５日発表された新会社の経営陣の詳細によると、ＣＮＮのマーク・トンプソン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）はＣＮＮの会長兼編集長として続投し、ＣＢＳニュースのバリ・ワイス編集長も現職にとどまる。これにより、ＣＮＮとＣＢＳはそれぞれ独立した編集体制を維持する見通しで、ＣＢＳのワイス氏が新会社全体のニュース部門を統括するとの懸念は後退した。

エリソンＣＥＯは、パラマウント傘下のＣＢＳニュースの報道内容をトランプ氏に有利なものにしようとしたとの批判を議員らから受けており、統合後の編集の独立性を巡る懸念が高まっていた。

また、新会社は約８００億ドルの負債を抱える見通しで、エリソン氏には配信事業の拡大、ケーブルネットワーク事業からのキャッシュフロー維持、劇場公開映画の業績改善が求められる。

調査会社モフェットナサンソンのアナリストは、同社の２０２８年の利払い・税引き・償却前利益（ＥＢＩＴＤＡ）を１６０億ドル、３０年には１９０億ドルに増加すると予想。売上高は２８年に約６７０億ドル、３０年には約７００億ドルに達すると見込む。

スカイダンスは、買収完了後の最初の２年間は年間少なくとも３０本、その後の３年間は年間３２本の映画を製作すると公約している。

エリソン氏は先週、統合後の新会社名を「スカイダンス」とした理由について、パラマウントとワーナー・ブラザースの両映画スタジオの個別のアイデンティティーが失われないようにすることが目的で、新たな企業ブランドの下に統合するものではないと説明していた。

米カリフォルニア州ロサンゼルスのパラマウント・スタジオで９月撮影。REUTERS/Daniel Cole

Anzar Mehraj　Harshita Mary Varghese

[６日　ロイター] - 米メディア大手パラマウント・スカイダンスは６日、ワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリー（ＷＢＤ）を買収する１１００億ドル規模の大型取引が完了したと発表した。これにより、新会社「スカイダンス」が誕生し、デービッド・エリソン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が世界最大級のエンターテインメント企業を率いることになる。

統合後の新会社「スカイダンス」の株式は６日、ナスダックからニューヨーク証券取引所に移管され、「SKYD」のティッカーシンボルで取引が開始された。

人気映画シリーズ「ミッション：インポッシブル」や「ハリー・ポッター」などを手がけるスタジオに、ＣＢＳニュース、ＣＮＮニュース、「パラマウント＋（プラス）」、「ＨＢＯマックス」などの主要なテレビや動画配信サービスが統合され、映画、テレビ、ニュースを網羅する広範なエンターテインメント企業が誕生する。

トランプ米大統領は、記者団から買収完了について質問され、「素晴らしい企業になるだろう」とし、「素晴らしい合併だ」と応じた。

トランプ大統領は１期目から報道機関を批判し、最近ではＷＢＤ傘下のニュース専門局ＣＮＮを含む３社の記者らをホワイトハウスから締め出すという異例の措置を講じた。

５日発表された新会社の経営陣の詳細によると、ＣＮＮのマーク・トンプソン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）はＣＮＮの会長兼編集長として続投し、ＣＢＳニュースのバリ・ワイス編集長も現職にとどまる。これにより、ＣＮＮとＣＢＳはそれぞれ独立した編集体制を維持する見通しで、ＣＢＳのワイス氏が新会社全体のニュース部門を統括するとの懸念は後退した。

エリソンＣＥＯは、パラマウント傘下のＣＢＳニュースの報道内容をトランプ氏に有利なものにしようとしたとの批判を議員らから受けており、統合後の編集の独立性を巡る懸念が高まっていた。

また、新会社は約８００億ドルの負債を抱える見通しで、エリソン氏には配信事業の拡大、ケーブルネットワーク事業からのキャッシュフロー維持、劇場公開映画の業績改善が求められる。

調査会社モフェットナサンソンのアナリストは、同社の２０２８年の利払い・税引き・償却前利益（ＥＢＩＴＤＡ）を１６０億ドル、３０年には１９０億ドルに増加すると予想。売上高は２８年に約６７０億ドル、３０年には約７００億ドルに達すると見込む。

スカイダンスは、買収完了後の最初の２年間は年間少なくとも３０本、その後の３年間は年間３２本の映画を製作すると公約している。

エリソン氏は先週、統合後の新会社名を「スカイダンス」とした理由について、パラマウントとワーナー・ブラザースの両映画スタジオの個別のアイデンティティーが失われないようにすることが目的で、新たな企業ブランドの下に統合するものではないと説明していた。

items.title: S&P 500 y Nasdaq alcanzan máximos récord de cierre, foco gira hacia ganancias corporativas
items.author: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.summary: Wall Street cerró al alza el martes, ya que los precios del petróleo se estabilizaron y los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro cedieron, ofreciendo cierto alivio ante las preocupaciones que habían inquietado a los inversores en las últimas semanas y permitiendo a los mercados centrar su atención en la próxima temporada de resultados del tercer trimestre.
items.body:
Wall Street cerró al alza el martes, ya que los precios del petróleo se estabilizaron y los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro cedieron, ofreciendo cierto alivio ante las preocupaciones que habían inquietado a los inversores en las últimas semanas y permitiendo a los mercados centrar su atención en la próxima temporada de resultados del tercer trimestre.
* Este avance generalizado llevó al S&P 500 y al Nasdaq a alcanzar máximos históricos de cierre.
* Cuando los precios del petróleo se estabilizan o bajan, "eso provoca un descenso de los rendimientos porque disminuye la inquietud por la inflación impulsada por la energía, lo que a su vez ayuda a elevar las acciones", dijo Oliver Pursche, vicepresidente senior de Wealthspire Advisors en Nueva York.
* El interés por el sector de la inteligencia artificial sigue muy vigente, con el índice de semiconductores Filadelfia (.SOX) ganando terreno. El gasto en infraestructura relacionada con la IA se reflejó en los datos de comercio internacional, que mostraron un aumento del 4,4% en las importaciones de bienes de capital durante agosto.
* Un informe del Departamento de Comercio reveló que el déficit comercial de Estados Unidos creció un 13,7%, ante un incremento de las importaciones, a un máximo histórico.
* En términos mensuales y anuales, las importaciones avanzaron un 4,3% y un 28,4%, respectivamente, reflejando una sólida demanda interna que podría agravar las presiones inflacionarias, sobre todo en medio de restricciones de suministro por el conflicto bélico.
* Aun así, los mercados financieros descuentan actualmente una menor probabilidad de que la Reserva Federal aplique una segunda subida consecutiva de las tasas de interés en la reunión de política monetaria de este mes, según la herramienta FedWatch de CME.
* Según los datos preliminares de cierre, el S&P 500 (.SPX) ganó 46,52 puntos, o un 0,60%, a 7.820,47 unidades; el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) subió 127,43 puntos, o un 0,46%, a 27.604,74 unidades; y el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) sumó 263,67 puntos, o un 0,49%, a 51.531,57 unidades.
* La temporada de resultados del tercer trimestre comienza la próxima semana, y se espera que varias firmas financieras de gran relevancia presenten sus informes el próximo martes. Los analistas prevén un crecimiento interanual agregado de los beneficios del S&P 500 del 30,6% para el periodo de julio a septiembre, según datos de LSEG.

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 6 : The euro rebounded on Tuesday and was poised for its strongest move higher in seven weeks after falling to a 17-month low on the prior day, as a pullback in French government bond yields eased fears about strain in euro zone debt markets.
The euro zone's currency jumped 0.35 per cent, on track for its biggest daily gain since August 19, at $1.126. The currency had slid to its lowest since May 2025 on Monday at $1.116, following a drop of more than 1 per cent in the prior week, its fourth straight weekly decline. 
The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies, fell 0.32 per cent to 101.83 and was on pace for its biggest daily drop since September 3. 
Bond markets around the world have seen yields climb in recent weeks due to expectations of sharp central bank rate hikes as energy prices have jumped because of the Iran war and stoked inflation, as well as concerns about government finances.

French debt has seen pressure mount as politicians struggle to curb the budget deficit ahead of a divisive election in 2027. The calling of a snap election in Spain added to the recent pressure on the euro.
ENERGY PRICES EASE BOND PRESSURE
An early drop in energy prices helped French bonds rally on Tuesday, with the key 10-year yield down 11.4 basis points at 4.7506 per cent.
Crude prices had fallen as rising Middle Eastern crude exports and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concern as Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces staged a lightning advance on Monday to retake the coast around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait up to the city of Mocha, the government said, but prices had since rebounded to erase declines. 
"Saudi-backed Yemen forces have recaptured some strategic territory from the Houthis, this has seen oil prices drop sharply," said Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Capital Markets in New York. "In turn, this has helped drag yields down, including in France, and in Italy, where the spreads had really widened lately and so this is giving the euro a bit of a bounce."
Far-right French presidential candidate Marine Le Pen, who leads the polls, on Tuesday increased her plans to reduce spending to €140 billion ($158 billion) from €125 billion in savings originally planned if she wins power in 2027.  
The fall in the dollar helped buoy other currencies, with sterling up 0.42 per cent and on pace for its biggest daily gain since August 19, to $1.3275, after climbing to a one-week high of $1.3283.
JAPAN SIGNALS RATE RISE READINESS
The yen was an exception, with the dollar up 0.11 per cent to 158.08 against the Japanese currency. 
The Bank of Japan may signal this month that underlying inflation has roughly hit its 2 per cent target, three people familiar with its thinking said, highlighting its readiness to raise interest rates again in the coming months.
Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said it was becoming more important to anchor underlying inflation around the central bank's 2 per cent target, signaling a preparedness to keep raising interest rates to blunt the risk of too-high inflation.
The US dollar's recent strength has come even as expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike at the central bank's policy meeting later this month have retreated in the wake of weaker-than-expected US jobs data and comments from some Fed officials. However, markets are still anticipating more rate hikes later in the year and next year. 
The gains for the dollar in September were partly due to the greater exposure of US equities to technology and AI, said Goldman Sachs analysts in a note, along with the recent outperformance of US growth. But the firm is cautious on the prospects for near-term dollar strength, citing stretched positioning in several major pairs and the recent Fed communication emphasizing a patient approach to policy tightening. 
In contrast to the recent call for patience from some Fed officials, Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid said on Tuesday that the central bank still needs to raise its policy rate further to lower inflation, even if higher long-term yields are weighing on activity in some parts of the economy. 
The chance of a hike of at least 25 basis points in October stands at about 19 per cent, from about 51 per cent a week ago, according to CME FedWatch, but markets are pricing in an 86 per cent chance for a hike at the December meeting. 

Source: Reuters

FAST

LONDON, Oct 6 : Google was accused of abusing its dominance to levy excessive commissions on app developers, as a mass consumer lawsuit worth over £1 billion ($1.33 billion) began in London on Tuesday.
The case — brought on behalf of around 20 million consumers who bought apps through Google's Play Store, or paid for in-app purchases and subscriptions between 2015 and this July — is the latest brought in Britain against Big Tech.
Lawyers representing consumer advocate Liz Coll, who is leading the claim, say Google used its dominant position to charge commissions of up to 30 per cent on purchases of apps through its Play Store, as well as on in-app purchases and subscriptions.
They argue that those excessive commissions were passed on by app developers to consumers, citing as an example that when Google sold YouTube Premium through Apple's App Store it also decided to pass on the commission it was charged.

But Google's parent Alphabet is fighting the lawsuit, which a spokesperson said ignores the degree of choice the Android platform gives consumers and that it charges "some of the lowest fees in the market".
The tech giant's lawyers, who said Coll's case was unfounded, argued the Play Store "faces strong competitive constraints both on the developer and consumer sides", including from Apple's App Store and other alternative platforms.
The trial at London's Competition Appeal Tribunal follows similar cases against Apple and Sony over their App Store and PlayStation Store, both of which cited commissions of up to 30 per cent.
Coll's case also comes after years of regulatory scrutiny and litigation over Google's app store practices, including a long-running battle with "Fortnite" maker Epic Games, whose London lawsuit was due to be heard alongside Coll's.
In March, Google and Epic reached a worldwide settlement under which Google said it would expand billing options and cut developer fees.
Last month, Google also settled another lawsuit for £260 million, which was brought on behalf of app developers, without making any admission of liability or wrongdoing.

items.title: Riesgo país de Argentina mantiene sesgo bajista por impulso de Brasil
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El riesgo país de Argentina bajó el martes por segunda ronda consecutiva ante una mejora en los niveles de la deuda pública, tras el optimismo regional que representó el triunfo de la derecha en las recientes elecciones de Brasil.
items.body:
El riesgo país de Argentina bajó el martes por segunda ronda consecutiva ante una mejora en los niveles de la deuda pública, tras el optimismo regional que representó el triunfo de la derecha en las recientes elecciones de Brasil.
El senador Flávio Bolsonaro se enfrentará al mandatario Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en el balotaje de los comicios presidenciales de [USN:L1N45R01Q TEXT:"Brasil"], después de que el aspirante de derecha obtuviera cerca del 47% de los votos válidos en la primera vuelta del domingo, superando las previsiones de la mayoría de los sondeos.
"A este resultado (en las urnas) no lo reflejaron la mayoría de las encuestas y por eso sorprendió, lo que aligeró el circulante de liquidez en toda la región. Pero hay que considerar que lo que puede ser bueno para los mercados, no necesariamente sea beneficioso para la marcha de la economía real", comentó un analista del Banco Galicia.
La fuerte recuperación de los mercados financieros el lunes aún derramaba beneficios este martes, donde el riesgo país argentino elaborado por el J.P. Morgan caía a 574 puntos básicos (2000 GMT), desde las 600 unidades del cierre previo y los 655 puntos anotados el viernes pasado.
Los bonos soberanos promediaban un fuerte salto positivo del 2%, desde la subida del 0,9% previa, mientras que el índice accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires ganó un 0,95% por coberturas rápidas, contra un salto del 3,68% del lunes.
"El índice de tipo de cambio real multilateral de Argentina tiene a Brasil como su principal componente, con una ponderación del 20%", resaltó Rava Bursátil.
"El secretario del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, Scott Bessent, afirmó que volvería a apoyar financieramente a la Argentina en caso de ser necesario. Además, el equipo económico argentino declaró tener 15.000 millones de dólares para vender en futuros con vencimiento en 2027", agregó.
El peso mayorista apenas avanzó un 0,03% a 1.520 por dólar , con la intervención cotidiana del banco central (BCRA) mediante la absorción de divisas para respaldar sus reservas internacionales. Este martes hubo compra oficial por 41 millones de dólares.
Esta quietud cambiaria permite una mejora del peso en la competitividad regional por la subida del real brasileño tras las elecciones del domingo, dijeron operadores.
Un reciente sondeo publicado por el portal Perfil indicó que siete de cada 10 empresarios participantes del coloquio anual de IDEA creen que el peso está sobrevaluado, ya que el nivel actual debería superar las 1.800 unidades por dólar.

items.title: US software shares hit 2026 highs as AI disruption fears ease
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: US software stocks are witnessing robust growth, fueled by optimistic earnings projections and partnerships in AI. Major players like Salesforce and Accenture have showcased impressive earnings, aiding the sector's revival. Analysts suggest that fears of AI disrupting the software landscape are exaggerated. Nonetheless, challenges persist as technology evolves, potentially affecting traditional business models.
items.body: US software stocks are scaling up to fresh 2026 highs as sharply improving earnings expectations ease concerns that artificial intelligence will disrupt the industry as severely as initially feared, Reuters reported.The S&P 500 software and services index rose 1.3% on Tuesday to its highest level since November 2025. It also recorded its biggest quarterly gain since the second quarter of 2020 during the July-September period.Strong results from Salesforce, ServiceNow and Accenture, along with partnerships with AI developers, have helped drive the sector’s recovery since late June.Cybersecurity companies have led the rebound. CrowdStrike, Fortinet and Palo Alto Networks have posted triple-digit percentage gains this year as businesses ramp up security spending in the AI era.“AI has been more of an enabler for a lot of these software companies, more than a disruptor,” said Adam Turnquist, chief cross-asset strategist at LPL Financial, according to Reuters. “We’re seeing more of a trend change now where software has recaptured the leadership reins, and we think there’s a window here for outperformance in software over semiconductors.”The software index has gained 5% this year. In comparison, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index has surged 87.5% in 2026, although it has retreated from its highs.The software sector’s projected earnings growth for 2026 has risen to 20.6% from 13.8% at the end of March, according to LSEG data.‘SaaSpocalypse’ fears easeThe software index fell more than 26% between late January and its April low during a selloff dubbed the “SaaSpocalypse.” Investors feared companies could use AI to develop applications internally at a lower cost, reducing demand for traditional software providers.Analysts now say those concerns outpaced the available evidence.“The whole SaaSpocalypse didn’t happen anywhere near as fast as some of the people on Wall Street thought it would,” said Rebecca Wettemann, CEO of technology research firm Valoir, adding that vendors were reporting stronger customer adoption as AI moved beyond the experimental stage.Risks remain as the rapidly evolving technology reshapes business models.Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management, told Reuters that the sector could face its biggest test in the second half of 2027, when greater data-centre capacity may make AI coding tools a more significant threat to traditional software companies.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

items.title: IMF says hedge funds' market footprint growing, merits closer scrutiny
items.author: Pete Schroeder
items.creator: Pete Schroeder
items.summary: Hedge funds have more than tripled in size in the last decade and now play increasingly critical market roles, the International Monetary Fund said Tuesday, while warning that the funds' use of leverage and overall opacity can inject risks into the financial system.
items.body:
Hedge funds have more than tripled in size in the last decade and now play increasingly critical market roles, the International Monetary Fund said Tuesday, while warning that the funds' use of leverage and overall opacity can inject risks into the financial system.
The findings were published Tuesday by the IMF as it released a chapter of its Global Financial Stability Report, which will be released in full on Oct. 13. Here's what the group found:
Hedge funds are playing an increasingly prominent role in trading, liquidity and risk transfers, as assets at the funds now stand at roughly $13 trillion in early 2026, up significantly from just $4 trillion in 2013
Hedge fund growth has primarily come through leverage, including synthetic leverage through derivatives
Such funds have grown their footprint significantly in sovereign bond markets, particularly US Treasuries. Hedge funds now account for 9% of the Treasury market, compared to just 4% in 2022
While greater hedge fund presence can boost market efficiency, the IMF warned they can also amplify stress when markets deteriorate, particularly due to those firms' use of leverage and fewer constraints on risk
The IMF warned that hedge funds remain "inherently opaque," making it difficult to accurately gauge their risks and exposures. It called on policymakers to close data gaps and boost risk monitoring of the sector for potential vulnerabilities

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［６日　ロイター］ - ルビオ米国務長官は６日、訪問先のアイスランドで同国のグンナルスドッティル外相と共同記者会見を行い、アイスランドは北大西洋・北極圏防衛で中核的な役割を担っているとし、脅威が増大する中、安全保障分野で協力を継続することが重要だと述べた。

ルビオ長官は北極圏の軍事、経済、インフラ面での脅威への懸念に言及した上で、「アイスランドは米軍による戦力投射を可能にしてきた。アイスランドの陸・空・海の領域を活用しながら協力することで、秘密活動を監視し、敵対勢力を抑止するための重要な拠点を提供している」と述べた。

その上で「アイスランドの地理的位置は、欧州だけでなく米国本土の防衛にとっても極めて重要だ」とし、「さらに何ができるかを探るため協議を行う用意がある。双方が協力拡大に関心を持っていると認識している」と語った。

items.title: Marvell raises 2028 revenue forecast on strong AI data center demand
items.author: Prathik Jayaprakash, Anhata Rooprai, Max Cherney
items.creator: Prathik Jayaprakash, Anhata Rooprai, Max Cherney
items.summary: Marvell Technology raised its fiscal 2028 revenue forecast to about $20 billion on Tuesday, above Wall Street estimates, as demand for its custom data center chips grows along with a surge in AI spending.
items.body:
Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) raised its fiscal 2028 revenue forecast to about $20 billion on Tuesday, above Wall Street estimates, as demand for its custom data center chips grows along with a surge in AI spending.
Shares of the Santa Clara, California-based company rose about 6%, while those of rival Broadcom (AVGO.O) advanced about 4%.
"It took a long time to get this company on this path and to be a technology leader," Chris Koopmans, Marvell's president and chief operating officer, said in an interview. "We have a track record of doing what we said we're going to do."
Marvell outlined a strategy in 2021 centered on custom and cloud-optimized silicon — chips specifically designed for use in data centers. It has been one of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI infrastructure boom since then and projects it will generate $12 billion in custom chip revenue in fiscal 2029, up from a prior target of $10 billion.
The company's custom chip business has become a major growth engine, with technology companies developing in-house AI processors to reduce reliance on Nvidia (NVDA.O) chips. Marvell's stock has more than tripled in value so far this year.
Marvell disclosed a deal with Alphabet's Google (GOOGL.O) in August that could generate up to $120 billion in sales through fiscal 2033, if performance milestones are achieved.
That same month, it raised its full-year revenue outlook to about $18 billion from $16.5 billion.
On Tuesday, Marvell forecast fiscal 2031 revenue of $70 billion to $90 billion. At $80 billion, the midpoint of that range exceeds Wall Street estimates of $46.85 billion, according to four analysts polled by Visible Alpha.
Analysts were expecting revenue of $18.2 billion for 2028, according to data compiled by LSEG.

Oct 6 : US software stocks are touching fresh 2026 highs, supported by a sharp rise in earnings expectations, which according to several analysts indicate that fears over AI-led disruption in the sector were largely overstated.
The S&P 500 software and services index rose 1.3 per cent on Tuesday to its highest levels since November 2025, after posting its biggest quarterly jump in July-September since the second quarter of 2020.
Strong earnings from software companies such as Salesforce, ServiceNow and Accenture, along with partnerships with AI labs, helped fuel a recovery in the sector that had been underway since late June.
Cybersecurity stocks have stood out, with Crowdstrike, Fortinet and Palo Alto Networks notching triple digit percentage gains this year as companies spend heavily on cybersecurity in the age of AI.

"AI has been more of an enabler for a lot of these software companies, more than a disruptor," said Adam Turnquist, chief cross-asset strategist at LPL Financial.
"We're seeing more of a trend change now where software has recaptured the leadership reins, and we think there's a window here for outperformance in software over semiconductors."
The software index is up 5 per cent this year while the Philadelphia SE Semiconductor index, home to many US chipmakers, has surged 87.5 per cent in 2026, but is well off its highs.
The sector's expected annual earnings growth rate for 2026 has climbed to 20.6 per cent, up from 13.8 per cent at the end of March, according to LSEG data.
'SAASPOCALYPSE' FEARS OVERDONE
The software index lost more than 26 per cent from late January to its lowest point in April, in a selloff dubbed "SaaSpocalypse", driven by fears that companies could use AI to build applications in-house more cheaply.
Analysts now say the fear ran ahead of evidence.
"The whole SaaSpocalypse didn't happen anywhere near as fast as some of the people on Wall Street thought it would," said Rebecca Wettemann, CEO of technology research firm Valoir, adding that vendors were reporting customer uptake as AI adoption moved beyond the experimental stage.
Still, risks to the sector persist as the fast-evolving technology upends business models.
Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management, said the real test for software stocks could come in the second half of 2027, when more data center capacity might make AI coding a bigger threat to traditional software firms.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Ｇ７の石油備蓄放出、詳細を14─15日のＩＥＡ理事会で決定へ＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Giuseppe Fonte　Kate Abnett　Alex Lawler

[ローマ／ロンドン　６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Giuseppe Fonte　Kate Abnett　Alex Lawler

[ローマ／ロンドン　６日　ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）の理事会は、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）が先週発表したディーゼル燃料（軽油）および原油の備蓄放出に関する詳細を、１０月１４─１５日の会合で決定する見通しだ。この件に詳しい関係筋２人が６日、明らかにした。供給不足と過去最高水準の価格に対応するため、欧米がどれだけの量を放出するのかを巡り、市場で不透明感が広がっている。

Ｇ７は２日の首脳共同声明で、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向け、ＩＥＡを通じてディーゼル燃料などの石油備蓄１億バレルを協調放出すると発表した。ただ、放出する原油、ディーゼル燃料、その他の製品の数量の内訳や、どの国が参加するのかは明らかにしていなかった。 

関係筋の１人によると、Ｇ７加盟国であるイタリアが放出に加わる見通しだという。

ＩＥＡは、詳細が理事会で決定されるかどうかについてのコメント要請に対し、直ちには回答しなかった。

欧州委員会の報道官は６日、ＥＵの石油調整グループが７日に会合を開くと明らかにした。

ホワイトハウスは、備蓄放出の詳細を明らかにするよう求めたコメント要請に直ちには回答しなかった。

石油市場関係者や一部のＥＵ加盟国の政府当局者も、Ｇ７の２日の発表の詳細について情報収集に追われている。商品取引大手ビトルのラッセル・ハーディ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は６日、ロンドンで開かれた会議で、「具体的に何がどこで放出されるのか、十分に明確な発表ではなかった」とし、同社も備蓄放出の詳細をなお把握しようとしていると述べた。

Oct 6 : Computer-memory company Netlist announced on Tuesday that Micron would pay $600 million to settle a patent dispute over Micron's memory chips.

• Netlist won a $445 million patent infringement verdict against Micron in Marshall, Texas, federal court in 2024
• Netlist filed a new infringement complaint against Micron at the US International Trade Commission in September seeking to block imports of Micron chips used in Google, Nvidia and Broadcom products for AI computing

Oct 6 : Citigroup estimates Meta's AI assistant Muse could generate more than $27 billion in revenue by 2030 as strong user adoption and growing engagement reinforce the platform's first-mover advantage in the emerging personal agent market.
The brokerage said Muse is increasingly becoming the "front door to the internet," helping users search, compare and transact online, while Meta expands awareness and positions the product at the center of its broader AI strategy.
• Citi said Muse's cumulative downloads have topped 6.6 million since its launch, while daily active users reached 1.8 million as new use cases emerge and Meta ramps up awareness efforts
• The brokerage estimates Muse could account for more than $27 billion in annual revenue by 2030, including about $23 billion from transaction-related revenue and roughly $4.5 billion from subscriptions

• Unveiled last month, Muse is key to Meta's strategy to bring AI-powered personal agents to mainstream users, with the company betting the technology can drive new subscription and commerce revenue while deepening engagement across its ecosystem
• "With Muse the centerpiece of Meta's AI vision to be a key part of a user's daily life, we believe personal agents (PAs)— with Muse benefiting from its 1st-mover advantage, are emerging as the new front door to the internet," Citi said
• Muse's first-mover advantage could prove crucial as competitors such as OpenAI's ChatGPT Dots, Google's Gemini and Anthropic's Claude expand their own agent offerings in pursuit of what many view as the next major consumer computing platform
• Meta's stock has risen 12.4 per cent year-to-date and more than 20 per cent since Muse debuted on September 8, leaving Meta within striking distance of a $2 trillion market value

items.title: 米8月貿易赤字、1056億ドルと25年3月以来の高水準
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン　６日　ロイター] - 米商務省が６日発表した８月の貿易赤字（季節調整済み）は前月比１３．７％増の１０５６億ドルと、２０２５年３月以来の高水準となった。堅調な内需を背景に輸入が過去最高を記録し、ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想（１０２０億ドル）を上回った。第３・四半期も貿易が経済成長の押し下げ要因となる見通しとなった。  

８月の輸入は４．３％増の４２０８億ドルと過去最高となった。モノの輸入は５．３％増の３４２２億ドル。石油を含む工業用資材・原材料が９１億ドル増加したことが押し上げ要因となった。

原油の輸入は３３億ドル増、非貨幣用金は３１億ドル増加した。資本財の輸入は、半導体やその他の産業機械がけん引し、６２億ドル増の１４６４億ドルと過去最高となった。一方、コンピューター周辺機器は１６億ドル減少した。

サービス輸入は１億ドル弱の増加にとどまり、７８５億ドルとなった。輸送サービスが小幅に増加した一方、知的財産使用料や旅行サービスは減少した。  

８月の輸出は１．４％増の３１５２億ドル、モノの輸出は２．２％増の２０５７億ドルとなった。工業用資材・原材料が６３億ドル増加した。資本財の輸出は、半導体とコンピューターに押し上げられ１３億ドル増加。一方、民間航空機は１０億ドル減少した。 消費財の輸出は２２億ドル減少。医薬品が２４億ドル減少したことが響いた。

サービス輸出は１０９５億ドルと、１億ドル弱の増加にとどまった。知的財産使用料とその他ビジネスサービスが小幅に増加した一方、旅行サービスと金融サービスはともに減少した。  

貿易は３四半期連続で国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の押し下げ要因となっており、エコノミストらは第３・四半期のＧＤＰを最大２．５％ポイント押し下げる可能性があると試算している。

第３・四半期の成長率予想は概ね年率３．０％を上回っており、個人消費が輸入によるマイナス影響を相殺すると見込まれている。第２・四半期の成長率は２．２％だった。

トランプ大統領は貿易赤字の縮小に向けて輸入品に対する強硬な関税措置を講じてきたものの、赤字は逆に拡大し、メキシコ、ベトナム、マレーシアに対するモノの貿易赤字は過去最大となった。台湾、中国、欧州連合（ＥＵ）、韓国、カナダ、インドなどに対しても引き続き赤字となった。一方、ベルギーに対するモノの貿易黒字は過去最大を記録。オランダ、中南米、英国、香港、ブラジル、オーストラリア、サウジアラビアに対しても黒字を維持した。 

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「現政権の通商政策は概ね失敗に終わっており、関税措置は米国が外国製品への依存を低減することに何ら寄与していない」と指摘。「米国の労働コストは高過ぎるため、消費者が購入を検討できるほど安価な商品を国内で生産することはできない。たとえ米国の製造業者にその意思があったとしても、消費者が依存している商品を生産するための工場を国内に素早く建設することはできないだろう」と述べた。

Alien 'phoenix planet' was born from the ashes of a dying star

An artist’s impression of a second-generation planet orbiting the white dwarf HS 0209+0832, the first such planet to be found orbiting a white dwarf, in this image released on October 5, 2026. Snehalata Sahu/University of Warwick/Handout via REUTERS

WASHINGTON, Oct 6 : In ancient mythology, the phoenix was a miraculous bird with a cyclical pattern of life and death, perishing in flames only to rise again from the ashes. Astronomers have now found a world that rightly can be called a phoenix planet.
Researchers said this exoplanet, as planets beyond our solar system are called, appears to have been born from material expelled into space during the death throes of a star a bit bigger than the sun, and now orbits the highly compact stellar remnant that was left behind, called a white dwarf.
It is classified as a second-generation planet, meaning it did not form from the swirling disk of material surrounding a newborn star, as Earth and other first-generation planets did, but rather from the leftovers of a doomed star.
"This is the first example of a planet forming around a white dwarf," said Jamie Williams, a doctoral student in astrophysics at the University of Warwick in England and lead author of the study published this week in the journal Nature Astronomy.

The white dwarf is located about 250 light-years from Earth, near the constellation Cetus. A light-year is the distance light travels in a year, 5.9 trillion miles (9.5 trillion km).
The planet is a gas giant perhaps slightly more massive than Jupiter, our solar system's largest planet. It orbits the white dwarf every 4.4 days at only 4 per cent the distance between Earth and the sun. It is so close that the blazingly hot white dwarf's extreme ultraviolet radiation is causing the planet's outer atmosphere to evaporate, with a portion then falling into the white dwarf.
The planet's chemical pattern points to its second-generation origin. It is rich in niobium, copper and zinc, the type of elements that certain dying stars cast off when they expand in their death throes, indicating the planet formed from a disk of this expelled material that surrounded the stellar corpse.
"In myths, a phoenix is born again from its own ashes. In the case of this planet, it is born again from the ashes of its dying host star, and therefore the planetary system is reborn. A second-generation planet is defined as one born after its host star dies — in this case after it has become a white dwarf," Williams said.
The researchers used data from the orbiting Hubble, TESS and FUSE telescopes, and hope to use the James Webb Space Telescope to confirm their conclusions.
A small number of potential second-generation planets previously have been identified orbiting pulsars, a rare type of neutron star, another type of stellar remnant.
"White dwarfs are much more common than pulsars, and over 95 per cent of stars in the Milky Way will evolve to become a white dwarf. Therefore, there would be many more second-generation planets around white dwarfs than around pulsars," Williams said.
While the newly discovered planet would be inhospitable for life, another second-generation planet potentially could be habitable.
"If a gas giant formed around a white dwarf, then a rocky planet could form, too. White dwarfs cool predictably over time and as they get cooler, their cooling slows. So if a second-generation rocky planet formed close enough to the white dwarf then it could remain in the habitable zone for billions of years," Williams said.
A RED DWARF AND A BROWN DWARF
A second study published in the same journal describes another exotic celestial phenomenon roughly 300 to 500 light-years from Earth in the constellation Taurus.
Researchers used the Zwicky Transient Facility at Palomar Observatory in California to discover a red dwarf star about 8 per cent of the mass of the sun in a tight orbit with a brown dwarf, an object too small to be a star and too big to be a planet. The brown dwarf is about 30 times the mass of Jupiter and a third of the mass of the star.
These two companions orbit each other every 87 minutes at slightly more than half the distance between Earth and the moon, and the star's gravitational pull appears to be siphoning material from the brown dwarf. The researchers detected a hot spot on the star's surface where this material appears to be landing.
"This is the first observed example of this phenomenon," said Aaron Householder, a Massachusetts Institute of Technology graduate student in astrophysics and lead author of the study.
"The two objects are so close together that the entire orbit would fit inside the sun," Householder said.

Source: Reuters

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は６日に公表した研究報告書で、食料とエネルギー価格の急上昇は今後より頻繁に起こる可能性が高いと述べ、こうした危機はインフレ期待を長期にわたって高め、貧困を悪化させ、経済の安定を脅かすと警告した。

各国政府が物価高騰を緩和するために用いてきた３０年間の戦略を検証するとともに、生活必需品に家計のより大きな割合を費やす貧困層が経験する高いインフレ率を考慮した新たな経済モデルを提示。新しいモデルでは、標準的なインフレ指標との間に０．８％ポイントの乖離が見られ、２０２１年から２４年にかけて、以前の試算よりも２３００万人多い人々が極度の貧困ラインを下回ったことが示唆された。

研究を共同で主導したＩＭＦのエコノミスト、キアラ・マッジ氏は「要するに、生活費危機は物価安定に影響を与え、生活水準を低下させ、格差を悪化させる」と述べた。今回の研究は来週に公表される「世界経済見通し」の一部となる。

ジョージタウン大学教授で元世界銀行エコノミストのシャンタヤナン・デバラジャン氏は６日に公開されたマッジ氏とのビデオ対談の中で、原油価格の高騰、高水準の債務、借入コストの上昇、そして今年のスーパーエルニーニョ現象による影響が複合的に作用し、発展途上国は深刻な危機に直面していると指摘。「これは低所得国全体の成長率が過去最低水準にある時期に起こっている」とし、「成長率は著しく鈍化している」と語った。

items.title: US Senator Murphy says Pentagon denied him access to US base in Qatar
items.author: Timour Azhari
items.creator: Timour Azhari
items.summary: Democratic US Senator Chris Murphy said on Tuesday that the Department of Defense denied him access to a key military base in Qatar during a visit to the Middle East, describing it as part of a US government effort to conceal the impact of the Iran war.
items.body:
Democratic US Senator Chris Murphy said on Tuesday that the Department of Defense denied him access to a key military base in Qatar during a visit to the Middle East , describing it as part of a US government effort to conceal the impact of the Iran war .
The Al Udeid Air Base is the largest US base in the region and has repeatedly been attacked by Iran during the war launched by the US and Israel in February.
"This trip confirmed for me that there is an active, unprecedented, unconstitutional effort underway to hide the costs of this war and the implications of this war from Congress and the American people," Murphy told a group of journalists in Riyadh, the second stop on his trip.
Many members of Congress, including some of President Donald Trump's Republicans, have been pushing his administration to provide them with more information about the cost of the war, strategy and casualties.
Asked for comment, a senior Pentagon official said Murphy's office had been informed before his trip that he would not receive the department's support to access the base, consistent with Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth's March 3, 2026, directive restricting travel to the area.
"The Department applies the Secretary's guidance evenly," the official said in an emailed statement.
Murphy said that the Pentagon refused to set up a briefing for him on the war while he was in the region.
"I've never encountered anything like this in my time in the Senate and it's part of a deliberate campaign of obfuscation that my Republican colleagues in Congress should demand an end to," he said.
He said that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio had facilitated his visit, including arranging meetings with diplomats, a stance he contrasted with that of the Pentagon.
During his trip, Murphy, a member of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee who represents the state of Connecticut, met with Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad al Thani and with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman as well as other senior Gulf officials.

items.title: El euro repunta porque remite el temor por la deuda de Francia
items.author: Chuck Mikolajczak
items.creator: Chuck Mikolajczak
items.summary: El euro subió el martes, en camino a su mayor alza en siete semanas, tras haber caído en la sesión previa a su nivel más bajo en 17 meses, ya que el descenso del rendimiento de los bonos gubernamentales franceses atenuó el temor en los mercados de deuda de la zona euro.
items.body:
El euro subió el martes, en camino a su mayor alza en siete semanas, tras haber caído en la sesión previa a su nivel más bajo en 17 meses, ya que el descenso del rendimiento de los bonos gubernamentales franceses atenuó el temor en los mercados de deuda de la zona euro.
* La moneda única ganó un 0,35% , a 1,126 dólares, para su mayor subida diaria desde el 19 de agosto. El lunes tocó su mínimo desde mayo de 2025, a 1,116 dólares, tras un declive superior al 1% la semana pasada, su cuarto descenso semanal consecutivo.
* El índice dólar , que compara al billete verde con una cesta de seis destacadas monedas, bajó un 0,32%, a 101,83 unidades, en su mayor caída diaria desde el 3 de septiembre.
* Los rendimientos de los bonos han subido en los mercados mundiales por las expectativas de fuertes alzas de las tasas de interés, tras el repunte de los precios de la energía a raíz de la guerra en Irán, así como la preocupación sobre las finanzas públicas.
* La deuda francesa se ha visto sometida a una presión cada vez mayor, mientras los políticos luchan por limitar el déficit presupuestario de cara a las divisivas elecciones de 2027. La convocatoria de elecciones anticipadas en España se sumaba a la presión reciente sobre el euro.
* Los precios del crudo bajaron temprano, ya que el aumento de las exportaciones de crudo de Oriente Medio y la liberación de reservas de emergencia del G7 aliviaron las preocupaciones sobre el suministro.
* Asimismo, las fuerzas gubernamentales yemeníes respaldadas por Arabia Saudita llevaron a cabo el lunes un avance relámpago para recuperar la costa alrededor del estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb hasta la ciudad de Mocha, según informó el Gobierno.
* La libra esterlina subió un 0,42%, a 1,3275 dólares. Frente al yen, la moneda estadounidense avanzó un 0,11%, a 158,08 unidades.

items.title: New Maryland defense shipyard gets $6.6 billion commitment and Trump visit
items.author: Nathan Gomes, Shivansh Tiwary, Trevor Hunnicutt
items.creator: Nathan Gomes, Shivansh Tiwary, Trevor Hunnicutt
items.summary: Defense tech firm Anduril unveiled plans on Tuesday for a $3.7 billion shipyard in Maryland, and President Donald Trump was due to join an announcement ceremony for the project expected to generate 3,100 jobs and receive a $2.9 billion US Navy contract.
items.body:
Defense tech firm Anduril unveiled plans on Tuesday for a $3.7 billion shipyard in Maryland, and President Donald Trump was due to join an announcement ceremony for the project expected to generate 3,100 jobs and receive a $2.9 billion US Navy contract.
Anduril said the new high-tech shipyard at Sparrows Point, Maryland, near the Port of Baltimore would make components for the Navy's Virginia-class submarines.
The Navy on Tuesday awarded Anduril a $2.9 billion contract to manufacture submarine components including torpedo tubes and doors.
The investment and associated contract, together valued at up to $6.6 billion, come amid a broader push by the United States and its allies to expand arms production following Russia's invasion of Ukraine and conflicts in the Middle East.
The project puts Trump in rare alignment with a frequent critic, Maryland Governor Wes Moore, a Democrat who is seen as a potential 2028 presidential candidate.
Ahead of November's congressional elections, Trump is working to show that his policies have bolstered jobs and manufacturing while [USN:L6N45R10Y TEXT:"polls have shown"] that Trump's Republicans have lost voter support, largely over cost-of-living concerns.
The president has argued that his tariffs and industrial policy will revive US factory work, from steelmaking to shipbuilding. Anduril's location in Maryland was formerly home to a large steel mill that went through decades of financial decline and closed in bankruptcy in 2012.
Trump is touring the country in a pre-election blitz, announcing or claiming credit for a range of private-sector investments and government spending initiatives he has called "goodies."
The new plant, dubbed Arsenal-2, is expected to be operational by the end of the decade, creating 3,100 direct jobs and supporting over 11,000 indirect jobs.
Anduril is building another facility in California to manufacture Virginia-class submarine components and plans to expand into producing larger submarine modules and hull sections once its Baltimore shipyard becomes operational.
Virginia-class submarines, which can travel at over 25 knots, are the Navy's latest generation of nuclear-powered attack submarines, designed for anti-submarine warfare, land-attack strikes and surveillance missions.
General Dynamics' (GD.N) Electric Boat and Huntington Ingalls Industries (HII.N) jointly build the submarines.
Anduril, founded in 2017 by Palmer Luckey, is a defense firm that is best known for its autonomous systems, drones and software built for the US military and its allies.
Anduril's $1 billion [USN:L1N4070RY TEXT:"Arsenal-1 facility"] in Ohio began producing autonomous combat drones this year.

PARIS, Oct 6 : French AI startup Mistral unveiled a new AI model on Tuesday, ending a gap of about five months between major releases, and said it outperforms many rival open-weight models.
The three-year-old company, widely viewed as Europe's strongest AI challenger to US and Chinese competitors, has not released a new model since May. In August, it began offering third-party models to customers, starting with Beijing-based Z.ai's GLM 5.3.
"The model we're actually announcing today is actually above the Chinese models on certain aspects, including cyber. So the narrative that Europe cannot compete is something that is not true," CEO Artur Mensch said at a launch event in Abu Dhabi, without specifying which Chinese models or benchmarks he was referring to.
Mistral said Le Chonk, officially named Mistral Large 4, will be made publicly available on October 27.

Before the release, cybersecurity experts and government authorities will be given access to a version with fewer safety restrictions to test its capabilities, the company said.
Pierre Stock, Mistral's vice president of science, told Reuters that the model ranks among the strongest open-weight, systems available.
Open-weight means users can download the model from platforms and run it on their own hardware. Many Chinese models are open-weight, while top US models tend to be closed and accessible only through their developers' infrastructure.
SAFETY RISKS CONTAINED
Stock told Reuters the model had tried to go beyond its testing environment, but that this was expected and the company was able to prevent it.
OpenAI and Anthropic, whose most advanced models have demonstrated similar behaviour in testing, have restricted access to their most cyber-capable systems.
After executives at US AI companies warned last month that AI could pose an existential threat to humanity, Mensch dismissed such arguments as self-serving.
Mistral, which raised €3 billion ($3.4 billion) in its latest funding round, has positioned itself as a safer, European alternative.
'CLOSING THE GAP'
Mistral said Large 4 is "closing the gap with frontier models" in areas including coding, finance, geospatial analysis, manufacturing and product design.
The company trained the model on its own infrastructure.
Stock said Mistral's goal was to partner "very deeply" with backers including ASML and new-investor Samsung "across the entire value chain".
He said Large 4 is capable of designing computer chips, but declined to comment on whether Mistral is currently working with Samsung on chip development.

items.title: Sweden to deploy Patriot missiles to NATO hub in Poland
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Sweden's Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson said on Tuesday the Nordic country will deploy Patriot missile defence systems to eastern Poland to help protect the NATO logistics hub that supplies weapons to Ukraine.
items.body:
Sweden's Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson said on Tuesday the Nordic country will deploy Patriot missile defence systems to eastern Poland to help protect the NATO logistics hub that supplies weapons to Ukraine.
Sweden will replace Patriot support from the Netherlands and the operation will start in December. It will deploy around 100 military personnel from the air defence unit in Halmstad, the government said
Sweden [USN:L6N45M0TU TEXT:"last week announced"] that it was deploying Gripen fighter jets to Poland as part of a NATO airspace surveillance mission
"The task of both the Gripen deployment and the Patriot deployment is...to protect NATO's logistics hub in Poland at the airport," Kristersson said
Sweden declined to say how many Patriot system units would be sent to Poland
Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk [USN:L8N4590UT TEXT:"said last month"], citing unnamed intelligence agencies, that Russia plans to launch 'hybrid' drone and missile attacks against countries supporting Ukraine
Russia's President Vladimir Putin said last week that Russia had "no intention of attacking anyone...but if we are subjected to aggression, we will have no choice but to respond"
(This story has been refiled to replace an incorrect image.)

items.title: 北朝鮮、地雷爆発巡る韓国正式見解に反発　「重大な挑発」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kyu-seok Shim

［ソウル　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Kyu-seok Shim

［ソウル　６日　ロイター］ - 北朝鮮外務省は６日、南北境界地域の非武装地帯（ＤＭＺ）で韓国軍兵士２人が重傷を負った地雷爆発を巡る韓国の非難を一蹴し、領土を侵犯すれば「即時かつ強力な対抗措置」を取ると警告した。国営朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）が伝えた。

韓国軍は５日、ＤＭＺでの爆発は、北朝鮮が仕掛けた地雷によるものだと結論付ける調査結果を発表した。

北朝鮮外務省は、韓国軍の発表は、爆発を北朝鮮と結び付けて北朝鮮への外交・軍事的措置を正当化するための「計画的な茶番劇」だと指摘。調査結果は「重大な挑発」で北朝鮮の主権を侵害するものだと非難した。

「韓国の軍靴や火花がほんの１ミリでも国境を越えてわが領土を侵犯すれば、北朝鮮の国境警備部隊は即時かつ強力な対抗措置を取る」とした。

さらに、韓国が進める地雷除去作業には関知しないとし、韓国側で同様の事案が再び起きた場合、責任は全て韓国にあると警告した。

韓国国防省の報道官は６日、地雷爆発を巡り、北朝鮮に謝罪を迫る対応策を準備していると明らかにした。金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記の妹である金与正党総務部長は２日、韓国側の謝罪要求を退けている。

items.title: Paramount wraps up mega Warner Bros merger to create Hollywood powerhouse Skydance
items.author: Anzar Mehraj, Harshita Varghese
items.creator: Anzar Mehraj, Harshita Varghese
items.summary: Paramount Skydance on Tuesday completed its blockbuster $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros Discovery , creating a Hollywood heavyweight that hands CEO David Ellison control of one of the world's largest entertainment and news businesses.
items.body:
Paramount Skydance on Tuesday completed its blockbuster $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros Discovery (WBD.O) , creating a Hollywood heavyweight that hands CEO David Ellison control of one of the world's largest entertainment and news businesses.
The deal brings together the studios behind "Mission: Impossible," "Harry Potter" and DC Studios alongside major television and streaming networks such as CBS, CNN, Paramount+ and HBO Max — forming an expansive entertainment company spanning film, TV and news.
Ellison laid out his vision for the new company in a memo to employees on Tuesday in which he said the acquisition is "to build the next-generation media and entertainment company, powered by creativity and technology." The goal, he added, was not simply to get bigger but "to take on the biggest players in our industry."
The new company, called Skydance, is the latest iteration of a conglomerate once controlled by the late Sumner Redstone that has precipitously shrunk over the years, as audiences flock to news and entertainment delivered by a growing cadre of smaller publishers and creators chipping away at once-mighty Hollywood.
Skydance not only faces competition from Netflix, Disney and others, but also from tech giants Apple, Meta, and Amazon, as well as the growing threat of AI.
Shares of the combined company moved to the New York Stock Exchange from Nasdaq on Tuesday to trade under the ticker "SKYD."
[USN:L4N45D11C TEXT:"Settlements"] with a [USN:L4N45D112 TEXT:"coalition of US states"] and a Hollywood writers union removed the main legal barriers to the merger, one of the largest in media history. It comes as Hollywood faces declining cable-TV subscriptions, the high cost of competing for streaming audiences and persistent pressure from unions over jobs and creative workers' rights.
TRUMP'S CNN PROBLEM President Donald Trump expressed approval when asked about the deal. "It's going to be a great company," he told reporters . "That's a great merger. I'm glad they let it go."
Trump has attacked news organizations since his first term and recently took the unprecedented step of [USN:L8N45A1OV TEXT:"banning several news outlets"] from the White House, including CNN. The move came weeks ahead of the November 3 midterm elections in which Trump's fellow Republicans are defending narrow majorities in Congress.
CNN chief Mark Thompson and CBS News Editor-in-Chief Bari Weiss [USN:L4N45R0RX TEXT:"will continue"] in their respective leadership roles in the new company and each will separately report to Ellison and Kreiz, allaying [USN:L1N42I0HA TEXT:"concerns from critics"] that Weiss, who took over as CBS News editor-in-chief in 2025, would have greater control over all of Skydance's news operations.
The concerns are also fueled by [USN:L1N43G107 TEXT:"lawmakers' criticism of Ellison"] for tailoring news coverage at Paramount-owned CBS News to favor Trump. As part of the settlement, Ellison agreed to create an editorial independence board to oversee CNN and CBS. Experts warn that the board will be "[USN:L4N45E0EO TEXT:"toothless"]."
Ellison [USN:L6N45R0UG TEXT:"said last week"] the Skydance name was chosen to retain the individual identities of Paramount and Warner Bros studios, rather than combining them under a new brand.
Wall Street analysts, however, said the name reinforces the extent of Ellison's control, highlighting how some of Hollywood's most iconic brands now answer to him and how he has a platform to impose his strategy and culture.
In just 16 years, Skydance has gone from an independent studio to the center of one of Hollywood's biggest power plays. Founded in 2010 by the son of Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison, it built its reputation as a financial backer and producer of Paramount's blockbuster "Top Gun: Maverick."
After [USN:L4N3TZ1NM TEXT:"merging with"] Paramount last year, Skydance set its sights on Warner Bros, entering a heated bidding contest with Netflix (NFLX.O) while drawing interest from other potential suitors, including Comcast (CMCSA.O) .
Warner Bros shareholders received an additional $41.9 million in a "ticking fee," based on the number of days between September-end and the deal-closing, according to a regulatory filing.
BROADER HOLLYWOOD BET Ellison named Mattel's former CEO Ynon Kreiz as Skydance co-CEO to run day-to-day operations and lead the integration, while Ellison oversees creative direction and overall strategy.
In bringing on Kreiz, Ellison has signaled the [USN:L4N45N0LV TEXT:"need for a cost-cutter"]. The duo faces the task of combining two large companies while delivering $6 billion in planned savings, a big part of which Paramount said would come from "non-labor sources."
That includes combining technology and cloud providers of the two companies, but the scale of the cuts is expected to affect jobs across Hollywood.
Skydance plans to combine its streaming services, including HBO Max and Paramount+, into a single service and has [USN:L1N45D0VR TEXT:"pledged to release at least 30 films"] each in the first two years after closing, rising to 32 a year for the following three.
The combined company is also expected to carry about $80 billion in debt, putting pressure on Ellison to grow streaming, preserve cash flow from cable networks and improve theatrical film performance.
Analysts at MoffettNathanson forecast profit, or EBITDA, of $16 billion for 2028 and rising to $19 billion in 2030. The research firm also predicted about $67 billion in revenue in 2028, growing to roughly $70 billion in 2030.
Ellison's annual base salary will be $5 million, with a target annual bonus of $5 million, according to the filing.

Oct 6 : German software company SAP said on Tuesday it had agreed to buy TechWolf, a Belgian company that analyses workforce data to map employees' skills and tasks, for an undisclosed sum.
The deal gives SAP a view of its customers' workforces that its own HR software lacks, at a time when companies reorganise around AI and need to know which skills they have and which they are losing.
• SAP expects to close the acquisition in the fourth quarter, subject to regulatory approval
• It plans to make TechWolf the core of its workforce software for planning hiring, retraining and reorganisation
