items.title: Euroleague shareholders reject NBA Europe offer, door open for future talks
items.author: Elvira Pollina
items.creator: Elvira Pollina
items.summary: Euroleague shareholder clubs rejected a collaboration offer from the NBA on Tuesday, according to sources familiar with the discussions, raising the prospect of a battle for the continent's biggest teams, players and commercial riches.
items.body:
Euroleague shareholder clubs rejected a collaboration offer from the NBA on Tuesday, according to sources familiar with the discussions, raising the prospect of a battle for the continent's biggest teams, players and commercial riches.
The door on a deal has yet to be closed though.
The Euroleague said in a statement that its 13 shareholder clubs had agreed to convert into franchises, a change that would turn their current licences into a more lasting stake in the league. The clubs did not, however, take a formal decision on expanding the competition from 20 to 24 teams.
Regarding Euroleague's expansion plan, a person attending the meeting told Reuters the decision on allocating additional long-term licences would be taken within the next month.
The source said the Euroleague was keen to move ahead with expansion and attention will now be on whether the NBA submits a fresh proposal before those calls are made.
Up to eight additional long-term licences could be awarded. The remaining places would be filled through a combination of short-term licences, wildcards and sporting qualification through the BKT EuroCup.
A senior sports executive told Reuters any collaboration between Euroleague and the NBA was unlikely before 2028 because of the difficulty of organising a new competition in time for the 2027-28 season.
Representatives of the 13 permanent shareholder clubs met near Lake Como to discuss the expansion plan, with the prospect of an agreement with the NBA dominating discussions around the future of European basketball.
The Euroleague did not mention the widely reported NBA offer in its statement, but told Reuters last Friday it remained open to collaboration. Although the clubs rejected the current proposal, talks with the NBA could continue.
Reuters was not immediately able to confirm the details of the NBA's offer but media reports said it would have seen the NBA's continental expansion project merge with Euroleague.
The NBA did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. NBA Europe's managing director, George Aivazoglou, is due to speak at a conference in London on Thursday.
The rejection is a significant setback to attempts to unite Europe’s established elite basketball competition with the financial and commercial power of the NBA, which plans to launch a 16-team NBA Europe league in 2027.
SURGE OF INTEREST The NBA has stepped up its push into Europe amid a surge of interest in the sport, with Euroleague reporting in May an 82% increase in TV viewership through the first 25 regular-season rounds of the 2025-26 campaign.
The NBA has also enjoyed growing momentum on the continent. Streaming deals with providers like Amazon Prime have boosted audiences for the NBA in Europe, while regular-season games in Berlin and London this year highlighted the league's growing appeal.
Viewership of January's clash between Orlando Magic and Memphis Grizzlies in London was up 90% compared to the last NBA game there in 2019.
A report from JB Capital commissioned by the Euroleague values the competition at €1.41 billion ($1.59 billion), while the aggregate value of its licensed teams was put at approximately €1.8 billion.
Those figures pale in comparison to the NBA.
The NBA recently surpassed Major League Baseball to become the world's second-richest sports league, according to Sports Value, a marketing and valuation agency, with upwards of $14 billion in revenue during the 2025-26 season.
The NBA and Euroleague have said throughout this year that they would like to work together on a new competition, but each has also made clear it is prepared to pursue its own plans if no agreement is reached.
No deadline has been set for a deal, although the sides have indicated they want greater clarity by the end of the season.
($1 = 0.8883 euros)

FAST

The United States has discussed starting reciprocal visits to nuclear sites with China, and plans to continue pushing in meetings in the coming months, CNN reported on Tuesday (Oct 6), citing sources familiar with the matter.

The idea of reciprocal visits was initially raised by China in meetings with US officials this year and visits to US Department of Energy national laboratories and equivalent Chinese facilities were discussed, CNN said, citing a source.

The discussions between US and Chinese officials have mainly been on the sidelines of gatherings by the UN Security Council's five veto-wielding permanent members, CNN reported.

Reuters could not immediately verify the report. The White House and the Chinese embassy in Washington did not respond to requests for comment outside business hours.

US President Donald Trump called for trilateral arms control negotiations between the US, China and Russia when he met President Xi Jinping last month. However, the two leaders did not discuss the possibility of nuclear site visits during their talks, the CNN report said, citing a US official.

Beijing has said its nuclear arsenal is far smaller than those of Russia and the US, something it says makes its participation in such talks unnecessary.

Another meeting between Trump and Xi is widely considered likely this year, potentially at November's Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in China or during Group of 20 meetings in the US in December.

By the time the two leaders meet again, it is expected that further lower-level discussions on possible nuclear site visits will have taken place, CNN said.

FAST

Oct 6 : Tereina, a payments company in which SAP owns a stake, on Tuesday launched technology that lets businesses pay suppliers, employees and affiliates directly from their SAP software in traditional currencies or stablecoins.
The launch introduces a payments layer inside business software that companies already use to track their money. Until now, SAP had stopped short of payments and let customers connect their own providers, Tereina CEO Cedric Bru said, while declining to disclose the size of SAP's stake in the company.
• SAP customers can subscribe to the new SAP Pay services under existing contracts
• Bru compares the offering to Apple Pay as a payment service native to the system it runs in

OpenAI to watermark ChatGPT text in EU. Claude users in India already getting marked output

ChatGPT users outside EU won’t see any change, company says regional rollout would allow it to learn from real-world use and feedback, even as Anthropic goes whole hog with Claude.

Vrinda Tulsian

06 October, 2026 05:02 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

OpenAI will start adding an invisible watermark to text generated by ChatGPT in EU | Representational file photo | Reuters

Follow Us :

Text Size:
A-
A+

-->

New Delhi: OpenAI will start adding an invisible watermark to text generated by ChatGPT and Codex for users in the European Union (EU), the company announced on Monday. The step is aimed at complying with the EU Artificial Intelligence (AI) Act, which requires AI companies to make generated content identifiable by machines.

According to OpenAI, the watermark will be rolled out to eligible ChatGPT and Codex users across all plans in the EU “over the coming weeks”. Developers using OpenAI’s API anywhere in the world, including India, can turn on watermarking for select models from Monday, though the feature will remain off by default. Access to the tool that detects the watermark will, for now, be restricted to approved researchers and expert organisations.

ChatGPT users outside the EU will not see any change. “We are not making text watermarking a global default at launch,” the company said in a blog post, adding that the regional rollout would allow it to learn from real-world use and feedback.

Show Full Article

What EU law says
Article 50 of the EU AI Act, which came into effect on 2 August, requires providers of generative AI systems to mark text, images, audio and video in a machine-readable format so that they can be detected as AI-generated. Violations of the Act’s transparency obligations can attract fines of up to €15 million or 3 per cent of a company’s global annual turnover, whichever is higher.

In June, the European Commission published a voluntary Code of Practice laying down how companies can meet these requirements. Signatories are presumed to be in compliance with the law. Anthropic has said that around 190 organisations have signed the code. The rules also require deepfakes and AI-generated text published on matters of public interest to be labelled, and users to be informed when they are interacting with a chatbot.

OpenAI said access to its detector would be granted on a case-by-case basis “in accordance with the Code of Practice”.

Also Read: ‘I am Giorgia’: Ahead of polls, Italy PM Meloni wants voice trademarked before AI puts words in her mouth

How the watermark works
OpenAI’s system, called textGrain, works by embedding a statistical pattern in the words a model chooses while writing a response. Language models generate text one word at a time, and at many points, more than one word fits the sentence equally well. Normally, the choice between them is random. A watermark replaces this randomness with a pattern linked to a secret key, which a detector can later look for.

The company said the watermark does not add any visible marks or special characters to the text. It also does not identify the user, organisation, account, prompt or conversation.

In its post, OpenAI framed the purpose narrowly, saying the watermark helps answer a single question: “Was this likely generated by an OpenAI model?”

Where it falls short
OpenAI also published data on the system’s limitations. At a target false positive rate of 1 per cent, its detector identified the watermark in about 80 per cent of 200-token passages and about 95 per cent of 400-token passages on psychology-related content. Detection rates were lower for mathematics, where the model has fewer options in word choice.

Editing the text weakened the signal. In 400-token passages, replacing 10 per cent of the words with synonyms brought detection down from about 92 per cent to 66 per cent. When 25 per cent of the words were replaced, it fell to 17 per cent.

“Rewriting or translating text can completely remove the watermark,” the company said.

OpenAI claimed textGrain “matched or exceeded” the other methods it tested, including Google’s SynthID for text, but cautioned that results under test conditions may not hold in everyday use. On output quality, the company said watermarking did not affect the performance of Astra, its latest frontier model. On the GPQA Diamond benchmark, Astra scored 94.44 per cent without the watermark and 93.94 per cent with it. On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, the scores were 49.57 and 49.76 points respectively.

OpenAI also listed what a detection result cannot establish. It does not indicate how much a human edited the text, who owns it, who is responsible for it, or whether it is accurate. Equally, the absence of a watermark does not prove a human wrote the text, since it may be too short, edited, translated, produced by an older model or generated by another company’s tool.

Also Read: What is Griffin AI? World’s first ‘human interaction model’ passes Turing Test

Anthropic’s approach
Anthropic took a different route. In a post published on 14 August, the company said all Claude models released after 2 August embed a watermark in the text they generate, and that the change applies worldwide with no option for users to switch it off. This means Claude users in India are already receiving watermarked text from newer models.

Anthropic said it applied the watermark globally because it does “not yet have a durable way to scope it by region”, and that it would continue to evaluate other approaches.

Its method is based on SynthID-Text, a technique Google DeepMind described in a paper published in Nature in 2024. Anthropic said the watermark does not affect the quality of Claude’s responses, does not add hidden characters, does not use extra tokens and carries no information that could be traced to a user or a conversation.

The company acknowledged similar limitations. The watermark is weaker in code, factual passages and light proofreading, where most of the words belong to the user, and a complete rewrite removes it. Translations done by Claude, however, carry the watermark since every word is chosen by the model.

Anthropic has made a detection tool available in private preview to regulators, law enforcement agencies, media organisations, fact-checkers, researchers, educational institutions and EU civil society groups. Image files generated by Claude now carry a signed credential in their metadata under the C2PA industry standard. The company said older Claude models will get the watermark over the coming months.

Google DeepMind added SynthID-Text to Gemini in 2024 and released the code as open source for developers. According to Anthropic, Google tested the watermark on a section of Gemini users and found no difference in how they rated the responses.

A shift for OpenAI
The announcement marks a change in OpenAI’s position. In 2024, the company said it had developed a text watermarking method but was not releasing it, citing concerns that it could be bypassed through translation or rewording, and that it could unfairly affect non-native English speakers who use AI tools to improve their writing.

On Monday, OpenAI said its approach “must reflect the practical limits of current technology”. The company said it will extend watermarking to its models offered through cloud partners in the coming weeks, publish more technical details on textGrain and eventually release it as open source.

“We expect to revisit each part of this approach as the technology, standards, and evidence evolve,” OpenAI said.

(Edited by Nardeep Singh Dahiya)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [モスクワ／シェレホフ（ロシア）　６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ／シェレホフ（ロシア）　６日　ロイター] - ロシアの衛生監視機関である消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁（ロスポトレブナゾール）は６日、２日に死亡したシベリアのペスト研究所職員と接触した人の間で、ペストの発症例は確認されていないと発表した。

ロシアでは、東シベリアのイルクーツク近郊にあるシベリア・極東ペスト対策研究所に勤めていた２８歳の女性研究員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡。この件を巡っては、トランプ米大統領を含む国際社会から懸念の声が上がっている。

ロスポトレブナゾールは声明で、同研究所の職員の間で過去１０日間に感染症の報告はなく、詳しい検査でも死亡した女性の体内から業務に関連する微生物は見つからなかったと発表。公衆衛生関連法に基づき包括的な防疫措置を直ちに実施し、患者と接触した可能性のある人を病院での医学観察下で検査を毎日実施した結果、接触者の中に感染症に関連する健康状態の変化がみられた者はいなかったと明らかにした。

イルクーツク近郊シェレホフ地区のソフィナ副地区長も、危険な感染症は確認されなかったと述べた。同地区では地元の病院が隔離措置の対象となっているが、隔離された人の約６０％はすでに解除されたという。

FAST

LONDON, Oct 6 : US start-up Type One Energy has raised $200 million from investors including the venture unit of Germany's Siemens Energy, as it vies to build the world's first commercial fusion reactor, its chief executive told Reuters.
The Series-B round, which takes total funding to-date to more than $400 million, is the third-biggest sector Series B raise over the last five years, data from industry tracker PitchBook showed. The company did not disclose its valuation.
Fusion energy has been researched for decades. A wave of firms has launched in recent years as advances in magnets, computing and materials have fuelled hopes fusion technology could one day provide abundant clean power across the globe.
Type One is backed by Bill Gates' Breakthrough Energy Ventures and Clutterbuck Capital. It is developing a stellarator, a type of fusion reactor that uses complex magnetic fields to contain superheated plasma, partnering with engineering, construction and other companies to speed up delivery and reduce costs.

Chief Executive Christofer Mowry said the funds would help further develop its technology, including the deployment of an engineering prototype machine, Infinity One.
"It's not an experimental science project... the only thing that we want to learn is that our design for the fusion machine in the power plant works as advertised."
Project Infinity is based at Bull Run in Tennessee and Type One hopes to launch the commercial plant, Infinity Two, within a decade. It aims to work towards a manufacturing partnership with Siemens.
Enrique Gonzalez Zanetich, partner at Siemens Energy Ventures, said in a statement that the deal strengthened his company's position in fusion "as we continue to explore the technologies and collaborations that can help advance commercialization".
New investors alongside Siemens included Lowercarbon Capital, co-founded by early Uber backer Chris Sacca, and SiteGround Capital.

items.title: Becton Dickinson pledges $19 billion US investment in deal with government
items.author: Siddhi Mahatole
items.creator: Siddhi Mahatole
items.summary: Becton Dickinson became the first major US medical device company to strike a deal with the government to expand its domestic manufacturing, pledging $19 billion over several years in return for shelter from future tariffs.
items.body:
Becton Dickinson (BDX.N) became the first major US medical device company to strike a deal with the government to expand its domestic manufacturing, pledging $19 billion over several years in return for shelter from future tariffs.
Under the agreement, the company on Tuesday said it plans to make capital, operational and supply chain investments in the US, with $3 billion earmarked for strategic manufacturing sites across the country.
Shares of the medical device maker were up 2.4% in morning trading.
The deal follows the Trump administration's [USN:L4N3TZ1L7 TEXT:"push"] to use tariff threats to spur domestic healthcare manufacturing, with [USN:L4N4470VR TEXT:"major drugmakers already pledging billions"] for new and expanded US production and research facilities.
The agreement ties BD's US manufacturing commitments to relief from future tariffs on covered products and inputs under Section 232, subject to the final scope of the measures and the company meeting agreed milestones.
"We think tariff clarity or the potential for levies to be 'less bad' than feared could be a clearing event for MedTech," said Jefferies analyst Mathew Taylor, adding "we wonder if there are more MedTech announcements in the works."
The company plans to expand US production by about 5 billion essential medical consumables annually, raising the share it supplies domestically to roughly 80%.
It also plans to manufacture all needles used in the US domestically using American-made steel.
Becton Dickinson said it was not currently quantifying the financial impact of the agreement because the final tariff rates, product scope and timing have not yet been determined.
The announcement builds on President Donald Trump's [USN:L1N45S036 TEXT:"statement on Monday"] that the company had agreed to invest $3 billion to bring manufacturing of essential medical products to the United States, with more than $1 billion going to Nebraska.
In January, Becton announced a $110 million investment in Columbus, Nebraska, to expand prefillable syringe and cannula production, adding about 120 jobs, with syringe production expected to begin supplying customers in mid-2026.

Google enters massive 3.6-GW power deal with Constellation Energy

NEW YORK, Oct 6 : Google has contracted for 3,590 megawatts of power from Constellation Energy in the largest US power grid, with new nuclear energy accounting for about a quarter of that supply, the companies said on Tuesday.
Constellation will make more than $4.3 billion of new investments in its fleet as part of the agreement, which involves adding capacity at several of the power company's nuclear reactors in the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, the companies said.
Major tech companies are racing to secure massive amounts of electricity supplies to power data centers across the US by striking unprecedented power deals and reviving the country's nuclear industry.
Over the last two years, Constellation unveiled an agreement to restart its Three Mile Island reactor in Pennsylvania to serve Microsoft data centers, while Google contracted to restart NextEra Energy's nuclear power plant in Iowa.

In the latest arrangement, Google entered into a 20-year power purchase agreement for 890 megawatts of electricity from multiple Constellation-owned nuclear power plants, which would be upgraded to produce more electricity from existing reactors.
Electricity from the first of the upgraded plants is expected to be delivered in 2028, the companies said.
Google also entered into a 15-year supply agreement for an additional 2,700 megawatts of power from Constellation in the PJM power grid. That power is not tied to a specific generation source and serves as long-term revenue certainty for Constellation's operating plants, Google said.
Shares of Constellation were up by more than 13 per cent on Tuesday to $304.04 by mid-morning.
Maryland-based Constellation is the largest US nuclear power plant operator and owns a major fleet of natural-gas-fired power plants as well as geothermal energy following its acquisition of electricity producer Calpine Corp earlier this year.
"We’re committed to meeting our growth responsibly by actively investing in clean, reliable power that brings new capacity to our nation's grids," said Amanda Peterson Corio, Google's global head of energy and power, in a statement. 
The 11 nuclear units expected to be upgraded as part of the arrangement with Google are in Illinois, Pennsylvania, and New Jersey, within the footprint of the largest US electric grid - PJM Interconnection. 
Rising electricity demand driven largely by the data center expansion has contributed to a more than 11-fold increase in PJM capacity prices since 2024 and left the grid with a power shortfall.
In response, PJM management has proposed requiring data center customers connected to the 13-state grid to either bring their own power or face being shut off from grid power remotely in times of peak demand.
The deal between Google and Constellation is in response to PJM's "bring your own power" proposal. It also creates a "practical model for how major power consumers can expand new supply alongside growing operational requirements, without state or federal mandates," the companies said. 
Google and Constellation also agreed on a strategic framework that can be replicated to develop power generation, battery storage, and a flexible power use model known as "demand response" in other parts of the US, the companies said.
Joe Dominguez, chairman, president and CEO of Constellation, said the arrangement with Google is a "model for how technology companies and the energy industry can work together to responsibly develop the digital economy and invest in our nation’s energy infrastructure in a way that delivers grid-wide benefits for all, funded by private entities."

Source: Reuters

AI pathology lab tools lack public evidence, doctors don’t know how well they work

A new study of 77 AI and machine-learning-based diagnostic software devices found that performance evidence was publicly available for only 30 products.

Vitasta Kaul

06 October, 2026 03:59 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

FILE PHOTO: The words "AI Artificial Intelligence," a keyboard and a robotic hand are shown in this illustration created on June 5, 2026. | REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Follow Us :

Text Size:
A-
A+

-->

New Delhi: AI is making its way into pathology labs, where software can help detect cancer, analyse tissue samples and classify blood cells. But doctors deciding whether to use these tools may have little public evidence to tell them how well they actually work.

A new study of 77 AI and machine-learning-based diagnostic software devices found that performance evidence was publicly available for only 30 products, or 39 per cent of them. For the other 47, researchers could not find publicly accessible, device-specific evidence showing how accurately they performed.

Published in npj Digital Medicine , the study examined software authorised for digital pathology and haematology morphology in the European Union and the US. The products were designed for tasks including tissue assessment, cancer detection, biomarker scoring and blood-cell analysis. Researchers searched regulatory databases, scientific literature, conference proceedings and manufacturer websites.

Show Full Article

Of the 77 devices, 68 were designed for digital pathology and nine for analysing blood or bone-marrow cell morphology. All had entered the European market through either the current In Vitro Diagnostic Regulation (IVDR) or the older In Vitro Diagnostic Directive (IVDD). Only eight were authorised in both the EU and US.

The evidence gap was particularly large among products sold only in Europe. All eight devices authorised in both jurisdictions had publicly available performance evidence, compared with just 22 of the 69 EU-only devices, about 32 per cent.

That does not necessarily mean the remaining devices have never been tested. Manufacturers may hold validation data in technical files or submit it to notified bodies without making it public. But researchers said this lack of transparency makes it harder for clinicians, laboratory directors and procurement teams to independently assess whether a product is appropriate for their patients and workflows.

The evidence that was available was also difficult to compare. The 30 products with public data reported 15 different types of performance measures, including sensitivity, specificity, agreement, correlation and prognostic outcomes. Studies differed in the clinical tasks they examined, the samples used, reference standards and comparison groups.

Most of the studies were retrospective: 25 of the 30. For 28 devices where researchers could extract sample sizes, the median study size was 211 patients, slides or specimens. More than half involved fewer than 300 units.

Also read: Mumbai came to pull apart an 85,000-brick Lego wall. Then a govt visit cut the event short

Needs more testing 
There was also limited evidence on whether AI actually improves doctors’ performance. Only five devices had studies directly comparing pathologists working with and without AI assistance. All reported some improvement with AI, although the size and statistical significance of the gains varied. In one study, the time taken to read prostate biopsy cases fell from 55.7 seconds to 36.8 seconds with AI assistance.

The researchers called for more consistent reporting of AI performance, including complementary measures such as sensitivity and specificity. They also recommended more prospective, multicentre studies that test these tools in real clinical workflows.

For pathology labs, then, regulatory approval may be only the starting point. It can establish that a product meets market-access requirements, but the study suggests it does not necessarily give doctors enough publicly available information to decide whether an AI tool is reliable, useful or worth adopting.

(Edited by Ratan Priya)

items.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq reach record closing highs as focus pivots to earnings
items.author: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.summary: US stocks ended higher on Tuesday as crude prices steadied and US Treasury yields eased, offering some reprieve from concerns that have preoccupied investors in recent weeks, and allowing markets to turn their attention to the approaching third-quarter reporting season.
items.body:
US stocks ended higher on Tuesday as crude prices steadied and US Treasury yields eased, offering some reprieve from concerns that have preoccupied investors in recent weeks, and allowing markets to turn their attention to the approaching third-quarter reporting season.
The broad rally pushed the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq to all-time closing highs.
The blue-chip Dow remains just over 5% shy of its record closing level reached on August 5.
When oil prices stabilize or move lower, "that causes yields to move down because there's less anxiety about energy-driven inflation, which in turn is helping lift stocks higher," said Oliver Pursche, senior vice president at Wealthspire Advisors in New York. "This has been the narrative of the market for the last couple of weeks."
Six of the "Magnificent Seven" group of AI-linked megacap firms advanced, bolstering gains, while small-caps (.RUT) lagged their larger-cap counterparts.
The AI trade is very much alive, with the Philadelphia SE Semiconductor Index (.SOX) gaining ground. Expenditures on AI-related infrastructure were reflected in international trade data, which showed imports of capital goods rose by 4.4% in August.
The Commerce Department's report showed the [USN:L1N45S0IV TEXT:"US trade deficit"] grew by 13.7% as imports rose to a record high. On monthly and annual bases, imports have grown by 4.3% and 28.4%, respectively, reflecting robust domestic demand that could exacerbate inflation pressures, particularly amid war-related supply constraints.
Even so, financial markets are currently pricing in a diminishing probability of 19.4% that the US Federal Reserve will implement its second consecutive rate hike at this month's monetary policy meeting, down from 50.9% a week ago, according to CME's FedWatch tool.
Fed rate hike bets have been responsive to [USN:L1N45S05E TEXT:"oil prices"], which have surged amid the Iran war, threatening to morph into broader price pressures. But supply worries eased after the Group of Seven countries reached an agreement to release emergency diesel and crude stockpiles, helping to stabilize front-month WTI and Brent crude futures.
"We don't expect (the Fed) to do anything at the next meeting," said Tim Ghriskey, senior portfolio strategist at Ingalls & Snyder in New York. "But I think they're in a gradual hiking cycle."
"High oil prices have hit a broad range of consumers," Ghriskey added. "That's one of the reasons for the recent Fed hike."
The Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 253.14 points, or 0.49%, to 51,521.04, the S&P 500 (.SPX) gained 45.00 points, or 0.58%, to 7,818.95 and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) gained 122.48 points, or 0.45%, to 27,599.79.
Of the 11 major sectors in the S&P 500, all but healthcare (.SPXHC) gained ground, with utilities (.SPLCRU) leading the way.
Third-quarter earnings season kicks off next week, with a number of high-profile financial firms expected to report next Tuesday.
Analysts currently expect annual S&P 500 earnings growth of 30.6%, in aggregate, for the July-to-September period, led by an expected 114.7% jump in energy earnings, followed by a 66.5% estimated surge in tech results, according to LSEG.
Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) climbed 5.8% following the [USN:L6N45S0Y5 TEXT:"chip designer's"] 2028 revenue forecast hike due to strong demand for its data center chips.
Chipmaker AMD (AMD.O) gained 2.8% after CEO Lisa Su said [USN:L6N45S09C TEXT:"it plans"] to substantially increase its chip supply in 2027 to meet booming AI demand.
Constellation Energy (CEG.O) jumped 12.3% after Alphabet (GOOGL.O) entered into a 3,590-megawatt power [USN:L6N45S04O TEXT:"deal"] with the company.
Option Care Health (OPCH.O) soared 32.7% after drug distributor McKesson (MCK.N) and private equity firm Clayton Dubilier & Rice [USN:L4N45S0SZ TEXT:"agreed to buy"] the infusion therapy provider in a deal worth about $5.8 billion, including debt.
Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 1.93-to-1 ratio on the New York Stock Exchange. There were 258 new highs and 219 new lows on the NYSE.
On the Nasdaq, 2,394 stocks rose and 2,378 fell as advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 1.01-to-1 ratio.
The S&P 500 posted 23 new 52-week highs and 2 new lows while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 61 new highs and 182 new lows.
Volume on US exchanges was 16.50 billion shares, compared with the 17.51 billion average for the full session over the last 20 trading days.

items.title: 米中、核施設相互視察を協議　中国が提案とＣＮＮ報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［６日　ロイター］ - 米ＣＮＮは６日、米国が中国との間で核施設相互視察の開始について協議しており、今後数カ月の間に予定されている対面会談でも、その実現に向けて引き続き働きかけていく方針だと報じた。

ＣＮＮが関係筋の話として伝えたところによると、相互訪問の構想は今年行われた米中当局者の協議で中国側が提起し、米エネルギー省傘下の国立研究所や中国の同等施設への訪問が検討された。米中当局者協議は主に、国連安全保障理事会常任理事国の会合の合間に行われてきたという。

トランプ米大統領は先月、中国の習近平国家主席と会談した際、米中ロ３カ国による軍備管理交渉を呼びかけた。中国はかねて、自国の核戦力はロシアや米国に比べてはるかに小さく、そうした協議への参加は不要だとの立場を示している。

ＣＮＮは、米政府当局者の話として、両首脳が会談で核施設訪問の可能性について協議しなかったと伝えた。その上で、両首脳が再会談するまでに、核施設訪問の可能性を巡る実務レベルの協議がさらに行われる見通しだとした。

トランプ氏と習近平国家主席の年内の再会談は公算が大きいと広く見られており、１１月に中国で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議、または１２月に米国で開かれる２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）会合の機会に行われる可能性がある。

items.title: TSX climbs to 11-day high as bond yields ease
items.author: Avinash P, Fergal Smith
items.creator: Avinash P, Fergal Smith
items.summary: Canada's main stock index rose to an 11-day high on Tuesday, led by utilities and metal mining shares, as the recent sell-off in the global bond market eased and after a deal which will create one of Canada's top power providers.
items.body:
Canada's main stock index rose to an 11-day high on Tuesday, led by utilities and metal mining shares, as the recent sell-off in the global bond market eased and after a deal which will create one of Canada's top power providers.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) ended up 130.96 points, or 0.4%, at 35,649.51, its highest closing level since September 25.
[USN:L1N45S0RM TEXT:"US Treasuries rebounded"] after a sharp selloff in the previous session pushed long-term yields to multi-decade highs, as investors paused to assess recent moves ahead of next week's inflation data, which could offer fresh clues on the path of interest rates.
"I'd be focused more on interest rates, the 10-year yield in the United States, than I would be on energy prices, although they're related," said Matt Skipp, president at SW8 Asset Management.
"A moderating oil price seems to have the potential to lower yields, as investors worry less about inflation," Skipp added.
Lower bond yields tend to increase the attractiveness of high-dividend paying utilities stocks, with the sector rising 1.3%.
[USN:L4N45S0P5 TEXT:"Emera"] (EMA.TO) said it would buy peer Canadian Utilities (CU.TO) for C$14.3 billion ($10.02 billion) in stock, strengthening its financial muscle as power companies ramp up investments to tap into booming demand.
ATCO (ACOx.TO) , which holds nearly 37% of the outstanding non-voting shares and all outstanding voting shares of Canadian Utilities, said it will separate into a publicly traded industrial services company.
Emera shares fell 2.9%, Canadian Utilities was down nearly 2% and ATCO ended 9.2% higher.
The materials sector (.GSPTTMT) , which includes metal mining shares, added 0.4% as the price of gold recovered from an earlier two-month low to increase 0.7%.
US crude oil futures settled up 1 cent at $89.44 a barrel after earlier touching a five-week low at $86.86.
Energy (.SPTTEN) fell 0.6%, while industrials (.GSPTTIN) were down 0.7% as railroad shares lost ground.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 来日中のデービッド・マコーミック米上院議員は６日、都内で記者団の取材に応じ、日米両国が合意した５５００億ドル（約８７兆円）の対米投融資について、米国の製造業再生や日本の米市場へのアクセス獲得に加え、サプライチェーン（供給網）を中国から切り替えることで日米両国の対中依存度を低下させる効果があると述べた。

一方、マコーミック氏は中国が経済、軍事的に世界のリーダーの座を争う「敵対国」だとする一方、「共通点を探る努力は必要だ」と指摘。日本について「（世界有数の経済大国で）非常に重要な国だ。そして中国と同じ地域にあり、両国が対話を続けるのは理にかなったことだ」と話した。トランプ大統領と習近平国家主席の最近の会談に触れ、トランプ氏と高市早苗首相は「極めて緊密な関係にある」として米国の後押しで日中対話が進むことに期待を示した。

マコーミック氏は、日本製鉄が買収した米鉄鋼大手ＵＳスチールの本社があるペンシルベニア州選出。「ペンシルベニアにとっても米国にとっても、日本にとっても素晴らしい案件だと確信し、ホワイトハウスに行き、大統領執務室で大統領と会ってこの案件を支持するよう働きかけた」と振り返った。

同委員会は５人のメンバーで構成される。事務局長は候補に関する資料をまとめ、審議に参加するが、投票権はない。今年の受賞者発表は９日に行われる。

ハルプビケン氏は５日のインタビューで、世界が激動しているからといって、候補が不足しているわけでも、平和賞がその意義を失っているわけでもないと指摘。「賞そのものについては心配していないが、世界がどこへ向かっているのかについては懸念している」と付け加えた。

items.title: 「ニュートリノマン」にノーベル物理学賞、南極での国際研究事業主導
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ストックホルム　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ストックホルム　６日　ロイター］ - スウェーデン王立科学アカデミーは６日、２０２６年のノーベル物理学賞を、ベルギー出身の素粒子物理学者フランシス・ハルツェン氏（米ウィスコンシン大学マディソン校教授）に授与すると発表した。授賞理由は「アイスキューブ・ニュートリノ観測所への決定的な貢献と、天体起源の高エネルギーニュートリノの発見」。

ハルツェン氏は、南極に設置した観測施設「アイスキューブ」での国際研究プロジェクトを主導した。

王立科学アカデミーのエバ・オルソン氏は記者会見で「（ニュートリノという）メッセンジャーは宇宙から情報を運んでくる」と述べ、「遠くの銀河への扉を開き、星が爆発する過程を教えてくれる」と語った。

ノーベル物理学委員会のマーク・ピアース委員長は声明で「ハルツェン氏は国際的な研究者・技術者チームを率い、素晴らしい観測装置をもたらしてくれた」とし、「その粘り強さと科学的な先見性が、新しい種類の天文学への道を開いた」とも語った。

ハルツェン氏は電話で記者会見に参加し、「自分がいかに幸運だったかを強調したい。このプロジェクトを始めた時、良いアイデアかもしれないとは誰もが思っていたが、うまくいくと考えた人はほとんどいなかった。私自身もそうだった」と語った。

ベルギーのデウェーフェル首相は、「宇宙の最も小さな現れを通じて、宇宙の最大の謎の解明にささげた人生」が認められたと称えた。 

ニュートリノは地球や人体を跡形もなく通り抜け、物質とはごくまれにしか反応しないため、「幽霊粒子」と呼ばれることもある。ハルツェン氏は、南極点の氷を使えばニュートリノを追跡できることに気付いた。１９８８年、南極点でニュートリノの痕跡を捉えるという構想を初めて発表したが、プロジェクトの完成は２０１１年までかかった。 

アイスキューブは、アムンゼン・スコット南極点基地の近くの地下深くにあり、５０００個を超えるセンサーが設置されている。

高エネルギーニュートリノは質量がほぼゼロで、他の粒子と違ってエネルギーを失ったり方向を変えたりしない。アイスキューブはその信号を待ち受け、経路をさかのぼって発生源を突き止めることを目指している。

ハルツェン氏は６日の会見で、自身の研究で宇宙について具体的に何が分かるかを語るのは尚早とし、「本当にわくわくするのは、その質問にまだ答えられないことだ。これは科学の入り口にすぎず、天文学としての成果はこれからだ」と語った。

米スミソニアン誌は１４年にハルツェン氏に「独創性賞」を贈った。その際、同氏を「ニュートリノマン」と呼び、「天文学の新時代の幕開けを告げる驚くべき実験」と称え、ハルツェン氏の半生を描いた漫画「一人の物理学者の宇宙探求はいかにして南極で飛躍したか（How OnePhysicist’s Pursuit of the Cosmos Took Off in Antarctica）」を掲載した。

items.title: 米国民、税金使う選挙広告に不信感＝ロイター／イプソス世論調査
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Jason Lange

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Jason Lange

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - ロイター／イプソスが実施した世論調査によると、１１月の中間選挙を前にトランプ大統領が出演するテレビＣＭが放映される中、圧倒的多数の米国民が選挙の頃に大統領を起用したテレビＣＭに税金を使うのは不適切だと回答した。

５日に終了した６日間の世論調査によると、米国民の８６％、そして共和党員の５人に４人が、大統領や閣僚を起用した選挙関連のテレビ広告に税金を使うのは不適切だと考えていることが分かった。

倫理専門家や両党の議員は、中間選挙の数週間前に放映された「アメリカの黄金時代」を称える３つの全国放送広告を批判。議員らは公金がトランプ氏の政治的宣伝に使われているのではないかと疑問を呈しており、他の批判者らはこれらの広告が政府の宣伝活動や政治活動に関する規制に違反する可能性があると指摘している。

トランプ氏と側近らは、これらの広告は教育的かつ愛国的なものであり、特定の政治家候補を後押しする意図はないと述べている。

トランプ氏は５日夜、広告費は自ら支払うか、政治活動委員会（ＰＡＣ）の「ＭＡＧＡ」が集めた資金で賄うと表明した。 

各広告の最後には、米国政府が費用を負担した旨が記載されている。

民主党議員らは独立した調査を求め、ホワイトハウスが広告放映のために国土安全保障省の資金２０００万ドルを流用したと主張している。

また、世論調査によると、回答者の約７１％が米首都ワシントンの総合文化施設ケネディ・センターの名称をトランプ氏の名前を含むものに変更することに反対している。共和党員でこの案を支持しているのはわずか４分の１だった。

さらに、共和党支持者の間では、一部の記者をホワイトハウスから締め出すことに賛成する人が多く、５７％が賛成。一方、民主党支持者と無党派層は圧倒的に反対した。全体として、回答者の６８％がこうしたやり方は不適切だと答えた。

調査はオンラインで全米規模で実施され、米国の成人４５０６人から回答を得た。

items.title: Americans deeply skeptical of taxpayer-funded election ads, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds
items.author: Trevor Hunnicutt, Jason Lange
items.creator: Trevor Hunnicutt, Jason Lange
items.summary: An overwhelming majority of Americans said that it is inappropriate to use taxpayer funds for TV ads featuring the president around an election, in a Reuters/Ipsos poll conducted as spots with President Donald Trump air ahead of November's midterms.
items.body:
An overwhelming majority of Americans said that it is inappropriate to use taxpayer funds for TV ads featuring the president around an election, in a Reuters/Ipsos poll conducted as spots with President Donald Trump air ahead of November's midterms.
The six-day poll, which concluded on Monday, found that 86% of Americans — and four out of five Republicans — think it is inappropriate to use taxpayer money to pay for election-related TV ads featuring the president or his cabinet.
Ethics experts and lawmakers from both parties have criticized three nationally broadcast ads that celebrate a "golden age of America" airing weeks before the November 3 midterm elections . Lawmakers have questioned whether public funds are being used to promote Trump politically, while other critics say the spots may violate longstanding restrictions on government propaganda and political activity.
Trump and his aides have said the ads are educational, patriotic and not intended to promote any politician's candidacy.
"These public service announcements are about reminding Americans to love their country and understand what makes it worth defending, at home, at our borders, and abroad," said a White House spokesperson who declined to be named. Trump said late on Monday that he would pay for ads himself or with money raised from the MAGA political committee.
A White House official said on Tuesday that Trump was referring to the MAGA Inc PAC paying for future ads but did not plan to reimburse taxpayers for the ads that the government has paid for in recent weeks.
One ad features Trump declaring that "America will never be a communist country" while a chorus repeats "love me." Another combines images of Mount Rushmore with footage of Trump praising a "golden age of America." A third describes a "final battle" against the "deep state" and closely resembles one of Trump's 2024 campaign advertisements.
Each ad ends with a disclaimer that it was paid for by the US government.
Democratic lawmakers have sought independent investigations and said that the White House [USN:L1N45N046 TEXT:"transferred $20 million"] in Homeland Security Department funds to air the ads.
PRESSURE ON REPUBLICANS AHEAD OF ELECTIONS Republicans seeking reelection face growing pressure as the president's approval rating sits at [USN:L6N45R10Y TEXT:"record lows"].
Trump has taken a series of unusual steps in recent months promoting his brand and accomplishments, including a [USN:L6N41H110 TEXT:"sweeping makeover of Washington."]
A Trump-appointed board [USN:L1N4560T6 TEXT:"shut down"] the capital's landmark John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts after courts rejected two plans to put the president's name on the building.
Some 71% of respondents oppose renaming the Kennedy Center to include Trump's name, the poll showed. Just a quarter of Republicans supported that idea.
"For me to get involved and to take that on long term and to carry it or to raise money to carry it, I think that the Trump administration should certainly have recognition," Trump said last month.
A MEDIA BAN AT THE WHITE HOUSE In September, Trump banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House before a judge ordered the administration to [USN:L1N45G0ZE TEXT:"restore their access"].
Republicans were more supportive of keeping some reporters out of the White House, with 57% backing the practice. Democrats and independents were overwhelmingly opposed. Overall, 68% of respondents said the practice was inappropriate.
The Justice Department has accused the outlets of threatening national security with their coverage, citing stories about US missile stockpiles, construction of Trump's White House ballroom and turnout at the recent Republican midterm convention.
The Reuters/Ipsos poll, which was conducted online and nationwide, gathered responses from 4,506 US adults and had a margin of error of about 2 percentage points.

FAST

NEW YORK/BOSTON, October 6 : Dario Amodei made $18 million last year as CEO of Claude AI developer Anthropic, the company's IPO filing shows, putting him in the middle ranks of top executives at major technology firms in terms of compensation.
Anthropic is preparing for an IPO as early as this fall that could value it at more than $2 trillion, according to its IPO prospectus seen by Reuters. Amodei's pay last year puts him above CEOs at Alphabet and Amazon, but behind those at Oracle and Nvidia. 
Amodei's pay leans heavily towards stock and other sorts of compensation, suggesting that like many other tech founders, his yearly salary will account for just a fraction of his wealth.
Dario Amodei and his sister, Anthropic President Daniela Amodei, each had their annual salaries doubled this past July to $1.4 million. Stock and options awards made up the bulk of their packages in 2025, with Daniela Amodei receiving a total of $16.4 million last year.

Anthropic's board this year granted the pair the promise of further equity in the form of restricted stock units, which promise a future payout if certain conditions are met. Some of that is tied to their remaining at the company, and some of it is tied to the IPO.
Chief Financial Officer Krishna Rao earned $720,250 last year. He was granted options to buy 1.4 million shares when he was hired in 2024, and exercised options worth $385,285 in 2025.
An Anthropic spokesperson declined to comment on the figures.
MIDDLE OF THE PACK
The rise in US CEO pay in recent years has far outpaced the gains for the average worker, a dynamic critics worry could be exacerbated by AI's widespread adoption.
S&P 500 CEO average annual compensation rose 21 per cent to $22.8 million last year, and that does not include the extraordinary case of Tesla's Elon Musk and his $158 billion restricted stock plan, according to the AFL-CIO.
Courtney Yu, director of research for executive compensation data firm Equilar, said Amodei's $18 million haul "seems on the lower end for a company valued at $2 trillion, but it will be interesting to see how that changes once the company goes public" and his full ownership stake is shown. With six other co-founders, Amodei may wind up getting a lesser share of the wealth created by the IPO compared with other major tech CEOs, Yu added.
Top executives at AI-focused tech firms earned amounts that varied widely in 2025, based on SEC filings. At the high end, Oracle co-CEO Clayton Magouyrk earned $627.5 million, while the lowest was the $54,080 paid to Musk as CEO of SpaceX, before it went public. SpaceX has also promised super-voting restricted shares to Musk, already the world's richest person, if the company's market value grows to $7.5 trillion and the firm puts 1 million people on Mars.
Other giant companies pay less on a year-by-year basis, with executives benefiting from enormous stock ownership while having only salary and security costs reflected in annual filings. 
For instance, Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai made $10.9 million in 2025, including $8.8 million for personal security "due to Sundar's significant public profile." By "compensation actually paid," Pichai earned $213.9 million last year, which among other things reflects the change in value of his unvested shares. 
Amazon CEO Andrew Jassy made $2.1 million in 2025, a disclosure said, mainly reflecting travel and security. On an "actually paid" basis, Jassy received $13.2 million. 
LIVING OFF THE STOCK
Equilar's Yu said the disclosures show how these executives don't need to worry about year-by-year pay.
"Founder CEOs typically own enough equity that when the company does well and the stock prices increases they can just live off the wealth of the equity they already own, and typically don't take in a lot in annual compensation," Yu said.
Anthropic said in the filing it offered a mix of salary, equity awards and other benefits. The S-1 statement seen by Reuters does not describe the founders' share of ownership in the company, which could be worth billions of dollars, depending on the final terms and valuation of the IPO.
The Amodei siblings and their fellow co-founders pledged in the IPO filing to dedicate 80 per cent of their personal Anthropic equity to charitable causes.
Asked about the 80 per cent figure Monday, an Anthropic spokesperson noted an essay Dario Amodei posted earlier this year, where he wrote that wealthy individuals have an obligation to help address problems stemming from AI adoption, and decried that many wealthy people, particularly in the tech industry, "have recently adopted a cynical and nihilistic attitude that philanthropy is inevitably fraudulent or useless."

Source: Reuters

items.body:
Echo Wang　Ross Kerber　Isla Binnie

[ニューヨーク／ボストン ６日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）「クロード」を開発するアンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の２０２５年の報酬は１８００万ドルだった。同社の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請書類で明らかになった。大手テクノロジー企業の経営トップの中では中位に位置する。

ロイターが確認したＩＰＯ目論見書によると、アンソロピックは早ければ今秋の上場を準備しており、企業価値は２兆ドルを超える可能性がある。アモデイ氏の２５年の報酬は、アルファベットやアマゾン・ドット・コムのＣＥＯを上回る一方、オラクルやエヌビディアのＣＥＯには及ばなかった。 

アモデイ氏の報酬は株式などに大きく偏っており、他の多くのテクノロジー企業創業者と同様、年間給与が資産に占める割合はごく一部にとどまるとみられる。

アモデイ氏と妹のダニエラ・アモデイ社長の年間給与は、７月にそれぞれ２倍の１４０万ドルに引き上げられた。２５年の報酬は両氏とも株式とストックオプション（自社株購入権）が大半を占め、ダニエラ氏の報酬総額は１６４０万ドルだった。

アンソロピックの取締役会は今年、両氏に対し譲渡制限付き株式ユニット（ＲＳＵ）の形で追加の株式を付与することを約束した。ＲＳＵは一定の条件を満たした場合に将来支払われる仕組みで、一部は在籍継続、一部はＩＰＯに連動している。

アンソロピックの広報担当者は、これらの数字についてコメントを控えた。

＜大手テクノロジー企業の中では中位＞

米労働総同盟産別会議（ＡＦＬ─ＣＩＯ）によると、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種指数構成企業のＣＥＯの平均年間報酬は２５年に２１％増の２２８０万ドルとなった。この数字には、テスラのイーロン・マスクＣＥＯに対する１５８０億ドルの譲渡制限付き株式報酬という例外的な事例は含まれていない。

役員報酬データ会社エクイラーの調査責任者コートニー・ユー氏は、アモデイ氏の１８００万ドルという報酬について「企業価値が２兆ドルの会社としては低い方に見える」とした上で、上場して同氏の保有株式の全容が明らかになった後、どう変わるかは興味深いと述べた。他に６人の共同創業者がいるため、アモデイ氏がＩＰＯによって生み出される富から得る取り分は、他の大手テクノロジー企業のＣＥＯより小さくなる可能性があるとした。

米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）への提出書類によると、ＡＩに注力するテクノロジー企業の経営トップの２５年報酬には大きな開きがあった。高額な例ではオラクルのクレイトン・マグワイク共同ＣＥＯが６億２７５０万ドルを受け取った。一方、最低だったのは、上場前のスペースＸのＣＥＯとしてマスク氏に支払われた５万４０８０ドルだった。スペースＸは、同社の時価総額が７兆５０００億ドルに達し、火星に１００万人を送り込んだ場合、マスク氏に対し、強力な議決権を持つ譲渡制限付き株式を付与することも約束している。

他の巨大企業では、経営幹部が巨額の保有株式から恩恵を受ける一方、年次開示には給与や警備費用のみが計上されるため、年間の報酬額は比較的少ない。

例えば、アルファベットのスンダー・ピチャイＣＥＯの２５年の報酬は１０９０万ドルだった。このうち８８０万ドルは「スンダー氏の社会的な知名度の高さを踏まえた」身辺警護費用だった。一方、未確定の株式報酬の価値変動などを反映する「実際に支払われた報酬」という開示上の指標では、２億１３９０万ドルだった。

items.body:
[東京 ６日 ロイター] - シチズン時計は６日、委託先企業のサーバーが不正アクセスを受け、保存されていた約１０万人の顧客情報が流出した可能性があると発表した。二次被害は確認されていないという。

シチズンが顧客からの問い合わせ受付業務を委託していたスカラコミュニケーションズによると、１０月２日夜から３日朝にかけて不正アクセスが発生。 約１０万人の氏名、住所、電話番号、メールアドレスなどが流出した可能性があるという。問い合わせ内容欄に銀行口座やクレジットカード情報などを記載していた場合は漏えいした可能性があるとしている。

対象はシチズン、ブローバ、フレデリック・コンスタントの各ブランドのホームページ。シチズン本体への不正アクセスは確認されていないという。

items.title: Google signs massive 3.6-GW power deal with Constellation Energy in US
items.summary: The agreements cover 3,590 MW of power, including 890 MW from upgraded nuclear plants, as Constellation plans more than $4.3 billion in new investments ...
items.body:
Home / World News / Google signs massive 3.6-GW power deal with Constellation Energy in US

Google signs massive 3.6-GW power deal with Constellation Energy in US The agreements cover 3,590 MW of power, including 890 MW from upgraded nuclear plants, as Constellation plans more than $4.3 billion in new investments

Rising electricity demand driven largely by the data centre expansion has contributed to a more than 11-fold increase in PJM capacity prices since 2024 and left the grid with a power shortfall (Photo: Reuters)

Reuters New York 3 min read Last Updated : Oct 06 2026 | 10:24 PM IST

Listen to This Article

Google has contracted for 3,590 megawatts of power from Constellation Energy in the largest US power grid, with new nuclear energy accounting for about a quarter of that supply, the companies said on Tuesday.
  Constellation will make more than $4.3 billion of new investments in its fleet as part of the agreement, which involves adding capacity at several of the power company's nuclear reactors in the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, the companies said.
  Major tech companies are racing to secure massive amounts of electricity supplies to power data centres across the US by striking unprecedented power deals and reviving the country's nuclear industry.
 

  Over the last two years, Constellation unveiled an agreement to restart its Three Mile Island reactor in Pennsylvania to serve Microsoft data centres, while Google contracted to restart NextEra Energy's nuclear power plant in Iowa.
  In the latest arrangement, Google entered into a 20-year power purchase agreement for 890 megawatts of electricity from multiple Constellation-owned nuclear power plants, which would be upgraded to produce more electricity from existing reactors.
Also Read

From coding to cyber defence: What makes Google's Gemini 4 Argon different

  Electricity from the first of the upgraded plants is expected to be delivered in 2028, the companies said.
  Google also entered into a 15-year supply agreement for an additional 2,700 megawatts of power from Constellation in the PJM power grid. That power is not tied to a specific generation source and serves as long-term revenue certainty for Constellation's operating plants, Google said.

  Shares of Constellation were up by more than 13 per cent on Tuesday to $304.04 by mid-morning.
  Maryland-based Constellation is the largest US nuclear power plant operator and owns a major fleet of natural-gas-fired power plants as well as geothermal energy following its acquisition of electricity producer Calpine Corp earlier this year.
  "We're committed to meeting our growth responsibly by actively investing in clean, reliable power that brings new capacity to our nation's grids," said Amanda Peterson Corio, Google's global head of energy and power, in a statement.
  The 11 nuclear units expected to be upgraded as part of the arrangement with Google are in Illinois, Pennsylvania, and New Jersey, within the footprint of the largest US electric grid — PJM Interconnection.

  Rising electricity demand driven largely by the data centre expansion has contributed to a more than 11-fold increase in PJM capacity prices since 2024 and left the grid with a power shortfall.
  In response, PJM management has proposed requiring data centre customers connected to the 13-state grid to either bring their own power or face being shut off from grid power remotely in times of peak demand.
  The deal between Google and Constellation is in response to PJM's "bring your own power" proposal. It also creates a "practical model for how major power consumers can expand new supply alongside growing operational requirements, without state or federal mandates," the companies said.

  Google and Constellation also agreed on a strategic framework that can be replicated to develop power generation, battery storage, and a flexible power use model known as "demand response" in other parts of the US, the companies said.
  Joe Dominguez, chairman, president and CEO of Constellation, said the arrangement with Google is a "model for how technology companies and the energy industry can work together to responsibly develop the digital economy and invest in our nation's energy infrastructure in a way that delivers grid-wide benefits for all, funded by private entities."

items.title: ASOS shares slide after hackers target online retailer
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Shares in ASOS fell 10% on Tuesday after the British online fashion retailer warned that some customer information may have been accessed following the unauthorised sending of a notification to shoppers.
items.body:
Shares in ASOS (ASOS.L) fell 10% on Tuesday after the British online fashion retailer warned that some customer information may have been accessed following the unauthorised sending of a notification to shoppers.
The group said it was investigating unauthorised activity involving third-party platforms that it uses to communicate with customers.
It said it took immediate action to restrict access to the platforms and was working with internal and external specialist advisers, as well as all relevant authorities.
"Basic personal information including name and contact details may have been accessed. We do not believe that payment-card information or account passwords, were impacted," it said.
The retailer's website and app were operating as normal, with no current disruption to operations, it said.
British companies and institutions have been increasingly hit by aggressive and regular cyber and ransomware attacks in recent years. The British Library, a blood testing service, the London Underground, Marks & Spencer (MKS.L) , the Co-op and Jaguar Land Rover are some that have suffered months of disruption due to such breaches.
HACKING GROUP 'XUANYE GROUP' CLAIMS RESPONSIBILITY The notifications to ASOS shoppers - addressed to ASOS' data protection officer and IT department - read, "we have fully compromised the Snowflake instance. Engage with us, or we will leak it."
Snowflake is a data storage firm, whose tools are used by thousands of companies.
A hacking group calling itself the "Xuanye group" claimed credit for compromising ASOS' Snowflake repository in the push alert sent to users of the retailer's app. The message included a link to a Telegram channel, where the group said that payment information "is not affected," and that the ASOS app "is safe to use."
"The incident involves customer information, it is safe on our server, and it will not be touched for a designated period," the group said in a message posted to the channel.
A spokesperson for Snowflake said it launched an investigation as soon as it became aware of the notification. "At this time, we can report that we have found no compromise of the Snowflake platform."
Hackers have previously targeted organisations' Snowflake data repositories. In 2024, Google's (GOOGL.O) cybersecurity unit Mandiant detailed a widespread hacking spree targeting Snowflake data associated with at least 165 customers.
ASOS said that it has cyber insurance, including basic continuity insurance, but said it was too early to quantify any potential impact on trading.
Shares in the group were up more than 60% so far this year, though they are well below a peak in 2018 amid tough competition in fast fashion. The company has been divesting assets and last month provided an upbeat profit forecast for fiscal 2026.
items.raw_description: Shares in ASOS fell 10% on Tuesday after the British online fashion retailer warned that some customer information may have been accessed following the unauthorised sending of a notification to shoppers.

Francis Halzen wins Nobel physics prize for Antarctic 'ghost particle' hunt

Eva Olsson, Ellen Moons, and Mark Pearce sit as they announce Francis Halzen as the recipient of the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics during a press conference at the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences in Stockholm, Sweden, Oct 6, 2026. (Photo: TT News Agency/Christine Olsson via REUTERS)

STOCKHOLM: The Belgian-American Francis Halzen won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for his work creating an Antarctic observatory of ice to detect high-energy neutrinos, elusive subatomic particles that can reveal otherwise inaccessible information about the cosmos.
Halzen, 82, realised that pristine ice at the South Pole could be used to track such neutrinos, sometimes known as "ghost particles" for the way they pass through the Earth without a trace, only interacting with matter extremely rarely.
"The messengers bring information from the cosmos," Eva Olsson, of the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, told a press conference. "They open the door to distant galaxies and tell us about the processes of exploding stars."
HALZEN HAILED FOR DETECTING "MESSENGERS FROM THE COSMOS" The interactions registered by the IceCube observatory provide information about how high-energy neutrinos are created and may even reveal previously unknown phenomena, the Academy said.

In 2014, the US-based Smithsonian magazine dubbed Halzen "Neutrino Man" when giving him one of its Ingenuity Awards, acclaiming him for an "amazing experiment (that) heralds the beginning of a new era in astronomy".
It even published a comic illustrating his life: "How One Physicist’s Pursuit of the Cosmos Took Off in Antarctica".
The observatory - in effect a telescope that shows neutrinos instead of light - is set in a cubic kilometre of Antarctic ice, which extends to a depth of 2,500 metres below the surface near the Amundsen-Scott South Pole Station.
More than 5,000 sensors await blips from the nearly massless high-energy neutrinos, which unlike other particles do not lose energy or change direction, in the hope of tracing their paths back to exploding stars, gamma-ray bursts, and cataclysmic phenomena involving black holes and neutron stars. They can expect to register about one per day.
Halzen, a professor at the University of Wisconsin–Madison in the United States, first presented his idea in 1988 for capturing neutrino traces at the South Pole, but the project was not completed until 2011.
"I have to emphasise how lucky I was because, when we started this project, everybody realised this was maybe a good idea, but very few thought it would work, including myself," Halzen told the press conference by telephone.
Neutrinos are electrically neutral, undisturbed by any magnetic field, which means that, in contrast to electromagnetic waves such as visible light, the direction from which they arrive points directly back to their source.

Related:

Medicine Nobel goes to US-German trio for pioneering light-based control of cells

FRUITS OF HALZEN'S RESEARCH YET TO COME The observatory has determined that high-energy neutrinos originate within but also far outside our own Milky Way galaxy, setting in motion an interstellar quest to find the objects and processes that create them.
Through the long winter at the South Pole, when bringing anything in or out is difficult as temperatures below minus 50°C (minus 58 Fahrenheit) preclude even aircraft landing, a skeleton crew of "winterovers" has to maintain the observatory.
The station, home to many other activities, can house as many as 150 people and has an industrial kitchen, dining room, gym and even a greenhouse. Last week it celebrated the sun's return above the horizon after six months of night with a six-hole ice-golf tournament.
An extension, IceCube-Gen2, encompassing 8 cubic kilometres of ice, is planned to become operational in 2033 and will be able to detect 10 times as many neutrinos, including much weaker ones.
Halzen said the main fruits of his work were yet to be seen and that it was too early to say exactly what it could reveal about the universe.
"The real excitement is that I cannot answer that question yet," he said. "This is just an introduction to the science, the astronomy is still to come."
WINNERS FROM EINSTEIN TO BOHR AND THE CURIES Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever congratulated Halzen on the recognition of "a life dedicated to unraveling the greatest secrets of the cosmos through its most minuscule manifestations".
The physics laureate receives an award of 12 million Swedish crowns (US$1.2 million). Past winners include several other neutrino research pioneers, for instance Japan's Takaaki Kajita and Arthur McDonald from Canada in 2015.
The Nobel Prizes were established under the will of Swedish inventor and entrepreneur Alfred Nobel, whose fortune was built in part on the invention of dynamite.
Physics was prominent in Nobel's will and the prize remains one of the discipline's highest distinctions. Over the decades, it has recognised discoveries that have fundamentally reshaped humanity's understanding of the universe.
Among past laureates are some of the most celebrated figures in science, including Albert Einstein, Marie and Pierre Curie, Max Planck and Niels Bohr, whose work helped establish the foundations of modern physics.
The prize is presented in Stockholm on Dec 10, the anniversary of Nobel's death.

Source: Reuters/fh

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）のキャサリン・マン委員は６日、２％の目標を上回るインフレが英国経済に定着してしまったようだと述べた。

経済助言会社ＴＳロンバードが主催した会議で「私がこの職に就いて以来、インフレ率は一貫して目標を大幅に上回ってきた。インフレは定着してしまった」と語った。

また、賃金交渉が活発化する年末年始ごろにインフレ率が４％に達する見通しであることに特に懸念を示した。

マン氏は、英国の経済需要は力強いとは思えないものの、ポジティブとの見解を示した。

さらに、最近の労働生産性データの上方改定が労働時間の下方改定によるものだったことに触れ、これが将来的にインフレを伴わない成長を実現する経済の能力を制限する可能性があるとの見解を示した。

マン氏は７月以来、政策金利を０．２５ポイント引き上げて４％とする案に賛成票を投じる少数派の一員となっている。

‘I am Giorgia’: Ahead of polls, Italy PM Meloni wants voice trademarked before AI puts words in her mouth

Italian PM Giorgia Meloni has filed an EU trademark application for her voice, as concerns grow over AI-generated political deepfakes ahead of next year’s election.

Jeyasri AT

06 October, 2026 03:18 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

Prime Minister Narendra Modi in a conversation with Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni in Rome in May | DPR PMO/ANI

Follow Us :

Text Size:
A-
A+

-->

New Delhi: A four-second recording could become Georgia Meloni’s defence against AI. Italy’s Prime Minister, Georgia Meloni, wants to legally protect her voice, a big part of her public image, as artificial intelligence makes it easier than ever to fake audio. 

Meloni filed a sound trademark application with the European Union Intellectual Property Office this Monday (5 October). It is a four-second clip where she says “Io sono Giorgia Meloni” (“I am Giorgia Meloni”) twice. Right now, the application is still under review, so EU trademark protection isn’t official yet, as reported by the Financial Times .

The recorded phrase echoes Meloni’s famous declaration at a 2019 political rally: “I am Giorgia, I am a woman, I am a mother, I am Italian, I am Christian.” The slogan became widely known in Italy and inspired a viral dance remix. “Io sono Giorgia” was also the title of her 2021 autobiography.

Show Full Article

According to Reuters , Italian media has reported that even if approved, it would not by itself prevent the use of her voice in AI-generated deepfakes, though it could create additional legal obstacles for those seeking to replicate it.

If the trademark goes through, she’ll be the first major politician to get this kind of protection for her voice. Singers and other celebrities have done it before, but politicians haven’t till now.

Celebrities like Matthew McConaughey and Taylor Swift have filed legal trademark and registration protections for their voices with intellectual property authorities to guard against unauthorised AI voice cloning and deepfakes.

This isn’t Meloni’s first time in legal battles over deepfakes. In 2024, she filed a civil lawsuit against a man accused of creating and distributing pornographic deepfake images using her face. The case remains pending before an Italian court.

What Meloni is trying to protect
The trademark doesn’t cover every possible use of her voice. The European Union Intellectual Property Office ( EUIPO) recognises sound as a category of EU trademark. The rules say the sound itself must be clearly represented, usually in an audio file, and any protection sticks only to specific goods and services named in the application.

So, registering the sound won’t stop AI clones altogether. But it does give Meloni a stronger intellectual property argument to challenge unauthorised uses, if they fall under her registration.

Why now? 
Italy expects its next general election in 2027, and everyone’s struggling to tell real political content from AI-generated fakes. 

This move comes as generative AI now allows people to clone voices and create entirely new speech.

For politicians, that means someone can create a speech or endorsement from scratch, spread it online, and the damage is done before anyone realises it is fake. Today, the technology doesn’t only recreate politician’s faces, it can fake their voices and put words in their mouths. Meloni’s application marks a new attempt to use existing laws to bear against AI-generated impersonation.

(Edited by Viny Mishra)

items.title: Nigeria's Dangote refinery aims to draw more retail investors than Aramco IPO, CEO says
items.author: Vallari Srivastava, Sarah Safty
items.creator: Vallari Srivastava, Sarah Safty
items.summary: Nigeria's Dangote Petroleum Refinery is using Saudi Aramco's blockbuster listing as a benchmark for its own IPO in terms of retail subscribers, Chief Executive David Bird said on Tuesday.
items.body:
Nigeria's Dangote Petroleum Refinery is using Saudi Aramco's (2222.SE) blockbuster listing as a benchmark for its own IPO in terms of retail subscribers, Chief Executive David Bird said on Tuesday.
Speaking at the Fujairah Energy Markets Forum, Bird said the refinery is targeting 10 million retail investors for its planned initial public offering.
Last month, Nigeria's Dangote Group [USN:L4N4511G5 TEXT:"launched"] Africa's largest share sale yet in an initial public offering of its oil refinery that could raise 2.15 trillion naira ($1.6 billion), if fully subscribed.
Aramco, which raised [USN:KBN1ZB03C TEXT:"$29.4 billion"] in its 2019 IPO by over-allotment of shares, had said it would sell up to 0.5% of the state oil giant to retail investors.
"Our benchmark is the Aramco listing, which I think (had) over 4.5 million retail subscribers," Bird said.
"So we are going to try and smash that with 10 million retail subscribers and we are well on our way."

items.body:
香港株式市場は海外市場に追随して堅調。製薬株やハイテク株が上昇した。    ハンセン指数は１％高。ハンセン中国株指数は１％近く上昇した。    ハンセン・バイオテック指数は３．２%上昇し、ハンセン・テック指数は０．９%上昇した。    HSBC Qianhaiの中国ヘルスケア調査責任者リンダ・シュー氏はリポートで「２０２６年には主要な製薬企業のほとんどが堅調な成長を遂げると予想している」と記した。    半面、主要な不動産開発会社の株価は下落し、新鴻基地産（サンフンカイ・プロパティーズ）は０．６％安、長江実業集団（ＣＫアセット・ホールディングス）は０．３％安となった。    ＵＯＢケイヒアンは「（住宅）価格は２０２６年を通じてもみ合いが続くと予想している」と指摘した。    新世界発展（ニューワールド・デベロップメント）３．５％安。２７年および２８年に満期を迎える一部社債について、３２年に満期を迎える新たな担保付社債とスワップする債務交換オファーを発表した。    中国本土の金融市場は国慶節（建国記念日）の連休で７日まで休場。取引は８日に再開する。

休場明けのソウル株式市場は下落。今週発表されるサムスン電子の決算を控え、半導体株が売られた。

未来アセット証券のアナリスト、ソ・サンヨン氏は「メモリー半導体価格の継続的な上昇を背景にサムスン電子の決算は良好な内容になるとみられるが、債券利回りの高止まりが相場全般の重しとなっている」と指摘した。    

半導体のサムスン電子は１．４５％安、同業のＳＫハイニックスは３．６９％下落した。

電池メーカーのＬＧエネルギーソリューションが５．１２％上昇。現代自動車は０．４３％高、傘下の起亜は０．２７％安だった。

売買された９１８銘柄のうち、値上がりは４２５、値下がりは４６１。    

外国人投資家は差し引き１兆８０００億ウォン（１３億４０００万ドル）の売り越し。

シドニー株式市場は３営業日続伸して取引を終えた。銅価格の上昇を背景に主力鉱山株が買われたほか、原油安でインフレ懸念が和らいだ。

金融株指数は０．７％上昇し、３営業日続伸。４大銀行は全て上昇し、上昇率は０．６─０．８％だった。不動産株指数は１．１％上昇し、４営業日ぶりに反発した。センター・グループは２．７％、ＧＰＴグループは２．３％それぞれ上昇した。

鉱業株指数は銅価格の上昇を受けて０．９％上昇した。業界大手のＢＨＰグループは１．６％高となり、約１カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。ハイテク株指数は３％近く下落し、１カ月余りで最大の下落率を記録した。ワイズテック・グローバルは２．５％下落し、下げを主導した。

items.title: 英建設ＰＭＩ、9月46.1に改善　新規受注は引き続き低迷
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
David Milliken

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
David Milliken

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが６日発表した英国の９月の建設業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は４６．１だった。８月の４４．３から改善したものの、好不況の分かれ目である５０を引き続き下回った。ただ落ち込みは１月以降で最も穏やかだった。

英建設業ＰＭＩは２０２５年１月から５０を下回っている。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスの経済ディレクター、ティム・ムーア氏は「９月の新規受注は相対的に低迷した。建設企業は営業から受注までの期間が長期化しており、顧客が大型プロジェクトの意思決定を先送りにしていると指摘した」と述べた。

・新規受注指数は４５．９で、前月の４７．７から低下し３カ月ぶりの低水準。

・投入価格の上昇率は２月のイラン戦争勃発以来、最も緩やかなペースとなった。ただしムーア氏は、エネルギーコストの上昇を踏まえると、この傾向が続く可能性は低いと述べた。

・今後の活動見通しは５月以来で最も弱かった。

・部門別では住宅建設が引き続き最も低調で、土木工事がこれに続いた。一方、商業施設は小幅な低下にとどまった。

・サービス、製造業、建設業のＰＭＩデータを含む全セクターＰＭＩは５１．５で前月の５１．８から低下し、３カ月ぶりの低水準。

items.title: Audi’s $89,000 Q9 Shows Chinese Competition Is Hitting the US
items.author: Liam Denning
items.creator: Liam Denning
items.summary: America’s automakers enjoy the refuge of an anti-Chinese wall. But so do foreign, non-Chinese automakers who also sell vehicles in America, especially if they manufacture here. This means Chinese competition is exerting pressure on US dealer lots already; indirectly, yes, but it’s likely to intensify. Detroit’s defensive moat is less impenetrable than it might seem.

items.title: 東エルサレムの英領事館、閉鎖ならイスラエル外交官追放も＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Alexander Cornwell

[テルアビブ ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Alexander Cornwell

[テルアビブ ６日 ロイター] - イスラエル入植地を対象とした制裁を巡る対立で、イスラエルが今週、東エルサレムにある英国領事館の閉鎖命令を実行した場合、英国は対抗措置としてイスラエルの外交官を追放する可能性が高い。関係筋４人が明らかにした。

パレスチナ自治区ヨルダン川西岸の入植地で生産された製品の輸入を禁止する方針を英国が発表したことを受け、イスラエルは先月、同領事館を３０日以内に閉鎖し、外交官を同市から退去させるよう命じた。

関係筋によると、８日が領事館閉鎖の期限となる。同領事館に勤務する約３０人の英国人外交官とその家族が影響を受ける。

関係筋は領事館が閉鎖されれば、英国は対抗措置として、駐英イスラエル大使館から同程度の人数を追放する可能性が高いと述べた。

領事館は東エルサレムのシェイクジャラ地区にあり、エルサレム市内やヨルダン川西岸、ガザ地区のパレスチナ人との関係窓口を務めるほか、パレスチナ人向けの領事業務も行っている。

別の関係筋２人によると、イスラエル政府に決定を撤回させるため、英国は欧州各国に対し、この問題をイスラエル側に提起するよう求めた。

ハンセン指数は１％高。ハンセン中国株指数は１％近く上昇した。

ハンセン・バイオテック指数は３．２%上昇し、ハンセン・テック指数は０．９%上昇した。

HSBC Qianhaiの中国ヘルスケア調査責任者リンダ・シュー氏はリポートで「２０２６年には主要な製薬企業のほとんどが堅調な成長を遂げると予想している」と記した。

半面、主要な不動産開発会社の株価は下落し、新鴻基地産（サンフンカイ・プロパティーズ）は０．６％安、長江実業集団（ＣＫアセット・ホールディングス）は０．３％安となった。

ＵＯＢケイヒアンは「（住宅）価格は２０２６年を通じてもみ合いが続くと予想している」と指摘した。

新世界発展（ニューワールド・デベロップメント）３．５％安。２７年および２８年に満期を迎える一部社債について、３２年に満期を迎える新たな担保付社債とスワップする債務交換オファーを発表した。

中国本土の金融市場は国慶節（建国記念日）の連休で７日まで休場。取引は８日に再開する。

items.title: Italy regulator probes AI music startup Suno over terms of service
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Italy's antitrust authority said on Tuesday it had opened an investigation into AI music startup Suno, saying some clauses in its terms of service may be unfair to consumers.
items.body:
Italy's antitrust authority said on Tuesday it had opened an investigation into AI music startup Suno, saying some clauses in its terms of service may be unfair to consumers.
Suno was not immediately available for comment
Suno's terms could create a significant imbalance in the rights and obligations of users, the watchdog said
They give Suno "broad discretion" to unilaterally modify its contract, service and subscription prices without having to provide any justification, it added in a statement
The regulator said the licence granted by users was excessively broad and included a waiver of moral rights that may conflict with Italian copyright law
Suno's terms require users to resolve disputes through mandatory arbitration in the United States, waive class-action rights and accept Massachusetts as the exclusive jurisdiction for legal claims, the authority said
It added it would launch a consultation in the coming weeks in which interested business groups, chambers of commerce and consumer associations could participate

items.title: ベインとＧＩＣ、人事システムＷＨＩの上場・売却を検討　企業価値5000億円超目指す＝関係者
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Miho Uranaka　Yantoultra Ngui

[東京 ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Miho Uranaka　Yantoultra Ngui

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 米投資会社ベインキャピタルとシンガポール政府系ファンドのＧＩＣが、人事管理システムを手がけるＷＨＩホールディングス（東京都港区）について、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）または第三者への売却を検討しており、５０００億円超の企業価値を目指していることが分かった。事情に詳しい関係者２人が明らかにした。

関係者によると、両社は、このプロセスの一環として、アドバイザーや潜在的な買い手、投資家への打診を始めている。選択肢の一つとして日本市場への上場が検討されているほか、事業会社や他のファンドなどへの売却も検討しているという。

協議は初期段階にあり、最終的な決定は下されていない。ベインとＧＩＣは最終的に保有を継続する可能性もあるという。

ベインとＧＩＣはコメントを控えた。ＷＨＩのコメントは現時点で得られていない。

ベインは２０１９年、ワークスアプリケーションズ（同千代田区）から人事ソフト事業を取得し、ＷＨＩを発足させた。取得額は公表されていない。２０２３年３月にはＧＩＣがＷＨＩに共同出資し、両社は共同支配株主となった。

ＷＨＩ傘下の中核事業会社ワークスヒューマンインテリジェンスは、人事管理、給与計算、勤怠管理、タレントマネジメントなどの機能を備えた大企業向け人事システム「ＣＯＭＰＡＮＹ」の開発・販売・サポートを手掛ける。ＷＨＩホールディングスのホームページによると、国内大手法人約１２００グループで利用されている。

items.title: ルペン氏、歳出削減目標1400億ユーロ　仏大統領選にらみ財政構想
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [パリ ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[パリ ６日 ロイター] - フランスの極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」のマリーヌ・ルペン氏は６日、来年の大統領選挙を見据えて、財政運営方針を示した。同国の債務が雪だるま式に膨らむ危機に瀕していると指摘し、歳出削減規模を従来方針から拡大した。

＜就任後１８カ月以内に基礎的財政収支均衡＞

ルペン氏は、大統領に就任した場合、就任後１８カ月以内に基礎的財政収支を均衡させると述べた。

財政赤字の対国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比率を２０３０年までに３％未満にし、任期最終年の３２年までに２．５％未満に引き下げるとした。

公的債務は２７年のＧＤＰ比約１２１％から３２年までに１１２％に下げる。

歳出は、３２年までに、少なくとも３００億ユーロの減税分を差し引いて１４００億ユーロ（１５７０億ドル）削減する。任期終了までに公的支出をＧＤＰ比５０％未満に下げるとした。

財政の混乱は選挙戦の最大の争点になっている。

ルペン氏は、現在ＧＤＰ比１１９％の公的債務が６０％に下がるまで、財政赤字を毎年少なくとも０．５ポイント減らすことを義務付ける「黄金律」を国民投票にかけ、財政規律を憲法に明記したいと述べた。

また欧州連合（ＥＵ）の予算協議でフランスの純拠出額を５０億ユーロ（５６億１０００万ドル）に減らすよう求める考えを示した。

さらに、数週間以内にフランスの年金制度に関する提案を行うと表明した。節税スキームを利用して納税額を圧縮している多国籍企業への対策として、売上高に占めるフランス国内での売上高の割合に基づいて課税する方針を示した。

＜金利上昇巡りＥＣＢと協議＞

同氏は、フランスが財政を再び管理できるようになった段階で、借り入れコストを引き下げるための介入について欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）と協議すべきだと述べた。

ＥＣＢには、市場の圧力に直面したユーロ加盟国の国債を、健全な経済政策の維持を条件に買い入れる伝達保護措置（ＴＰＩ）という制度がある。レスキュール経済・財務相は６日、同国の国債市場の混乱について、資金調達環境の安定に向けてＴＰＩの活用を検討する段階には至っていないとの認識を示した。

ルペン氏は、現在ＧＤＰ比１１９％の公的債務が６０％に下がるまで、財政赤字を毎年少なくとも０．５ポイント減らすことを義務付ける「黄金律」を国民投票にかけ、財政規律を憲法に明記したいと述べた。

また欧州連合（ＥＵ）の予算協議でフランスの純拠出額を５０億ユーロ（５６億１０００万ドル）に減らすよう求める考えを示した。

さらに、数週間以内にフランスの年金制度に関する提案を行うと表明した。節税スキームを利用して納税額を圧縮している多国籍企業への対策として、売上高に占めるフランス国内での売上高の割合に基づいて課税する方針を示した。

＜金利上昇巡りＥＣＢと協議＞

同氏は、フランスが財政を再び管理できるようになった段階で、借り入れコストを引き下げるための介入について欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）と協議すべきだと述べた。

ＥＣＢには、市場の圧力に直面したユーロ加盟国の国債を、健全な経済政策の維持を条件に買い入れる伝達保護措置（ＴＰＩ）という制度がある。レスキュール経済・財務相は６日、同国の国債市場の混乱について、資金調達環境の安定に向けてＴＰＩの活用を検討する段階には至っていないとの認識を示した。

items.title: 英、米メタを調査　インスタの「インスタンツ」機能巡り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［６日　ロイター］ - 英情報通信庁は６日、米メタ・プラットフォームズの写真共有アプリ「インスタグラム」の新機能「インスタンツ（Instants）」を巡り調査を開始したと発表した。導入前にリスクを適切に評価しておらず、同国のオンライン安全関連法に違反した疑いがあるとした。

インスタンツは、利用者が共有したコンテンツが閲覧後に消去される機能で５月に導入された。

情報通信庁は、メタが新機能を導入する前に違法コンテンツのリスクや児童への潜在的リスクについて「適切かつ十分な」評価を実施したかどうかを確認する方針。

オフコムの執行責任者ジョージ・ラスティ氏は「われわれのオンライン安全法は明確だ。プラットフォームの重大な変更は立ち上げ前にリスク評価を受けなければならない」と述べた。

安全性は設計段階から組み込む必要があり、後付けするものではないと指摘。「本日の調査開始は、提供事業者がコンプライアンス違反の懸念がある場合、われわれが行動することを示している」とした。

メタは、オンライン安全法に基づく規制上の義務を真剣に受け止めているとし、調査に協力すると述べた。

同社の広報担当者は「リスク分析を実施した上で、導入前に何度もＯｆｃｏｍに同機能について説明した」と述べた。

「インスタンツには保護機能が組み込まれている。スクリーンショットや再共有、転送はできず、公開フィードもない。『ティーンアカウント』の保護機能も自動で有効になる」とした。

items.title: Crew goes missing after ship sinks in Black Sea Zone of Bulgaria following drone strike, says PM
items.author: Swati Gandhi
items.summary: Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev on Tuesday (local time) said that the crew of a ship that sunk following a drone strike in the country's Black Sea Zone is missing, Reuters reported.
items.body:
Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev on Tuesday (local time) said that the crew of a ship that sank following a drone strike in the country's Black Sea zone is missing, AFP reported.Speaking to reporters, Radev condemned the drone attack on two commercial ships, calling it "a flagrant violation of maritime law". He added, "Such an attack within the Bulgarian exclusive economic zone is absolutely unacceptable." Here's what we knowHis remarks came shortly after local media reported that drones struck two commercial vessels in the Black Sea off the coast of Bulgaria, sinking one of them. After convening an emergency meeting on Tuesday, Radev stated that the ships were attacked by several drones roughly 80 miles (128km) off Bulgaria's coast.Rumen Nikolov, head of local rescue operations in Varna, was quoted as saying that sailors from the sunken ship were missing, while those aboard the second vessel were rescued, AFP reported.Rescue teams were searching for the missing sailors about 150 kilometres (90 miles) east of the coastal city of Byala. At least 18 crew members from the other vessel were evacuated by a Bulgarian ferry following the strikes. Of the evacuated members, two suffered severe injuries and were flown to a hospital in the port city of Varna, Radev stated.Radev said the Togo-flagged vessel Alfa Watan sustained severe structural damage in the strike and sank at the site, while the status of its crew remained unclear.British maritime security and risk consultancy Vanguard said two cargo ships were targeted by drones on Tuesday while operating within Bulgaria’s exclusive economic zone, according to Reuters.The vessels involved were the Togo-flagged general cargo ship ALFA WATAN and the Palau-flagged ABLE. According to Vanguard, both ships sent distress alerts after the attacks, while Bulgarian sources told Reuters that drones had struck the vessels.The latest incident comes a day after Romanian authorities reported that two people were killed in a fire aboard a ship in the Black Sea, outside Romania’s territorial waters.Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy attributed that incident to Russian drone attacks. Russia had not immediately commented on the allegation.
The Black Sea has faced growing security risks since Russia launched its invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Several European nations have since reported incidents involving Russian drones entering their airspace, while sea mines have also been detected in the Black Sea, affecting key trade and energy routes.
Last month, Turkey's Chamber of Maritime Commerce (IMEAK) said that 226 civilian and commercial ships had come under attack in the Black Sea since the war began, with most of the incidents recorded this year.
