items.title: 仏高校生デモ全国に拡大、教師や保護者含む25万人参加　マクロン氏緊急会合
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Inti Landauro　Tilman Blasshofer　Cecile Mantovani　Lucien Libert

［ストラスブール／リヨン／パリ　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Inti Landauro　Tilman Blasshofer　Cecile Mantovani　Lucien Libert

［ストラスブール／リヨン／パリ　６日　ロイター］ - フランスで教育環境の改善を求める高校生の抗議活動が３週目に入り、６日は各地で高校生らとともに教師や保護者が街頭デモに参加した。首都パリのほか、ストラスブール、レンヌ、トゥールーズなどの都市で警察はデモ行進の周辺で暴徒化した集団を排除するため催涙ガスや放水砲を使用。内務省によるとデモには全国数十都市で２５万人を超える人が参加した。

この日のデモはこれまでで最大規模。主催者側は４５万人が参加したとしている。ルコルニュ首相は議会で、これまでの衝突で少なくとも生徒２１５人と学校職員８５人が負傷したと明らかにし、「教育現場が払った犠牲としては数十年で最も大きい」と述べた。首相府によると、これまでに７００人を超える警察官が負傷。内務省によると、この日のデモで４８８人が拘束され、治安要員４８人が負傷した。

ＢＦＭテレビによると、マクロン大統領はこの日、事態への対応を協議するためにルコルニュ首相と関係閣僚を招集し緊急会合を開催した。ルコルニュ首相は高校生らが掲げる主要な要求への対応を関係閣僚に指示。老朽化した校舎の改修についても検討すると表明し、関係閣僚に対し今月末までに最初の提案を取りまとめるよう要請した。高校生らは欠員教員の補充のほか、午前８時から午後６時までに及ぶ授業時間の見直し、昼休み時間の延長などを要求している。

フランスで抗議活動が拡大していることについて、トランプ米大統領は「制御不能となった」移民問題の証拠だと主張。自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に「これは学校を巡る問題ではない。かつて偉大だった国をイスラム教が支配しようとしているという問題だ」と投稿した。

ただ、フランスの高校生の要求は人員不足や教育予算の不足への対応で、宗教や移民問題に関するものではない。フランスの極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」を率いるマリーヌ・ルペン氏も、今回の抗議行動をフランスの移民政策と結び付けていない。この件に関して、ロイターは仏首相府からコメントを得られていない。

＜各地でデモ、パリでは約３００人が治安部隊と対峙＞

マルセイユやナントでは、参加者が「国が教育を壊した」などと書かれたプラカードを掲げ、デモはおおむね平穏に行われた。トゥールーズでは、保護者が腕を組み、市内を行進するデモ隊の先頭に立った。一方、ストラスブール、リヨン、レンヌではデモが時折、暴力的な衝突に発展。抗議参加者が路上で火を付けたりする事態となり、警察が催涙ガスを発射して鎮圧に乗り出した。

パリ警察によると、パリではフードやマスクで顔を隠した約３００人が治安部隊と対峙。複数の店舗が損壊するなど被害を受けたものの、デモ自体はおおむね大きな混乱なく行われたという。

抗議活動は２週間前にパリ郊外の貧困地区で始まり、全国に広がった。パリでは「催涙ガスではなく、私たちの声に耳を傾けて」「私たちの未来を後回しにするな」と書いた横断幕が掲げられた。

高校生団体によると、国内の高校の半数超が封鎖されるか、休校になった。一部の地方教育当局は授業のオンライン移行を試みている。

＜デモ開始以来６１００人逮捕、大多数が未成年＞

人権団体や学生団体、保護者団体は、当局が未成年者に対して過剰な実力行使を行っていると非難。これに対し政府は、抗議運動が部外者に乗っ取られ、一部では都市型暴動へと発展したとの認識を示している。

内務省によると、抗議活動の開始以来６１００人が逮捕された。大多数が未成年という。未成年１４８３人を含む１８００人超が訴追されているが、司法省は罪名は明らかにしていない。

大統領選を６カ月後に控え、政府と極右政党・国民連合は急進左派「不服従のフランス」（ＬＦＩ）の議員や市長らが抗議活動をあおっていると非難。ＬＦＩはこうした非難を否定している。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ヘルシンキ ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ヘルシンキ ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁は６日、ユーロ圏全体で急速に進んでいるエネルギー価格の上昇はまだ他の財やサービスには波及しておらず、最近の債券利回りの上昇は成長を圧迫することで物価上昇圧力を和らげる可能性が高いと述べた。

多くの政策当局者がインフレリスクは予想よりも高めに傾いていると指摘する中、レーン氏は、経済には相反する力が働いているため、他にも考慮すべき点があると指摘。「長期金利の上昇は成長の鈍化につながるだけでなく、エネルギー価格が他の物価や賃金に波及する度合いを弱めている」と語った。

また、人工知能（ＡＩ）への力強い投資などにより、経済が並外れた強靭性を示しているとも指摘した。

一部の政策当局者はこうした強靭性について、これまで考えられていたよりも強い物価上昇圧力を示唆していると指摘している。

items.title: Kenya confirms first Ebola case after man who travelled from Congo dies
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case on Tuesday after a Kenyan citizen who had travelled from Democratic Republic of Congo died in Nairobi.
items.body:
Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case on Tuesday after a Kenyan citizen who had travelled from Democratic Republic of Congo died in Nairobi.
Kenya is the fourth country to record a case linked to the Ebola epidemic in eastern Congo, the [USN:L1N45O094 TEXT:"second largest on record"] with more than 8,000 cases.
Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths earlier in the year but was declared Ebola-free in August. A doctor who [USN:L8N42W0OV TEXT:"returned to France"] in June from Congo tested positive but there was no further spread of the virus.
The Kenyan patient, who had lived in Congo for seven years, had been ill for about a month before travelling by road from Congo to Uganda's capital, Kampala, and then flying to Nairobi on Saturday, Kenya's Health Minister Aden Duale told a news conference.
After arriving at Nairobi's international airport, he passed through health screening and was later taken by a relative to Nairobi Hospital. He was admitted with fever, chills and bleeding beneath the skin and was quickly placed in isolation, Duale said.
He died late on Monday.
Eight of his family members and 21 healthcare workers who attended to him have been quarantined and are being monitored, Kenyan President William Ruto's office said.
PATIENT BURIED UNDER HEALTH PROTOCOLS The patient was buried under protocols designed to prevent further spread of the virus, Ruto's office said.
Health authorities are trying to trace 23 passengers and four crew members who were on his Jambojet flight, Duale said.
The health minister said Kenya had trained nearly 5,000 health workers across the country on prevention and management and the UN's senior Ebola coordinator, Julien Harneis, told Reuters he expected a "solid health response" from Kenya to manage the disease.
The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) said in a statement that it was immediately sending a high-level team to Kenya to provide support, adding that the case "underscores the importance of sustained preparedness across the region".
World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said on X that the WHO was supporting the Kenyan and Ugandan governments and recommended against any travel restrictions on countries affected by the outbreak.
Nevertheless, the incident raised questions about measures meant to prevent the spread of the virus across borders.
Kenya's health ministry director-general, Patrick Amoth, said the patient may have passed through airport screening because medication had masked his symptoms.
Uganda's health ministry said screening teams observed he had a normal temperature at Entebbe airport.
It was also not clear how he had crossed from Congo into Uganda, given that the border has been closed since May. The Africa CDC said he spent a night in Uganda before boarding the flight to Kenya.
Asked about this, Ugandan government spokesperson Alan Kasujja said in a text message: "Leave Uganda out of this conversation ... We don't have Ebola here."
KENYA HOSTS US EBOLA QUARANTINE FACILITY After the outbreak was declared in Congo, the United States built a 50-bed Ebola quarantine camp for US citizens on an air force base in central Kenya.
The facility is currently empty and has only housed seven people. Kenyan officials have said it could receive Kenyans and other nationalities, but the US government has not confirmed that.
Ebola spreads through direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected people, whether living or dead. The disease can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding.
The outbreak in Congo was declared in mid-May but may have started months earlier. Caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, it has been blamed for more than 4,000 deaths .

items.title: Former German spy chief arrested for attempted treason, obtaining state secrets
items.author: Friederike Heine
items.creator: Friederike Heine
items.summary: Former German spy chief August Hanning was detained on Tuesday on suspicion of attempted treason in a case that ranks among Germany's biggest intelligence scandals since the Cold War.
items.body:
Former German spy chief August Hanning was detained on Tuesday on suspicion of attempted treason in a case that ranks among Germany's biggest intelligence scandals since the Cold War.
Prosecutors accused him of paying for secret documents and using them in an analysis for a foreign spy service. They did not identify the intelligence service and it was not immediately clear whether the analysis reached its intended recipient.
The arrest of a former head of Germany's foreign intelligence is unprecedented and could damage the country's intelligence relationships with allied nations, according to a senior security lawmaker.
"Hanning is strongly suspected of treasonous espionage, obtaining state secrets, attempted treason and espionage," the prosecutor's office said in a statement.
The Spiegel news magazine reported late on Tuesday that investigators were pursuing a possible connection to Azerbaijan. It reported Hanning had been in contact with an agent from the country.
The federal prosecutor's office declined to comment on the report.
Hanning did not respond to a request for comment. The chancellery declined to comment.
Five years after his seven-year tenure as head of the BND foreign intelligence service ended in 2005, Hanning agreed with a former BND office manager to receive confidential intelligence information in exchange for payment, according to prosecutors.
The office manager, identified as Manfred D. in line with privacy rules, was also arrested on Tuesday, and both were due to appear before a judge at the Federal Court of Justice.
Manfred D. served as office manager to successive BND presidents until March 2026, potentially giving him access to some of Germany's most current intelligence at the time that prosecutors say documents were being siphoned from the service.
'NO COMPROMISES' Prosecutors said D. is suspected of having supplied around 2,000 documents over the years, including classified material intended solely for internal use within the BND and senior-level intelligence briefings at the chancellery.
Those included documents relating to the Iranian nuclear programme and the Russian military, as well as highly sensitive material classified as secret by allied intelligence agencies in other countries, Sueddeutsche Zeitung (SZ) newspaper reported.
Prosecutors said Hanning had used classified information supplied by D. to prepare an analysis for an officer of a foreign intelligence service and for years shared political information with a representative of the spy agency.
The case does not involve Russia, according to information obtained by Sueddeutsche Zeitung.
Conservative security expert Roderich Kiesewetter told the Handelsblatt newspaper on Tuesday that the case could strain relations with Germany's intelligence allies, saying espionage cases of this kind were "particularly burdensome for trust and particularly damaging for Germany".
BND President Martin Jaeger said the agency had launched extensive internal investigations as soon as suspicions emerged, adding, "There can be no compromises on internal security."
PAST SPY SCANDALS Hanning's arrest is the latest in a series of notorious espionage scandals in Germany.
West German Chancellor Willy Brandt was forced to resign in 1974 after it was revealed that an East German spy had worked as his close aide for nearly two years. In 1990, senior West German counter-intelligence official Klaus Kuron was exposed as a Stasi spy and later convicted of treason.
More recently, former domestic intelligence chief Hans-Georg Maassen said in 2024 he was being monitored by the security agency he once ran over alleged right-wing political extremism, which he denied.

items.author: ロイター

items.summary:

［東京　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
(本文３段落目の「２５年度」を「２００５年度」に訂正します)

Makiko Yamazaki　Takaya Yamaguchi

［東京　６日　ロイター］ - 自民党の中西健治議員は６日、国債発行全体に占める個人向け販売を「桁違い」に拡大する必要があると述べた。税優遇を含む商品設計の見直しを通じ、国債消化の柱のひとつに据える考えを強調した。ロイターとのインタビューで語った。

財務省が６日発表した１０月発行分の個人向け国債（１０年変動、５年固定、３年固定）は１兆０２５１億円だった。

年度ベースでは累計６兆１６４１億円となり、当初計画（５兆９０００億円）をすでに上回った。過去最大だった２００５年度（訂正、７兆２７１２億円）を上回るペースにある。

ただ、中西氏は「もっと買ってもらえる余地はある」と強調。「そのための後押しは必要」との考えを述べた。

日銀が国債買い入れを減らす中、２０００兆円を超える家計の金融資産をどう取り込むかは、今後の財政運営を占う試金石となる。金利上昇に伴う個人向け国債の売れ行きは好調だが、保有比率は依然として低い。

中西氏はインタビューで、税優遇を含む商品設計の見直しにも言及。利回り曲線が傾斜化し、超長期債利回りが「魅力的な水準になってきている。（１０年を超える）長いものも、あったらいい」としている。

items.title: UK watchdog opens first Online Safety Act probe into Meta
items.author: Paul Sandle
items.creator: Paul Sandle
items.summary: Britain's communications regulator opened its first formal investigation into Meta under the Online Safety Act on Tuesday, questioning whether it properly assessed risks posed by its Instagram Instants feature before launching it in May.
items.body:
Britain's communications regulator opened its first formal investigation into Meta under the Online Safety Act on Tuesday, questioning whether it properly assessed risks posed by its Instagram Instants feature before launching it in May.
Instants allows content shared by users on Instagram to disappear after being viewed.
Ofcom said its investigation would establish whether Meta carried out a "suitable and sufficient" assessment of the risks of illegal content on the feature and any risks posed to children before its launch.
George Lusty, director of enforcement at Ofcom, said: "Our online safety laws are clear — significant changes to platforms must be risk assessed before they're launched."
Safety by design had to be built in and not bolted on, he said. "Today's investigation shows we'll take action where we have concerns that providers are failing to comply," he said.
Meta said it took its regulatory obligations under the Online Safety Act seriously.
"We conducted a risk analysis and briefed Ofcom about this feature on a number of occasions before launching it," a spokesperson said.
"Instants has in-built protections, including blocking screenshots, reshares and forwarding, no public feed, and Teen Account protections on automatically."
"We will of course co-operate with Ofcom during this investigation," the spokesperson said.
Ofcom's first investigation under the Online Safety Act was into an online suicide discussion forum last year, followed by probes into pornography sites, file-sharing services used to distribute child sexual abuse material, and platforms such as 4chan.
Britain's online safety regime sets obligations for social media platforms, search engines and adult content providers to tackle illegal content and to protect children's safety.
Ofcom requires companies to conduct risk assessments and implement safety measures, such as age verification.
If a company fails to comply, Ofcom can impose fines of up to £18 million or 10% of qualifying worldwide revenue, whichever is greater.
Meta has launched legal challenges against Ofcom over its implementation of the act, including the scale and scope of information it has to provide to the regulator and the level of fees Ofcom charges.
In January, Ofcom launched an investigation into Meta over the provision of information about its WhatsApp Business product under a separate Communications Act.

items.summary: In an official statement, the Federal Prosecutor’s Office announced that the two German nationals were taken into custody on Tuesday, in Bad Tölz-Wolfratshausen County, Bavaria, and Steinfurt County, ...
items.body:
Former German Intelligence Chief August Hanning arrested on alleged treason and espionage charges In an official statement, the Federal Prosecutor’s Office announced that the two German nationals were taken into custody on Tuesday, in Bad Tölz-Wolfratshausen County, Bavaria, and Steinfurt County, North Rhine-Westphalia, pursuant to warrants issued by the Investigating Judge at the Federal Court of Justice. Law enforcement officers simultaneously searched properties in both locations as well as in Berlin.
ANI | Updated: 06-10-2026 20:29 IST | Created: 06-10-2026 20:29 IST

Former General Federal Intelligence Service (BND) President August Hanning (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Germany's Federal Criminal Police Office agents have arrested former Federal Intelligence Service (BND) President August Hanning and his former chief of staff, Manfred D, on serious charges including treasonous espionage, spying on state secrets, attempted treason, and espionage, Euro News reported. In an official statement, the Federal Prosecutor’s Office announced that the two German nationals were taken into custody on Tuesday, in Bad Tölz-Wolfratshausen County, Bavaria, and Steinfurt County, North Rhine-Westphalia, pursuant to warrants issued by the Investigating Judge at the Federal Court of Justice. Law enforcement officers simultaneously searched properties in both locations as well as in Berlin.
Hanning, who served as President of the BND from December 1998 to November 2005 and later as State Secretary at the Federal Ministry of the Interior between December 2005 and November 2009, is "strongly suspected of treasonous espionage, spying out state secrets, attempted treason, and espionage." Manfred D, who served as Hanning's chief of staff at the BND and parliamentary assistant at the Interior Ministry before resuming duties as chief of staff for several subsequent BND presidents from March 2012 to March 2026, is charged with "aiding and abetting attempted treason and treasonous espionage."
According to federal prosecutors, the two suspects agreed in the spring of 2010 that Manfred D would systematically leak confidential intelligence files to Hanning in exchange for payment. Over the years, Manfred D allegedly provided Hanning with approximately 2,000 documents, many containing restricted intelligence intended strictly for internal agency use and executive briefings involving senior officials from federal ministries and German security agencies at the Federal Chancellery. Investigators revealed that Hanning utilised the classified material to enhance his private consultancy services. Prosecutors stated that on one occasion, Hanning "used classified intelligence provided by Manfred D. to draft an analysis for an officer of a foreign intelligence service," though it remains undetermined if the report reached its destination. Furthermore, Hanning was "in close contact with a representative of another foreign intelligence service, to whom he passed on political information, partially based on material provided by Manfred D., for several years."
The wide-ranging probe originated after a search of Hanning's property by Hamburg prosecutors in September 2025 during an investigation involving German businesswoman Christina Block and alleged leaks from the Chancellery. Euronews, citing reports by the German newspaper Süddeutsche Zeitung, along with public broadcasters WDR and NDR, previously pointed to evidence uncovered during those proceedings regarding the unauthorised handling of sensitive state documents.
The Federal Prosecutor's Office officially took over the investigation in early May 2026, conducting the probe alongside the BND and the Federal Criminal Police Office. Both suspects were brought before the Investigating Judge at the Federal Court of Justice to review the charges and determine pre-trial detention. (ANI)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京 ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 木原稔官房長官は６日午後の会見で、企業や団体に対してサイバー攻撃が行われ情報が流出する事案が続発していることについて、「大変深刻に受け止めている」と述べた。

現在、政府として被害の全体像の把握に努めており、「流出した個人情報が悪用されると二次被害につながることから、パスワードの使い回しをやめ多要素認証を利用すること、また不審なメールに注意することなどを呼びかけている」とした。

また海外のサイバーセキュリティ関係機関・捜査当局との連携による情報収集も行っているとしたうえで、「サイバー攻撃の被害を受けた場合、早期に所管省庁や警察等の関係機関への通報、相談をお願いしたい」と呼びかけた。

items.title: 中国ディープシーク、少なくとも120億ドル調達へ＝通信社
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[６日 ロイター] - 中国の新興人工知能（ＡＩ）企業ディープシークは、最新の資金調達ラウンドで少なくとも８００億元（１１９億３０００万ドル）を確保する見通しとなった。ブルームバーグ・ニュースが６日、関係者の話として報じた。

報道によると、中国の電池大手、寧徳時代新能源科技（ＣＡＴＬ）と騰訊控股（テンセント）が最大規模の出資を約束している。

ディープシークは当初、約５００億元の調達を目指していたが、最新ＡＩモデルの投入が成功し、投資家の需要が予想を上回ったという。最終的な調達額は１０００億元に迫る可能性があるとした。

ディープシークは９月、最新モデル「Ｖ４．１－Ｆｌａｓｈ」を公開した。機能の向上、推論の高速化、処理能力の拡大、より大規模なモデルへの拡張を目指して設計したと説明した。

ロイターは先月、ディープシークが上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）準備に向けて中信証券を起用したと報じた。ただ、上場時期や企業評価額、調達規模は未定とされている。

items.summary: 南アジア経済堅調、今年度の印成長率見通し7.1％に上げ＝世銀 | ロイター    Reuters
items.raw_description: 南アジア経済堅調、今年度の印成長率見通し7.1％に上げ＝世銀 | ロイター    Reuters

items.title: 南アジア経済堅調、今年度の印成長率見通し7.1％に上げ＝世銀
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Shubham Batra

[ニューデリー ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Shubham Batra

[ニューデリー ６日 ロイター] - 世界銀行は、エネルギーショックにもかかわらず消費者需要が堅調であることを理由に南アジアの成長見通しを引き上げた。ただ、原油価格の高止まり、深刻な気象ショック、世界的な市場の調整が地域の見通しを脅かす可能性があると警告した。

同地域の２０２６年の成長率を６．９％と予測。これは前回予測より６０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）高く、１年前の予測を１０ｂｐ上回っている。

世銀のアジア担当チーフエコノミスト、フランツィスカ・オーンソルゲ氏は５日、ロイターとのインタビューで「消費者を保護するための政府の措置、堅調な送金、そして底堅い内需が、その（エネルギー価格上昇の）影響を和らげる一助となったためだ」と述べた。

地域最大の経済大国であるインドの２６／２７年度の成長率は７．１％と予測。６月時点の６．６％から上方修正されたものの、前年度に記録された８．６％よりは大幅に低い水準となる。

オーンソルゲ氏は「インフレ率は２７年にかけて高止まりが続くと予想される」と述べ、インフレ率の上昇が成長に影響を及ぼすまでには時間がかかる可能性があると付け加えた。「新興国市場において、こうしたショックと経済活動への影響との間に生じる通常のタイムラグは約１８カ月だ」と語った。

強いエルニーニョ現象が、特に農業が農村部の需要とインフレの鍵を握るインドにとって、さらなるリスクとなり得るとも指摘した。

世銀はまた、中期的な成長の勢いを維持するため、各国に対しＡＩ（人工知能）の導入を強く促した。

報告書は「より多く、より質の高い雇用を創出するための有望な手段の一つは、ＡＩの広範な導入だ。南アジアにおけるＡＩの導入は、先進国に比べて依然として大きく遅れているが、急速に追い上げている」と述べている。

同地域の経済成長の大部分を占めるインドでは、企業の約２３％がＡＩを利用していると報告しているのに対し、米国では４３％の企業がＡＩを利用していると報告している。

items.title: フィジカルＡＩは「勝ち筋、うまくやれば独壇場に」＝赤沢経産相
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京 ６日 ロイター] - 赤沢亮正経済産業相は６日、都内で講演し、フィジカルＡＩ（人工知能）は「間違いなくわが国の勝ち筋であり、うまくやれば独壇場になる。ＡＩロボットとフィジカルＡＩの開発にかなり賭けている」と強調した。
items.body:
[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 赤沢亮正経済産業相は６日、都内で講演し、フィジカルＡＩ（人工知能）は「間違いなくわが国の勝ち筋であり、うまくやれば独壇場になる。ＡＩロボットとフィジカルＡＩの開発にかなり賭けている」と強調した。 ＡＩ自体の開発では米国や中国に「今のところ歯が立たない」ものの、日本には「世界有数の製造現場と世界で唯一の（原発の）廃炉の現場がある」と述べ、こうした知見を活用することが日本の強みになるとの見方を示した。

赤沢氏は、中国がレアアースの「チョークポイント（急所）」を握って経済的威圧を行っている一方、「ＡＩや半導体を製造するにあたっての素材や製造装置は、日本がかなりチョーキングポイントを握っている」と指摘。「しっかり維持して日本の強みとして生かしていくのは当然だ」と語った。ＡＩ時代には「スタートアップの成功確率が劇的に高まる可能性がある」とも話し、「わが国のスタートアップ振興のための政策をもう一回、ゼロから抜本的に強力に見直したい」とした。

＜サハリン２の権益維持、かなり優先順位高い＞

経産省は同日、ウクライナ侵攻を続けるロシアに対する追加制裁として、ロシアの産業基盤強化に資する物品の輸出禁止措置を追加実施すると発表した。 赤沢氏は、ロシアの「侵略」は非難されるべきもので「われわれはウクライナサイドに立っている」とした上で、ロシア・サハリン州の石油・天然ガス開発事業「サハリン２」 については「日本の権益をきちっと維持することはかなり優先順位の高い課題」で、「そのことについて今ロシアとの間で何か問題を抱えているわけではない」と説明。同盟国も含めた了解を得た上で輸入されているとも述べた。

その上で、仮に日本が権益を手放せば「どこの国とは言わないが、他の国が入ってきて、われわれが開発に膨大な税金を費やしたものをただ持っていかれる。それが国益にかなうのかということも含めてやってきている」と語った。

＜ＡＩの開発速度巡る問題、米中の動向が鍵に＞

人工知能（ＡＩ）の開発速度を抑制すべきだとの主張については、危惧は理解するとした一方で「中国と米国両方が同意しない限りはあまり実効性がない」と指摘。一方が応じなければ「開発を続けた方が早く新しいものを開発することは目に見えている」と述べ、米中がルール作りに合意し、順守しなければ速度抑制の実現は難しいだろうと述べた。

items.summary: Demonstrations swept across France on Tuesday as teachers and parents took to the streets with high school pupils on the biggest day of what Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu described as the most violent student demonstrations in decades.
items.body:
Demonstrations swept across France on Tuesday as teachers and parents took to the streets with high school pupils on the biggest day of what Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu described as the most violent student demonstrations in decades.
Police fired tear gas and water cannons to disperse violent groups on the fringes of marches in Paris, Strasbourg, Rennes and Toulouse, among other cities. The marches drew more than 250,000 people in dozens of cities, the interior ministry said, though organisers said 450,000 had participated.
The protests, in which a teenager lost a hand on Monday, were the latest manifestation of public anger in a country where support for populist parties on the far right and far left has surged ahead of a presidential election in the spring.
The government is under pressure to tame public debt amid weak growth, and has struggled with basic tasks such as passing a budget since President Emmanuel Macron's allies lost their majority in a 2024 parliamentary vote.
Lecornu told lawmakers at least 215 teenagers and 85 school staff had so far been injured in clashes, "the heaviest toll in decades paid by the school system". His office said more than 700 police officers were also hurt.
Macron has convened Lecornu and other senior ministers at an emergency meeting on Tuesday, broadcaster BFM reported.
US President Donald Trump said the protests were evidence of "out of control" migration in France. "This isn't about schools, this is about Islam wanting to take over a once great Country," he posted on Truth Social.
The students' demands do not concern religion or immigration, but focus instead on understaffing and lack of funding. Marine Le Pen's far-right National Rally party has not linked the protests to France's migration policy. Lecornu's office did not respond to a request for comment.
In Marseille and Nantes, protesters held up handmade signs bearing phrases such as "The state has killed national education". In Toulouse, parents linked arms at the front of a march through the city.
Paris police said clashes in the capital resulted from some 300 people, most hooded or masked, facing off against security forces, and that the protest generally unfolded without major incident elsewhere. Several storefronts were damaged.
The Interior Ministry said 488 people had been arrested and 48 security personnel were injured on Tuesday.
MAINTENANCE COMPLAINTS The student protests began in September in the deprived suburbs of Paris before spreading nationwide.
Students complain about schools facing basic maintenance problems, from water leaks to rat infestations.
"There is such a gap between the elites and us," said Hugo Vetzel, a recent high-school graduate in Strasbourg.
The High School Students Union said more than half of France's high schools were blockaded or had closed for the day. Some local education authorities have tried to move classes online.
Rights groups, students and parent groups have accused authorities of using disproportionate force against minors. The government says the protest movement has been hijacked by outsiders and in some places deteriorated into urban violence.
More than 1,800 people are being prosecuted for unspecified crimes, including 1,483 minors, the justice ministry said on Monday.
"They want to divide the young people into good and bad protesters," said Omar Slaouti, a high-school teacher in Argenteuil, a northwestern suburb of Paris. "If there were no trash cans on fire, the government would not have stepped back and become aware of the issues at stake."
PRIME MINISTER PROMISES A RESPONSE Lecornu has ordered his ministers to tackle the students' leading demands. Those include ensuring absent teachers are replaced, reviewing the length of the 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. school day and the need for longer lunch breaks.
The government will also look at repairs needed to ageing school buildings, said Lecornu, who demanded ministers send in their first proposals by the end of October.
Parent Emilie Lhomme said at a protest outside the Helene Boucher school in Paris that the government's words were not enough: "That's all fine and dandy, but that's not what's going to change the daily lives of our children," she said.
Finding spare cash to implement educational reforms will be difficult.
The government is under pressure to try to narrow a ballooning budget deficit as investor concerns about France's growing debt, weak growth and reluctance to rein in spending push the cost of borrowing higher. The yield on [USN:L8N45O0YO TEXT:"France's 10-year bonds"] briefly hit a 24-year high of over 5% last week.
The surge in French borrowing costs has started to spill into the broader euro area, with the [USN:L6N45S0D2 TEXT:"sliding euro currency"] the latest alarm bell for policy makers. Finance Minister Roland Lescure said on Tuesday there was no need for the [USN:S8N3XB0C2 TEXT:"European Central Bank"] to step in.
Le Pen, the far-right euro-sceptic populist leading the presidential race ahead of next spring's election, set out [USN:L1N45S0C4 TEXT:"plans to slash public spending if elected"], seeking to establish her fiscal credibility as the bond market crisis deepens.
French spending on education has lagged inflation and the country's students are trailing their OECD peers in overall performance, data from the[USN:L8N44Z0XI TEXT:" PISA 2025 assessment"] shows.

items.summary: [パリ ６日 ロイター] - フランスのレスキュール経済・財務相は６日、同国の国債市場の混乱について、資金調達環境の...
items.body:
仏国債市場の混乱、ＴＰＩ活用を検討する段階でない＝財務相
10/6 16:22 配信

フランスのレスキュール経済・財務相。10月1日、パリのエリゼ宮で撮影。REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

[パリ ６日 ロイター] - フランスのレスキュール経済・財務相は６日、同国の国債市場の混乱について、資金調達環境の安定に向けて欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の伝達保護措置（ＴＰＩ）の活用を検討する段階には至っていないとの認識を示した。

記者団に「もちろん何としてもそうした事態を避けることが目標だ。だからこそ現在、財政健全化を重視している」と語った。

ＴＰＩは市場の圧力に直面したユーロ加盟国の国債を、健全な経済政策の維持を条件に買い入れる制度。

レスキュール氏は「信認の低下によって投資家が仏国債を売っているのではなく、買い手が減っている 」との見方を示した。

仏国債市場の混乱がユーロへの不信につながっている兆候は見られないと指摘した。足元の世界的な売りの中でも、ドイツ国債のパフォーマンスは最も良好な部類に入ると述べた。

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 日銀の植田和男総裁は６日、全国証券大会であいさつし、基調的...
items.body:
利上げの時期やペース、中心見通しの実現確度やリスク点検し検討＝植田日銀総裁
10/6 16:20 配信

日銀本店。9月18日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Takahiko Wada

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 日銀の植田和男総裁は６日、全国証券大会であいさつし、基調的な物価上昇率が２％に近づいている中、金融環境が緩和的なことを踏まえれば「経済・物価・金融情勢に応じて、引き続き政策金利を引き上げ、金融緩和度合いを調整していくことになる」と述べた。その上で、政策調整のタイミングやペースは、経済・物価の中心的な見通しが実現する確度やリスクを点検しながら検討していくとした。

基調物価が２％を超えて上振れていくリスクが顕在化し、その後の経済に悪影響を及ぼすことがないよう「基調的な物価上昇率を２％程度の水準で安定させていくという観点が、これまでよりも重要になってきている」と述べた。

経済・物価は、展望リポートで示してきた「中心的な見通しにおおむね沿って推移している」とし、景気は「中東情勢の影響もあって一部に弱めの動きもみられるが、緩やかに回復している」と述べた。１日発表の９月短観について、企業の業況感は「良好な水準」だと評価した。一方、中長期の予想物価上昇率は引き続き上昇しており、「消費者物価の基調的な上昇率は２％に近づいている」と話した。

中心的見通しを巡るリスク要因としては、中東情勢や人工知能（ＡＩ）関連需要の拡大、為替変動を挙げた。

植田総裁は９月の利上げ後も「緩和的な金融環境は維持されるため、引き続き経済活動をしっかりとサポートしていく」とも述べた。

Maria Martinez

[ベルリン　６日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦統計庁が６日発表した８月の鉱工業受注は、季節...
items.body:
ドイツ鉱工業受注、8月は10.6％減　大型案件が影響
10/6 16:17 配信

メルセデス・ベンツのエンジン工場。ベルリンで6月9日撮影。REUTERS/Axel Schmidt

Maria Martinez

[ベルリン　６日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦統計庁が６日発表した８月の鉱工業受注は、季節・営業日調整済みで前月比１０．６％減少し、ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想（１．０％減）よりもマイナス幅が大きくなった。航空機、船舶、鉄道車両、軍用車両への大規模な受注が減少した。

「その他の輸送用機器」が６１．５％減少。７月に同分野の受注は２倍以上に増加していた。

大型案件を除くと、８月の新規受注は０．１％減だった。

変動が平準化される３カ月間の比較では、６─８月の新規受注は、直前の３カ月間と比べて１．３％増加した。

７月の新規受注（改定値）は前月比３．２％増加。速報値（２．５％増）から上方改定された。

８月の海外受注は５．４％減。ユーロ圏からの受注は５．４％減、ユーロ圏以外からの受注は５．５％減となった。

国内受注は１７．３％減少した。

＜第３・四半期の成長に重しか＞

ドイツ商工会議所の経済専門家のユップ・ツェンツェ氏は「変動の激しい大口受注を除くと、製造業の受注は数カ月にわたって横ばいが続いている」と指摘。「景気回復に広がりは見られない」と述べた。

コメルツ銀行のシニアエコノミスト、ラルフ・ゾルフェーン氏は、これまでに公表された統計を見る限り、上半期とは対照的に、第３・四半期は鉱工業部門が独経済の成長を鈍らせた可能性が高いと述べた。

ただ、同氏は第４・四半期にはこの傾向が反転すると予想している。政府の発注が増える見込みで、長期的に売上高や生産にプラスの影響を及ぼすとみている。「ここ数カ月で企業景況感が大幅に改善していることも、この見通しを裏付けている」と述べた。

ドイツ銀行のエコノミスト、マルク・シャッテンベルク氏によると、７月の最新データでは、受注残は過去最高の９カ月分に達した。「８月の数字は期待外れの弱さだったが、既に受注残が非常に高水準にあることを踏まえて見るべきだ」と述べた。

items.title: Britain Has Found a Politician Who Actually Knows Finance
items.author: Rosa Prince
items.creator: Rosa Prince
items.summary: If Andrew Griffith wanted to write a guide on how not to run an economy, he has lots of examples from his fairly short stint in British politics. items.body:
日経平均は続伸、原油安など支え　業績期待の買いも
10/6 15:59 配信

写真は2024年12月、都内の東京証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Hiroko Hamada

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は続伸し、前営業日比１．０５％（７３７円１２銭）高の７万０６８３円９８銭で取引を終えた。前日上昇した反動でマイナスに沈む場面もあったが、原油安などを背景にしっかりの展開が続いた。企業決算シーズンを前に業績期待も意識され、一部の半導体関連株や電子部品関連株が買われた。

日経平均は前営業日比０．０１％高でスタートした後、一時小幅安に転じたが、その後はすぐに切り返しプラス圏で推移した。寄与度の高い一部の半導体関連や電子部品関連、主力株の一角が堅調で相場を押し上げた。個別材料を手掛かりにした物色も活発だった。

後場に入ると日経平均は一段高となり、終盤に一時１．２２％（８５１円）高の７万０７９８円６２銭まで上昇。プライム市場では８割近くの銘柄が上昇するなど、相場全体が底堅い地合いとなった。ＴＯＰＩＸもしっかりだった。

マネックス証券のチーフ・マーケット・アナリスト、吉野貴晶氏は「米雇用統計が弱い結果となり、米国の早期利上げ観測が後退したという材料でここまで株価が上昇するのは意外感もある」と指摘。「相場の底堅さは維持されているものの、さらに上方向を試すためには別の材料が必要になる」とみている。

ＴＯＰＩＸは０．９２％高の４１８３．５６ポイントで取引を終えた。東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比０．９２％高の２１５７．０９ポイント。プライム市場の売買代金は７兆３０４８億２７００万円だった。東証３３業種では、非鉄金属、精密機器、銀行など３０業種が値上がり。情報・通信、建設、空運は値下がりした。

新興株式市場では、東証グロース市場２５０指数が続伸し、１．４１％高の８２３．７１ポイントだった。

個別では、アドバンテストは連日の上場来高値。ＴＤＫ、太陽誘電、フジクラは大幅高だった。企業などへの不正アクセスが頻発する中、セグエグループ、ソリトンシステムズなどサイバーセキュリティ関連も上昇。キオクシアホールディングス、ソフトバンクグループは軟調だった。

東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが１１５３銘柄（７４％）、値下がりは３４９銘柄（２２％）、変わらずは５０銘柄（３％）だった。

items.body:
Egypt, Lebanon, Oman, Greece, Cyprus keen to join IMEC; ministerial meet likely later this year: France  Egypt, Lebanon, Oman, Greece and Cyprus have expressed interest in joining the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC), French President’s Special Envoy for IMEC Gérard Mestrallet said on Tuesday, adding that an IMEC ministerial meeting is expected to be held later this year to consider expanding the corridor’s membership.

items.title: Drone sinks ship off Bulgaria, as fears grow about hybrid attacks by Russia
items.author: Alex Lefkowitz
items.creator: Alex Lefkowitz
items.summary: The crew of a merchant ship was missing on Tuesday after the vessel sank in the Black Sea off NATO member Bulgaria following a drone strike that Prime Minister Rumen Radev described as a gross violation of international law.
items.body:
The crew of a merchant ship was missing on Tuesday after the vessel sank in the Black Sea off NATO member Bulgaria following a drone strike that Prime Minister Rumen Radev described as a gross violation of international law.
It was not immediately clear who carried out the attack by air and sea drones about 70 nautical miles (130 km) off the coastal town of Byala in eastern Bulgaria, but there are growing concerns about [USN:L8N45R0NV TEXT:"hybrid attacks"] by Russia as it wages war in Ukraine .
Shipping sources said it appeared to be the first such attack in the waters of Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone.
Radev said it was unclear whether the drones came from Russia or from Ukraine, the BTA news agency reported. Bulgaria does not border either country but it holds a strategic position in the Black Sea, where both Ukraine and Russia have major ports.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, speaking in his nightly video address, said an investigation jointly with Bulgaria's navy showed that Russia was behind the attack.
"The Ukrainian Defence Forces were conducting no operations in this part of the sea," he said.
"This latest tragedy involving civilian ships is a continuation of Russia's attempt to make the western part of the Black Sea completely unsafe for navigation ... Our navy contacted their colleagues in Bulgaria and established that this was a Russian combined attack using both sea and aerial drones.
Moscow has made no comment on the incident.
Two ships were hit in the attack, Radev said in a televised statement. The crew of one, which was carrying grain, was rescued, with two injured. The other, which sank, was a Togo-flagged ship whose cargo was not disclosed. It is unclear how many people were on board.
The incident occurred some 140 nautical miles away from the Ukrainian coast.
A search has been launched for the missing crew and for any signs of an environmental threat.
RADEV WARNS OF RISK OF WIDENING CONFLICT A maritime security source said initial assessments of the strike suggested it had probably been a Russian attack.
Radev did not say who was behind the attack but made a reference to Russia's war in Ukraine.
"If this war is not brought to an end in time, it will continue to expand its geographical scope and increase the risk of even a global conflict," he said.
"We are seeing the war intensify, with all the rules of international law now being violated, and civilian vessels being attacked at sea. This is absolutely unacceptable."
European Commission President [USN:B5N443025 TEXT:"Ursula von der"] Leyen also condemned the attack, saying: "Commercial ships – and innocent crews – are being targeted, with lives already lost at sea."
Ukraine's Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said in a post on X that Russia "makes navigation a challenge. By making navigation a challenge, it drives up risks, insurance and transport costs, and threatens the flow of food to global markets."
DISTRESS SIGNALS REPORTED British maritime risk management group Vanguard said the attacks on Tuesday were on the Togo-flagged general cargo vessel ALFA WATAN and the Palau-flagged general cargo vessel ABLE, within Bulgaria’s economic zone.
The drone attack follows an incident in which Romanian authorities said on Monday [USN:L1N45R0CZ TEXT:"two people had died"] in a fire on a ship in the Black Sea outside Romania's territorial waters.
"The attacks represent a significant escalation in the threat to commercial shipping in the western Black Sea," maritime security firm MARISKS said in an advisory in which it advised captains and operators to watch out for drone activity in the area.
"Of particular concern is the apparent geographic expansion of incidents beyond waters immediately adjacent to Ukraine and into the EEZs of NATO members Romania and Bulgaria."
Zelenskiy blamed Russian drones for the Romania incident. Russian authorities have also made no comment on that incident.
Since Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, European countries have reported Russian drones breaching their airspace multiple times and mines floating in the Black Sea across trade and energy routes.

items.author: ロイター

[東京 ６日 ロイター] -

...
items.body:
午後3時のドルは158円前半でもみあい、日銀総裁の発言に関心向かう
10/6 15:28 配信

写真は１ドル紙幣。2021年11月撮影。REUTERS/Murad Sezer

Kentaro Sugiyama

[東京 ６日 ロイター] -

ドル／円 ユーロ／ドル ユーロ／円

午後３時現在 158.07／158.08 1.1213／1.1215 177.26／177.27

午前９時現在 157.94／157.98 1.1214／1.1220 177.18／177.19

ＮＹ午後５時 157.90／157.94 1.1221／1.1225 177.18／177.21

午後３時のドルは、前日ニューヨーク市場終盤に比べてややドル高／円安の１５８円前半で推移している。フランスの財政懸念などを背景とした欧州発のリスクオフでドルと円がともに買われる流れとなったが、日米金利差が意識される中で、相対的にドル買いがやや優勢となった。

ドル／円は午前１０時半頃に１５７．７８円の安値を付けた後、じり高となり、午後２時半前に高値の１５８．２１円を付けた。もっとも、日米当局が円安是正に向けて協調姿勢を示しており、積極的に上値は追いづらい状況で、午後３時にかけては伸び悩んだ。

トレイダーズ証券の井口喜雄・市場部長は「日米の協調行動が意識されて上値は攻め込めない一方、日米金利差が意識され、下値はしっかり買われる。この一週間ほどは大きなレンジが続き、方向感はあまり出ていない」と話す。

市場では、この後の植田和男日銀総裁のあいさつで動意づくか注目されている。次の利上げに前向きな見解を示すようなタカ派的な内容なら円買いにつながるとの見方もあるが、これまでの見解を踏襲する発言にとどまるとの予想も聞かれた。

items.title: フジＨＤ不動産事業売却、ブラックストーンやベインなど最終入札へ＝関係者
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kane Wu　Makiko Yamazaki

［東京　６日　ロイター］ - フジ・メディア・ホールディングス（フジＨ...
items.body:
フジＨＤ不動産事業売却、ブラックストーンやベインなど最終入札へ＝関係者
10/6 15:19 配信

写真はフジＨＤの看板。2025年1月、東京・お台場で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Kane Wu　Makiko Yamazaki

［東京　６日　ロイター］ - フジ・メディア・ホールディングス（フジＨＤ）が進める中核不動産子会社サンケイビルの売却を巡り、米国のブラックストーン、ベイン・キャピタル、ウォーバーグ・ピンカスなどが最終入札の準備を進めていることが分かった。事情に詳しい複数の関係者がロイターに明らかにした。負債を含めた取引額は１兆円規模に達する可能性があり、実現すれば不動産業界における国内最大級の買収案件となる。

３社のほか、カナダの保険大手サンライフ傘下の不動産投資ファンドであるＢＧＯが準備を進めている。１０月末までに拘束力のある最終提案を提出する方向という。関係者らは、情報が非公開であることを理由に匿名を条件に語った。

フジＨＤは提案内容を精査し、優先交渉先を選定。提案内容について株主の承認を求める見通しだという。

フジＨＤはロイターに対し、外部資本導入の方法などに関する詳細は「企業価値および株主共同の利益の最大化の観点から検討中」とし、「公表する必要のある事項が決定され次第、適時適切に開示する」と回答した。ブラックストーンとウォーバーグ・ピンカス、ベイン・キャピタルはコメントを控えた。ＢＧＯからは現時点で回答を得られていない。

一方、フジＨＤの一部株主からは取引プロセスの透明性向上を求める声も上がっている。

ロイターが確認した９月３０日付の書簡によると、シンガポールの投資ファンド、ヴァサンタ・マスターファンドは、清水賢治社長宛てに、サンケイビル資産の評価額や取引スキーム、一部売却やスピンオフ、資産ごとの段階的売却といった代替案の検討や、売却資金の使途などについて、より詳細な情報開示を求めた。

同ファンドはまた、不動産ポートフォリオの規模が大きく資産内容も多岐にわたるため、買収候補者が一部の大手プライベートエクイティ（ＰＥ）ファンドに限定される恐れがあると指摘。フジＨＤの既存株主へ還元される価値が十分確保されない可能性があると主張した。ヴァサンタの保有比率は１％未満。

＜日本の不動産、世界から注目＞

世界の投資家の間で日本の不動産市場への関心は高まっている。物件調査会社などによると、オフィス需要の底堅さや訪日観光客の増加、海外資本への開放性、円安などを背景に、日本は世界で最も注目される不動産投資市場の一つとなっている。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、日本の不動産資産を対象としたＭ＆Ａ（合併・買収） 取引額は１０月５日時点で１５５億ドル（約２兆４５００億円）となり、前年同期比４５％増加。２０１３年以来の高水準となっている。

フジＨＤは、米アクティビストファンドのダルトン・インベストメンツや、旧村上ファンド系の投資家らから、不動産資産の売却や政策保有株の解消を通じた資本効率改善を要求されていた。

また、著名タレントを巡る不祥事をきっかけに広告主の離反が相次ぎ、複数の経営幹部が退任。取締役会の刷新も迫られるなど、経営陣への圧力は一段と強まった。

フジＨＤは今年２月、発行済み株式のおよそ３０％に当たる約２３５０億円規模の自社株買いを実施。アクティビスト投資家などから株式を取得した。併せて、サンケイビルを含む不動産事業の見直しに着手すると発表。不動産事業への外部資本導入や売却を通じて、メディア・コンテンツ事業への投資を拡大し、資本効率の向上を目指している。

items.body:
Pakistan’s power crisis deepens as electricity shortfall crosses 4,000 MW According to ARY News, sources stated that the worsening shortfall has forced power distribution companies (DISCOs) to increase load-shedding across the country. Consumers in both urban and rural areas are reportedly facing three to four hours of power cuts, with the duration of outages increasing suddenly in several areas.
ANI | Updated: 06-10-2026 18:43 IST | Created: 06-10-2026 18:43 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Lahore [Pakistan], October 6 (ANI) Pakistan’s electricity crisis has intensified, with the country’s overall power deficit reportedly surpassing 4,000 megawatts as several generation units remain offline and hydropower production declines, as reported by ARY News. According to ARY News, sources stated that the worsening shortfall has forced power distribution companies (DISCOs) to increase load-shedding across the country. Consumers in both urban and rural areas are reportedly facing three to four hours of power cuts, with the duration of outages increasing suddenly in several areas.
The situation is particularly difficult in Lahore, where electricity demand has reportedly climbed to around 4,000 megawatts, against an available supply of approximately 3,000 megawatts. This has created a significant gap between demand and supply, adding to pressure on the already strained power distribution system. The latest deterioration has also raised questions over repeated government claims that Pakistan’s electricity shortages had been brought under control. The sources said the promised improvement has failed to materialise as the supply deficit continues to widen. Lahore is also reportedly experiencing a shortage of diesel following disruptions in gas availability, further complicating the city’s energy situation, sources said.
Meanwhile, the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA) has taken action against K-Electric (KE) over its practice of carrying out load-shedding on feeders based on aggregate technical and commercial (ATC) losses. NEPRA has declared such load-shedding illegal and directed K-Electric to immediately stop unannounced power outages carried out on the basis of feeder losses. The regulator maintained that consumers who regularly pay their electricity bills should not have their supply suspended simply because they are connected to feeders with high losses, as cited by ARY News.
NEPRA stressed that paying consumers should not be penalised for electricity theft or other failures by other users. The authority instructed K-Electric to take targeted action against individual consumers involved in electricity theft rather than cutting power to entire feeders, as reported by ARY News. (ANI)

items.body:
金価格、27年に最高値更新へ　投資需要が支援＝調査会社
10/6 14:41 配信

インドの宝飾店に並んだ金地金。2009年11月4日、北部チャンディーガルで撮影。REUTERS/Ajay Verma (INDIA BUSINESS)

[５日 ロイター] - 貴金属コンサルティング会社メタルズ・フォーカスは年次報告書で、金価格が２０２７年に過去最高値を更新するとの見通しを示した。根強いインフレや米財政赤字の拡大、政策の不透明感を背景に、従来のドル建て資産に代わる投資先を求める投資家の動きが上昇を後押しするという。

• ２７年の金の平均価格は、現在の水準を約２２％上回る１オンス＝５３３０ドルになる見通し。ただ、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が目標を上回るインフレに対処するため、金融引き締めをさらに進める可能性があり、短期的には逆風となり得るとした。

• 金現物価格は２６年１月下旬に５５９４．８２ドルの過去最高値を付けたが、その後はエネルギー価格の高騰やＦＲＢの金融引き締めを受け、２５％下落した。足元では４１５２．２７ドル付近で取引されている。[GOL/]

• メタルズ・フォーカスは銀についても、金を支えるマクロ経済要因の多くから恩恵を受け、今後１２─１８カ月に上昇すると予想した。

• 現物市場の需給逼迫ではなく、投資家の関心の再燃が上昇を支えると指摘。銀の平均価格は２６年第４・四半期の１オンス＝７０ドルから、２７年第４・四半期には９０ドルを上回ると見込んだ。

• プラチナは現物の需給逼迫が和らぐものの、供給不足の継続が価格を支える見通し。２７年の平均価格を１オンス＝２０６０ドルと予想し、年間の供給不足は５年連続になるとした。

items.summary: [東京 ６日 ロイター] - 年金積立金管理運用独立行政法人（ＧＰＩＦ）は６日、９月２８日に開催した経営委員会の議事...
items.body:
ＧＰＩＦ、9月経営委で基本ポートフォリオ見直しの議題なし
10/6 14:39 配信

写真はＧＰＩＦの看板。2018年11月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Toru Hanai

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 年金積立金管理運用独立行政法人（ＧＰＩＦ）は６日、９月２８日に開催した経営委員会の議事次第を公表した。同委の異例の８月開催を契機に市場では基本ポートフォリオ見直しに関する思惑が浮上していたが、関連する報告は今回の議題に盛り込まれなかった。

ＧＰＩＦは、経営委を８月としては７年ぶりに開催し、議事次第には「基本ポートフォリオ検証等ＰＴ（プロジェクトチーム）における議論について」との報告事項が記載されていた。

経営委で仮に各種計数の再確認が必要と判断され、見直し検討の必要性が決議されれば、基本ポートフォリオの正式な改定作業へと移行することになる。検証に進んだ場合、９月以降の経営委では基本ポートフォリオ検証等ＰＴのメンバーから各種計数の確認結果が報告されることになるとの指摘が出ていた。

items.title: マクドナルド、ＡＩで価格操作か　米顧客が集団訴訟求め提訴
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Mike Scarcella

[ワシントン ５日 ロイター] - 米ファストフードチェーン大手マクドナルドが人工知能（...
items.body:
マクドナルド、ＡＩで価格操作か　米顧客が集団訴訟求め提訴
10/6 13:50 配信

米ニューヨークにあるマクドナルドのドライブスルーの看板。７月撮影。 REUTERS/Jordan Tovin

Mike Scarcella

[ワシントン ５日 ロイター] - 米ファストフードチェーン大手マクドナルドが人工知能（ＡＩ）を活用した価格設定システムを通じて、加盟店と直営店のメニュー価格を違法に調整しているとして、シカゴの連邦裁判所に提訴された。原告は全米の顧客を対象とする集団訴訟の認定を求めている。

２日に提出された訴状は、マクドナルドが独立した加盟店と共謀し、非公開データで学習させたアルゴリズムを使って価格を操作することで、米国の反トラスト法（独占禁止法）に違反したと主張している。

ロイターは先週、マクドナルドの価格設定システムが機械学習アルゴリズムを使い、約１万４０００店舗で日々行われる数百万件の取引データを継続的に分析していると報じた。

訴状は「独立した事業者は、独自に価格を設定しなければならない」としている。 

マクドナルドは５日の声明で、原告の主張は憶測に基づき、実態を理解していないと反論した。

同社は「ビッグマックやその他のメニュー商品の価格を決めているのはＡＩではない」と表明。加盟店は独自に価格を決定しており、価格推奨ツールやデータ分析の活用は幅広い業界に浸透していると説明した。 

原告側の弁護士ラーク・ターナー氏は声明で、マクドナルドが「膨大なデータとフランチャイズ網を利用し、フライドポテトの最後の１本に至るまで、消費者から小銭を搾り取っている」と述べた。

訴状によると、原告はイリノイ州の住民で、数百万人に上る可能性があるマクドナルドの顧客を代表することを求めている。

items.title: 川崎重工、防衛事業の売上収益上振れへ　半導体用ロボットの生産能力倍増
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京 ６日 ロイター] - 川崎重工業は６日、最大７０００億円を計画していた２０３０年度の防衛事業の売上収益が８０００...
items.body:
川崎重工、防衛事業の売上収益上振れへ　半導体用ロボットの生産能力倍増
10/6 13:46 配信

都内の川崎重工業のオフィスで９月撮影。REUTERS/Manami Yamada

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 川崎重工業は６日、最大７０００億円を計画していた２０３０年度の防衛事業の売上収益が８０００億円に上振れる見込みだと発表した。政府の防衛費増額が追い風になるとしている。半導体用ロボットの生産能力を２倍に引き上げることも公表した。

同社はこの日、３０年度を最終年度とする経営計画の進捗説明会を開いた。事業別に説明していく中で、防衛を最初に取り上げた。

橋本康彦社長は「防衛費が増大したということと、防衛に関して国民の全体の理解が進んだ中で、そこに注力していくことを皆さんにお知らせするタイミングが来た」と語った。

３０年度に５０００億━７０００億円と見通していた防衛事業の売上収益は７０００─８０００億円に増えそうだという。事業利益率は防衛省との契約制度改正により、２７年度以降１０％を超える見込みだとした。

また、無人装備や人工知能（ＡＩ）の普及など戦い方の変化に対応し、２０３０年代中ごろに防衛事業の売上収益を１兆円超へ引き上げるとした。

半導体の製造現場で使うロボットの生産能力を、２９年度までに倍増することも発表した。既存の建屋を活用して７５億円を投資する。新工場の建設も視野に入れる。拡大する半導体製造装置の需要を取り込み、３５年に売り上げを１６００億円規模へ増やす。

連結では３０年度までの４年間で約５５００億円を成長投資に振り向ける。売上収益は従来目標の３兆円規模から３兆３０００億円超へ引き上げた。同社は７月、公募増資などで２０００億円を調達した。

items.title: オープンＡＩとアンソロピック、豪州のデータ侵害報告義務化を歓迎
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Byron Kaye

[シドニー ６日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）企業のオープンＡＩとアンソロピックは６日、オ...
items.body:
オープンＡＩとアンソロピック、豪州のデータ侵害報告義務化を歓迎
10/6 13:43 配信

アンソロピックのロゴ。6月5日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Byron Kaye

[シドニー ６日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）企業のオープンＡＩとアンソロピックは６日、オーストラリア議会に対し、自社のＡＩエージェントによるデータ侵害を報告することを義務付ける法律を歓迎すると述べた。両社は、当局への通知が現在は各社の裁量に委ねられていることを認めた。

オープンＡＩは数週間前、自社のＡＩエージェントが豪州の主要な医療ポータルサイトに不正侵入したと公表。豪政府は、不正侵入の通知が発生から約３カ月後となったことについて、オープンＡＩを批判している。

アンソロピックとオープンＡＩはそれぞれ、クイーンズランド州とシドニーで計画する大規模データセンターの承認を待っている。また、豪州のコンテンツをモデルの学習に利用できるよう、著作権法の緩和も求めている。

豪州は現在、ＡＩに特化した法律の準備を進めており、２０２７年の施行を目指している。

オープンＡＩのジェイソン・クォン最高戦略責任者（ＣＳＯ）は公聴会で「われわれは情報開示の義務化に関する枠組みを支持する」と表明。不正侵入について知った際、「われわれはプロセスを整理し、適用すべき基準を策定しようとしていた」と説明した上で、「それは法的措置によって提供できる機能だ。社会を代表する人々が、より多くの決定を下す必要がある。そうすればわれわれがこれら全ての決定を下す必要はなくなる」と語った。

アンソロピックでも、同社のエージェントがハッキングを犯したという事例が複数発生しており、オーストラリア・ニュージーランド担当ポリシー責任者デービッド・マスターズ氏も公聴会で、ＡＩ企業にデータ侵害の開示を義務付けるオーストラリアの法律については、同社として喜んで受け入れる意向だと述べた。

また、同社の安全対策責任者、デービッド・オア氏は公聴会で、オープンＡＩのエージェントによるハギング・フェイスへの侵入事件以来、「長期にわたる詳細な調査」を実施してきたが、豪政府のシステムへの不正侵入は確認されなかったと説明した。

９日まで公聴会が予定されており、最終報告書は１１月３０日に提出される予定となっている。

items.title: 日銀、10月会合で基調物価2％到達と判断の可能性＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Takahiko Wada　Leika Kihara

［東京　６日　ロイター］ - 日銀が金融政策運営で重視する基調的...
items.body:
日銀、10月会合で基調物価2％到達と判断の可能性＝関係筋
10/6 13:32 配信

日本銀行本店の前で６月１５日撮影　REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Takahiko Wada　Leika Kihara

［東京　６日　ロイター］ - 日銀が金融政策運営で重視する基調的な物価上昇率について、２％に到達したとの認識を示す方向で検討に入ることが分かった。早ければ今月の金融政策決定会合で判断する。金融環境は依然として緩和的で、基調物価２％程度での定着へ、日銀は引き続き短い間隔での利上げを進める方針だが、物価指標は想定通りに推移しており、現時点で１０月会合での利上げには慎重な見方が多い。複数の関係筋が明らかにした。

日銀は基調的な物価上昇率について、政策要因を除いた消費者物価のコア指標や中長期の予想物価上昇率などから総合的に判断している。９月会合の声明文では「２０２６年度後半から２０２７年度にかけて」２％と整合的な水準に達するとの見方を維持した。

政策委員の間では、すでに高田創委員や田村直樹委員が２％に到達していると主張している。植田和男総裁は９月会合後の会見で、２％に「だいたいヒットしつつある」と述べており、他の委員の見方にも変化が出てきている。９月会合の主な意見では、基調物価は２％に「かなり近づいている」、「ほどなく２％に達することが見込まれる」との意見が見られた。

１日公表の日銀短観では、企業の中長期の予想物価上昇率が高止まりしていることが確認された。日銀では、原油市況が一時的に調整しても、企業の値上げ姿勢が積極的な中で予想物価が下振れすることは考えづらいとの声が出ている。毎月勤労統計では前年比３％付近の賃金上昇が続いており、基調物価の２％到達を示唆しているとの指摘もある。

このため、１０月会合で議論する「経済・物価情勢の展望（展望リポート）」で２％到達の認識を示す可能性が高い。

日銀は９月利上げに当たり、物価の上振れリスクが根強い中で基調物価を２％程度で定着させていくことが重要だと強調した。基調物価が２％に到達した際には政策金利が中立金利に到達している姿を理想としているが、累次の利上げにもかかわらず金融環境はなお緩和的で、政策金利は中立金利にはまだ距離がある状況だ。このため、基調物価が２％に到達したと判断した上で、２％程度での定着に向け、引き続き短い間隔で利上げを進めていく方針だ。

ただ、関係筋によると、９月に続いて１０月会合でも利上げすることに対しては日銀内で慎重な声が出ている。これまでの利上げの経済への影響を見極める必要があるとの見方のほか、短観の企業の物価見通しでは物価予想がさらに上振れていることまでは示されておらず、月次の物価指標も日銀の想定通りに推移しているという。日銀は決定会合までの市場動向なども見極めた上で、利上げの是非を最終判断する。

items.author: CNA
items.summary: South Korea's police have launched a full-scale investigation into the hacking attacks against commercial banks that led to a breach of customers' personal information.

South Korea's Lee says AI appears to have been used in bank hacks

South Korea's police have launched a full-scale investigation into the hacking attacks against commercial banks that led to a breach of customers' personal information. 

South Korean President Lee Jae Myung delivers a speech during the 78th Armed Forces Day at a military base in Gyeryong-City, South Korea, on Oct 1, 2026. (Photo: Jeon Heon-Kyun/Pool via Reuters)

FAST

SEOUL: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said on Tuesday (Oct 6) that AI models are believed to have been used in some recent hacking incidents against banks and called for the country to develop cybersecurity methods suited to the AI era.
"In some hacking incidents, signs have emerged of AI being used, causing considerable public concern and anxiety," Lee said during a Cabinet meeting. "Please establish the circumstances swiftly and clearly, and concentrate personnel and resources on minimising the damage."
South Korea's police have launched a full-scale investigation into the hacking attacks against commercial banks that led to a breach of customers' personal information, the Yonhap news agency reported on Tuesday.
Shinhan Bank, KB Kookmin Bank and others had reported cyberattacks, the Financial Services Commission (FSC) said on Friday, while Yonhap reported that Hana Bank and Woori Bank had also suffered breaches.

Authorities have not yet disclosed details on what kind of AI tools were used in the hacking incidents or the full scale of the breaches.
On Sunday, FSC Chairman Lee Eog-weon convened an emergency meeting with financial industry associations, regulators and executives from affected institutions, warning that the sector must respond with the highest level of vigilance.
In September, Australia said an OpenAI agent breached a government health data portal in June, gaining unauthorised access to files, in what could be the first known instance of an AI agent hacking a government website.
An artificial intelligence research firm said last week that AI agents tried to hack into a Canadian government website , casting the effort as a failed hacking attempt, while Canada said there were no indications its systems were compromised.

Families and rights organisations have repeatedly accused Pakistani security and intelligence agencies of detaining people without due process and keeping them incommunicado, as highlighted by The Balochistan Post.

items.title: Wall Street shares notch records as oil prices stabilize, bond yields retreat
items.author: Lawrence Delevingne, Medha Singh, Stella Qiu
items.creator: Lawrence Delevingne, Medha Singh, Stella Qiu
items.summary: World stocks scaled two-week highs on Tuesday with Wall Street indexes setting new records, as steady oil prices and falling bond yields boosted sentiment and investors looked ahead to an earnings season they expect will be powered by AI-driven growth.
items.body:
World stocks scaled two-week highs on Tuesday with Wall Street indexes setting new records, as steady oil prices and falling bond yields boosted sentiment and investors looked ahead to an earnings season they expect will be powered by AI-driven growth.
The S&P 500 (.SPX) hit a [USN:L6N45S16W TEXT:"fresh record"], up about 0.6% on the day, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq (.IXIC) gained 0.45%, also an all-time high. The Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 0.5%.
The pan-European STOXX 600 (.STOXX) [USN:L4N45S182 TEXT:"gained about 0.5%"] and MSCI's gauge of stocks across the globe (.MIWD00000PUS) rose 0.6%.
Bond markets found [USN:L1N45S0P3 TEXT:"some respite"] on Tuesday after France's contested [USN:L1N45N0A3 TEXT:"budget"] had triggered a French debt rout and fuelled fears of broader stress across the euro zone.
The euro rose 0.3% to 1.126, stabilising after hitting a 17-month low in the previous session due to [USN:L6N45S0D2 TEXT:"concerns"] about the euro zone's fiscal outlook. Political uncertainty also deepened after Spain called a [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"snap election"] on Monday.
France's 10-year bond yield dipped to 4.7% after surging to its highest since the 2000s last week. Far-right leader Marine Le Pen, the frontrunner in next spring's presidential election, [USN:L1N45S0C4 TEXT:"outlined"] her plans to cut spending if elected in 2027.
"On the one hand, you've got quite material pressure being felt on the government bond side. But elsewhere the corporate side of things actually doesn't look too bad. You've got companies whose earnings remain very robust. We're getting into the earnings season fairly soon, expectations for that are pretty high," said James Klempster, deputy head of multi-asset at Liontrust in London.
With few major catalysts on this week's calendar, investors are increasingly focused on third-quarter earnings, which begin in earnest next week. Goldman Sachs estimates consensus forecasts imply 27% growth in S&P 500 earnings, with more than half that coming from companies benefiting from AI infrastructure spending.
Nvidia (NVDA.O) , the world's most valuable company and a bellwether for the AI trade, ticked up 0.14%, rising closer to a market value of $6 trillion.
Brent crude settled slightly higher at about $100.6 a barrel as resilient Middle East [USN:L1N45S05E TEXT:"crude exports"] and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concerns, though ongoing security risks in the region limited losses. US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude < CLc1 > rose 1 cent to settle at $89.44.
Strategists at PIMCO said in a new outlook that they expect stable global growth to continue while inflation moderates as the energy price shock fades and AI-related demand continues to grow.
"The global economy has remained resilient," they wrote.
BOND WORRIES LINGER The dollar weakened broadly against most major currencies, reversing some recent advances as investors pared back their bets on US interest rate hikes following a soft US jobs report and policymakers' calls for more [USN:S0N44V01O TEXT:"evidence"] before further tightening.
The dollar index fell 0.3%, after rising 3% over the past month.
Traders scaled back expectations of a Federal Reserve rate increase this month to 19% from about 50% a week earlier.
Long-dated US Treasury yields also [USN:L1N45S0RM TEXT:"eased"] after touching fresh 24-year highs on Monday, amid a persistent selloff since late August on inflation and debt concerns. The 10-year yield fell 2.7 bps to 5.28%, while the 30-year yield dipped 0.5 bps to 5.65%.
Spot gold [USN:L1N45S0G9 TEXT:"rose"] 0.7% to $4,168 an ounce.

Middle East war sharpens focus on ASEAN energy security plans

Southeast Asian energy ministers meeting in Manila are expected to review regional fuel-security measures as the US-Israeli war against Iran drags on.

A "not available" sign is posted on a fuel dispenser at a gas station amid fuel shortages in Quezon City, Philippines, on Mar 26, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Eloisa Lopez)

FAST

MANILA: Southeast Asian energy ministers meeting in Manila this week face the prospect of a prolonged Middle East war that has exposed the region's vulnerabilities to imported energy.
As the US-Israeli war against Iran drags on, there is increased urgency for ASEAN to implement its proposed energy security plans and reduce its exposure to price shocks caused by attacks on infrastructure and shipping routes in the Middle East. 
ASEAN imports more than half of the crude for its refineries from the Middle East at a time when global benchmark prices are around US$100 a barrel . The conflict has also sharpened concerns about broader energy security risks as Chinese refiners have suspended oil product exports for October.
Against that backdrop, energy ministers meeting in Manila are expected to review regional fuel-security measures launched after emergency talks earlier this year, including efforts to put into effect coordinated emergency responses under the ASEAN Framework Agreement on Petroleum Security (APSA).

Long-term initiatives, including the ASEAN Power Grid and renewable-energy deployment, are also on the agenda.
“What the crisis brought was a sharper focus on resiliency,” Philippine Energy Undersecretary Felix Fuentebella told Reuters on Oct 1, saying energy security had moved from a technical issue to a priority for ASEAN ministers and leaders. 
LOWER EARNINGS The higher prices are raising the costs for the region's households and eating into the earnings of transport workers. 
“We hardly take anything home anymore,” said Antonio Bandin, a Manila jeepney driver who joined a protest last week over rising fuel prices. His working fuel bill has more than doubled to about 2,400 pesos (US$38) per day.

Jeepney drivers and operators march during a protest against the jeepney modernisation program in Manila on Jan 16, 2024. (Photo: AFP/Jam Sta Rosa)

The ASEAN Centre for Energy warned in a policy paper that a severe disruption to Middle East supplies could place oil volumes equivalent to nearly 28 per cent of ASEAN's final oil consumption at risk, underscoring the need for stronger regional petroleum-security arrangements.
But the region's insufficient storage capacity and inventories remain obstacles to implementing APSA, Alloysius Joko Purwanto, senior energy economist at the Economic Research Institute for ASEAN and East Asia, warned on Friday during a webinar hosted by the Center for Strategic and International Studies.
Energy Secretary Sharon Garin has said the Philippines, which remains under a national energy emergency, is exploring regional fuel-stockpiling arrangements and could host future storage projects.

Related:

Philippines suspends LPG, kerosene excise over Mideast war

Trump rules out diesel export ban after European release

But analysts cautioned that such measures are unlikely to affect the present crisis.
“This is more about preparing for the next crisis. A reserve is a buffer. It is not a strategy,” Christopher Len, a senior fellow at the ISEAS-Yusof Ishak Institute, said in the same webinar, referring to regional stockpiling initiatives. 
Ministers are also expected to discuss ways to reduce long-term dependence on imported fuels. Renewable energy, electric vehicles, and energy efficiency are expected to feature prominently.
The International Energy Agency estimates Southeast Asia's energy import bill could rise from more than US$80 billion in 2024 to about US$245 billion by 2035 without structural change. 
The IEA said wider electrification, including electric vehicles and biofuels, would help curb oil demand and reduce exposure to volatile fuel imports, while cross-border links under the ASEAN Power Grid that would integrate the region's electrical network will require about US$27 billion in investment by 2040.
“We should actually use this shock as a lesson to reduce exposure, not only to cushion it,” Len said.

Source: Reuters/ec

items.title: Euro bounces as decline in French bond yields cools debt jitters
items.author: Chuck Mikolajczak
items.creator: Chuck Mikolajczak
items.summary: The euro rebounded on Tuesday and was poised for its strongest move higher in seven weeks after falling to a 17-month low on the prior day, as a pullback in French government bond yields eased fears about strain in euro zone debt markets.
items.body:
The euro rebounded on Tuesday and was poised for its strongest move higher in seven weeks after falling to a 17-month low on the prior day, as a pullback in French government bond yields eased fears about strain in euro zone debt markets.
The euro zone's currency jumped 0.35%, on track for its biggest daily gain since August 19, at $1.126. The currency had slid to its lowest since May 2025 on Monday at $1.116, following a drop of more than 1% in the prior week, its fourth straight weekly decline.
The dollar index , which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies, fell 0.32% to 101.83 and was on pace for its biggest daily drop since September 3.
Bond markets around the world have seen yields climb in recent weeks due to expectations of sharp central bank rate hikes as energy prices have jumped because of the Iran war and stoked inflation, as well as concerns about government finances.
French debt [USN:L6N45O0HP TEXT:"has seen pressure mount"] as politicians struggle to curb the budget deficit ahead of a divisive election in 2027. The calling of a [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"snap election in Spain"] added to the recent pressure on the euro.
ENERGY PRICES EASE BOND PRESSURE [USN:L1N45S05E TEXT:"An early drop in energy prices"] helped French bonds rally on Tuesday, with the key 10-year yield down 11.4 basis points at 4.7506%.
Crude prices had fallen as rising Middle Eastern crude exports and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concern as Saudi-backed Yemeni [USN:L1N45R06H TEXT:"government forces staged"] a lightning advance on Monday to retake the coast around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait up to the city of Mocha, the government said, but prices had since rebounded to erase declines.
"Saudi-backed Yemen forces have recaptured some strategic territory from the Houthis, this has seen oil prices drop sharply," said Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Capital Markets in New York. "In turn, this has helped drag yields down, including in France, and in Italy, where the spreads had really widened lately and so this is giving the euro a bit of a bounce."
Far-right French presidential candidate Marine Le Pen, who leads the polls, on Tuesday [USN:L1N45S0C4 TEXT:"increased her plans to reduce spending"] to €140 billion ($158 billion) from €125 billion in savings originally planned if she wins power in 2027.
The fall in the dollar helped buoy other currencies, with sterling up 0.42% and on pace for its biggest daily gain since August 19, to $1.3275, after climbing to a one-week high of $1.3283.
JAPAN SIGNALS RATE RISE READINESS The yen was an exception, with the dollar up 0.11% to 158.08 against the Japanese currency.
[USN:L4N45S011 TEXT:"The Bank of Japan may signal"] this month that underlying inflation has roughly hit its 2% target, three people familiar with its thinking said, highlighting its readiness to raise interest rates again in the coming months.
Bank of Japan Governor [USN:L1N45S06F TEXT:"Kazuo Ueda said"] it was becoming more important to anchor underlying inflation around the central bank's 2% target, signaling a preparedness to keep raising interest rates to blunt the risk of too-high inflation.
The US dollar's recent strength has come even as expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike at the central bank's policy meeting later this month have retreated in the wake of [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"weaker-than-expected US jobs data"] and comments from some Fed officials. However, markets are still anticipating more rate hikes later in the year and next year.
The gains for the dollar in September were partly due to the greater exposure of US equities to technology and AI, said Goldman Sachs analysts in a note, along with the recent outperformance of US growth. But the firm is cautious on the prospects for near-term dollar strength, citing stretched positioning in several major pairs and the recent Fed communication emphasizing a patient approach to policy tightening.
In contrast to the recent call for patience from some Fed officials, Kansas City Fed President Jeff [USN:S0N3XI00P TEXT:"Schmid said"] on Tuesday that the central bank still needs to raise its policy rate further to lower inflation, even if higher long-term yields are weighing on activity in some parts of the economy.
The chance of a hike of at least 25 basis points in October stands at about 19%, from about 51% a week ago, according to CME FedWatch , but markets are pricing in an 86% chance for a hike at the December meeting.

items.title: Oil prices stable as market weighs supply risks, rising Middle East exports
items.author: Scott Disavino
items.creator: Scott Disavino
items.summary: Oil prices were little changed on Tuesday after recovering earlier losses, as the market weighed increases in Middle Eastern crude exports and a planned Group of Seven release of emergency diesel and crude stockpiles against supply concerns related to attacks by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis.
items.body:
Oil prices were little changed on Tuesday after recovering earlier losses, as the market weighed increases in Middle Eastern crude exports and a planned Group of Seven release of emergency diesel and crude stockpiles against supply concerns related to attacks by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis.
Brent futures rose 26 cents, or 0.3%, to settle at $100.58 a barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude rose one cent to settle at $89.44.
Around 12 million barrels per day of crude oil and 2 million bpd of refined products — volumes needed to dampen price pressure — have left the Middle East on tankers in the last seven to 10 days, the [USN:L6N45S0MD TEXT:"CEO of commodity trading giant Vitol"] said on Tuesday.
[USN:L1N45S0DH TEXT:"Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman"] said on Tuesday that oil pumped through the East-West Pipeline, which runs to the kingdom's Red Sea export hub of Yanbu, had reached 5.8 million barrels as of Tuesday morning.
Oil price declines, however, have been limited by the possibility of further Middle East supply disruptions.
[USN:L1N45S0BG TEXT:"Saudi Arabia's airports"] in Jazan and Najran were targeted in two attacks on Monday evening, injuring three people and causing limited damage, the Saudi aviation authority said, as hostilities between the kingdom and Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis escalated.
The attacks occurred as Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces pressed a major offensive to retake territory from the Houthis, after weeks of rebel advances, with Riyadh stepping up airstrikes in support of the campaign.
Separately, President [USN:L1N45S0UA TEXT:"Volodymyr Zelenskiy"] of Ukraine said on Tuesday that the latest intelligence suggested Russia was preparing a "massive attack."
Russia was the world's third-biggest crude oil producer behind the US and Saudi Arabia in 2025, according to US energy data. [USN:L1N45S0RE TEXT:"Sanctions"] designed to keep Russian energy out of global markets have helped support oil prices since Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022. A deal to end the Russia-Ukraine war could allow Russia to export more energy.
In the US, meanwhile, the [USN:AQN2MMYYH TEXT:"National Hurricane Center"] said there was a 100% chance a cyclone could form over the next seven days in the Gulf of Mexico. A storm in the US Gulf could boost oil prices by shutting oil and natural gas production and damaging other energy infrastructure.
OIL STOCKS AROUND THE WORLD The [USN:L6N45S0US TEXT:"International Energy Agency"] will meet next week to work out the details of a diesel stock release as market confusion grows over how many barrels Europe and the US plan to make available to address shortages and record-high prices, sources said.
The surge in diesel prices has turned the fuel, which underpins trucking, agriculture and industry, into a global political and economic concern. The wars in Iran and Ukraine have curtailed exports and damaged refineries, helping drive the rise in prices.
Under pressure from US President Donald Trump , the [USN:L8N45S0QH TEXT:"Group of Seven"] major economies agreed on Friday to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil from emergency reserves and pledged to refrain from imposing energy export restrictions.
With the war in Iran disrupting the flow of Middle East oil supplies, the US Energy Information Administration projected on Tuesday that world petroleum production would drop from a record 106.3 million bpd in 2025 to 101.1 million bpd in 2026, and world oil demand will drop from a record 104.4 million bpd in 2025 to 102.4 million bpd in 2026.
In 2027, however, EIA projected world oil supply and demand would rise back to record highs of 109.6 million bpd of production and 104.6 million bpd of consumption.
In the US, meanwhile, the oil market was watching for weekly storage reports from the American Petroleum Institute trade group on Tuesday and the EIA on Wednesday.
Analysts estimated energy firms added 1.7 million barrels of crude to US storage during the week ended October 2.
If correct, it would mark the first time since August that crude stocks increased for three weeks in a row and compare with an increase of 3.7 million barrels in the same week last year and an average increase of 1.7 million barrels over the past five years (2021 to 2025). ,

items.title: Dozens quarantined in Siberia after plague institute lab worker dies
items.author: CNA
items.summary: The World Health Organization said that based on available information, "the public health risk to the general population appears to be low".
items.body:

Dozens quarantined in Siberia after plague institute lab worker dies

The World Health Organization said that based on available information, "the public health risk to the general population appears to be low". 

This undated photo released by the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and Far East, shows the institute workers in a lab. (File photo: AP/The Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia/Far East)

06 Oct 2026 07:03AM
(Updated: 06 Oct 2026 07:06AM)

FAST

MOSCOW: A laboratory worker at a plague research institute in Siberia fell ill and died in undisclosed circumstances, prompting authorities to quarantine dozens of people and the head of Russia's health watchdog to fly to the Irkutsk region.
The death has sparked public health fears on social media, but the authorities said on Monday (Oct 5) the situation was under control.
The World Health Organization said that based on available information, "the public health risk to the general population appears to be low". New risk assessments would be conducted once further information became known, it said.
US President Donald Trump said the death was a "big problem for Russia" and offered to help Moscow deal with it.

"We'll help," Trump said. "Anybody that has that kind of a problem, we're always willing to help."
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Washington was closely monitoring the situation.
Plague is endemic to Siberia - the location of the first known prehistoric human outbreak - as the bacterium that causes it, Yersinia pestis, is present among the small wild mammals in its vast wilderness and their fleas. 
However, it is rare for Russians to fall ill with plague, though cases occur every year in other parts of the world - notably Africa.
Plague comes in three forms affecting different parts of the body. Pneumonic plague, an infection of the lungs, prompts the patient to cough out infectious airborne droplets.
If identified quickly, it can be treated with antibiotics. But if left untreated, it can be fatal in one to six days.
Local media have named the laboratory worker who died as Darya Shipilova, a 28-year-old employee at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East.
There were conflicting reports about how and where she fell ill, but the authorities said she had died of pneumonia of as-yet unestablished origin.

AUTHORITIES SAY NO NEW CASES REPORTED, ALL CONTACTS TRACED Russia's health watchdog, Rospotrebnadzor, told state media the institute had not found evidence of any accidents involving the handling of pathogens after rumours spread on social media that the woman had dropped a test tube containing live bacteria.
Nevertheless, Anna Popova, the head of Rospotrebnadzor, flew to Siberia for an emergency meeting over the weekend.
According to Russian media reports, about 200 people who had been in contact with the dead woman were quarantined, parts of the hospital in the town of Shelekhov where she died were cordoned off and an aluminium plant told its workers to wear masks.
Rospotrebnadzor, in a later statement quoted by the TASS news agency, said officials in Irkutsk Region had found two cases of COVID and two cases of rhinoviruses among people who had been in contact with her. No other cases of infectious diseases were noted.
Authorities urged people to remain calm and said there was no evidence that the woman's death was linked to her work.
Igor Kobzev, the governor of the Irkutsk region, said in a statement that she had died of "pneumonia of unknown aetiology", adding: "Importantly, over the past few days, no new cases of staff from the Anti-Plague Institute seeking medical attention have been identified."
He said the situation was under control and that all known contacts of the dead woman had been identified, examined and placed under medical supervision.

items.title: Barrick secures 15-year North Mara mining licences in Tanzania
items.author: Northern Miner Staff
items.creator: Northern Miner Staff
items.summary: The latest approval removes tenure risk, leaving Barrick to reverse a sharp first-half production decline.
items.body:
Barrick secures 15-year North Mara mining licences in Tanzania

Henry Lazenby | October 5, 2026 | 12:10 pm
Top Companies   Africa   Canada   Gold  

( Image by Twiga Partnership, Facebook. )

Tanzania has renewed Barrick Mining’s (TSX: ABX; NYSE: B) licences for the North Mara gold mine for 15 years, securing its operating tenure as the company weighs an expansion.

North Mara is a combined open-pit and underground operation about 540 km northwest of Dodoma and 20 km south of the Kenyan border. Barrick owns 84% and Tanzania holds the remaining 16%. The mine produced 249,000 attributable oz. last year.

“Relations at North Mara mine have strengthened since Barrick took over,” Tarime district commissioner Maj. Edward Gowele said in Barrick’s Monday release. “Residents now really view the mine as a community partner.”

North Mara’s two special mining licences were last renewed for 15 years in 2012. The latest approval removes that separate tenure risk, leaving Barrick to reverse a sharp first-half production decline, meet North Mara’s attributable 2026 guidance of 200,000 to 230,000 oz. and decide whether to expand the North Mara-Bulyanhulu complex.

Barrick’s Toronto-traded shares were down 1% at $56.84 (US$39.87) apiece by mid-Monday, after tracking 20% higher over the past 12 months. Bids have tested $42.62 and $74.00 over the same period.

Production test

Attributable output fell 47% to 68,000 oz. in the first half from 129,000 oz. a year earlier. All-in sustaining costs rose 79% to US$2,283 per oz. from US$1,272 per ounce. Barrick cited lower grades at North Mara among the factors raising company-wide second-quarter costs.

Barrick maintained North Mara’s guidance at 200,000 to 230,000 oz. and all-in sustaining costs of US$1,520-US$1,680 per oz. The mine must produce 132,000 to 162,000 oz. in the second half to reach that range.

North Mara output is expected to rise next year. Barrick is studying upgrades to remove processing bottlenecks and expand the North Mara-Bulyanhulu complex.

North Mara held attributable proven and probable reserves of 43 million tonnes grading 2.32 grams gold per tonne for 3.2 million oz. at the end of 2025, Barrick reported.

State reset

Barrick bought the 36% of Acacia Mining it didn’t already own in September 2019 and took direct control of North Mara. Under then-CEO Mark Bristow, it reached a settlement with Tanzania the following month and formalized it in January 2020, agreeing to pay $300 million, give the state a 16% free-carried interest in the mines and split their economic benefits equally.

The accord created Twiga Minerals to manage North Mara and Bulyanhulu. Since 2019, Barrick says its Tanzanian operations have contributed about $5.3 billion to the country, including $1.2 billion last year.

LBMA trial

The renewal comes as the London Bullion Market Association prepares for a six-week High Court trial beginning Wednesday over the deaths of two 23-year-old artisanal miners at North Mara in 2019. Their families allege Tanzanian police, private guards or both killed the men in separate incidents that July and December.

Barrick took operational control in September, between the incidents. It isn’t a defendant in the London case and declined to comment to Reuters , the news outlet reported Monday.

The claim alleges the LBMA negligently kept India-based refiner MMTC-PAMP that processed North Mara gold on its ‘good delivery list’ despite reports of abuses at the mine. The list determines which refiners’ bars are accepted in London’s wholesale bullion market.

The LBMA denies liability, saying it certifies refiners rather than mines and had no control over North Mara or Tanzanian police.

The association held about £1.4 million ($1.8 million) in reserves at the end of 2025 and could face £3 million in claimants’ legal costs before damages if it loses, Bloomberg reported on Monday.

A ruling holding the LBMA responsible could set a precedent for compensation over abuses at supplying mines and threaten its role in global gold trading, John Meyer, a mining analyst at SP Angel, said in a note on Monday. The court has stayed another 26 claims and five potential claims until after the trial, according to the LBMA.
